 	from the lemma. It therefore establishes the extraction conclusions only
 	after the measurement and its consistency estimates are supplied, not the
 	existence claim above. The missing composition and the range-projection
 	transfer are recorded in \cite{gap:qpbt_extraction-transfer}.

 \begin{proof}
 	\uses{def:v-swap-unitary, lem:v-swap-conjugation, lem:tildew-product-form, lem:qld-construct-the-paulis, lem:qld-win-implications, fact:triangle-for-simeq, def:bracket, lem:cancellation, lem:schwartz-zippel-total-degree, lem:qld-4-7}
 	For the first item, the self-consistency of the observables $\tilde{W}^j$ (Item~2 of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-construct-the-paulis}) is equivalent, since these observables are Hermitian involutions (Lemma~\ref{lem:tildew-product-form}), to $\E_{j \in \{0,\ldots,t-1\}} \E_{\tilde{u} \in \F_q^M} \bra{\hat\psi} \tilde{W}^j(\tilde{u}) \ot \tilde{W}^j(\tilde{u}) \ket{\hat\psi} \geq 1 - \delta_P/2$; setting $\ket{\vartheta} = V_{\mathrm{A}} \ot V_{\mathrm{B}} \ket{\hat\psi}$ and using the exact conjugation identities of Lemma~\ref{lem:v-swap-conjugation}, this becomes $\bra{\vartheta} H_W \ket{\vartheta} \geq 1 - \delta_P/2$ for $W \in \{X,Z\}$, where $H_W = \E_j \E_{\tilde{u}} \, \tau^W(e_j \tilde{u}) \ot \tau^W(e_j \tilde{u}) = \bigl( \E_{s \in \F_q} \tau^W(s) \ot \tau^W(s) \bigr)^{\ot M}$ by the tensor factorization of $\tau^W(\tilde{u})$ and the invariance of the uniform average over $s$ under $s \mapsto e_j s$. By Lemma~\ref{lem:cancellation}, $\E_{s,s'} \tau^X(s)\tau^Z(s') \ot \tau^X(s)\tau^Z(s') = \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}$ on each pair of qudits, whence $H_X H_Z = \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M}$. The bounds $\| (\Id - H_W)\ket{\vartheta} \|^2 \leq \delta_P$ and $\bra{\vartheta} H_W^2 \ket{\vartheta} \geq 1 - 2\delta_P$, combined through the triangle inequality $\| H_X \ket{\vartheta} - H_Z \ket{\vartheta} \| \leq 2\sqrt{\delta_P}$ (see Remark~\ref{rem:qld-unitary-triangle-slip}), give $\bra{\vartheta} \Id_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot (\ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M})_{\mathrm{A}''\mathrm{B}''} \ket{\vartheta} \geq 1 - 4\delta_P$.
 	% Case distinction added: the source normalizes the projected vector
 	% without ensuring that it is nonzero; see Remark rem:qld-unitary-triangle-slip.
 	If $\delta_P > 1/8$, then, after enlarging the universal constant in $\delta_{\mathrm{qld}}$, both items of the lemma hold with $\ket{\mathrm{aux}}$ an arbitrary unit state, since their left-hand sides never exceed $4$; assume therefore $\delta_P \leq 1/8$.     38	  let L (u : I → K) :=
    39	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (1 : Op (I → K)))
    40	  let B (u : I → K) :=
    41	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (1 : Op (I → K)) (tauObservable W u))
    42	  let C (u : I → K) :=
    43	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))

    55	/-- Conjugating both operator families and the state by the same unitary

    57	theorem opDistSq_conjBy_apply_eq {X I : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

    60	    opDistSq mu (fun x => conjBy U (A x)) (fun x => conjBy U (B x))

    70	  intro x

    72	    MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_isometry_mul hU]

    74	/-- After the swaps, the pulled-apart distance is exactly the distance of the

     5	/-!
     6	# Transfer of the complete Pauli overlap between states
     7	
     8	A selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a positive contraction.
     9	Applied to the product measurement, this bounds the complete overlap operator,
    10	independently of the number of answers. Its expectation changes by at most twice
    11	the distance between unit vectors. Schwartz--Zippel then removes unequal Pauli
    12	encodings after the change of state.

    15

    29	/-- Any selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a contraction.
    30	The estimate applies to the whole sum and has no outcome-cardinality factor. -/
    31	theorem norm_apply_measurement_sum_le {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
    32	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (s : Finset α)
    33	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    34	    ‖applyOperatorToState (∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a) psi‖ ≤ ‖psi‖ := by
    35	  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => M.pos a)
    36	  have hle : ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
    37	    rw [← M.sum_eq_one]
    38	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)
    39	      (fun a _ _ => M.pos a)
    40	  apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
    41	  rw [(Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hpos).isHermitian.eq]
    42	  exact (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self hpos hle).trans hle
    43	
    44	/-- Changing a unit vector changes the expectation of a contraction by at most
    45	twice the vector distance. No positivity or self-adjointness is required. -/
    46	theorem abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction {ι : Type*}
    47	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : Op ι)
    48	    (hT : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖applyOperatorToState T v‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
    49	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    50	    |stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T| ≤ 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    51	  have hsplit : stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T =
    52	      (inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re +
    53	        (inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re := by
    54	    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
    55	  rw [hsplit]
    56	  calc
    57	    _ ≤ |(inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re| +
    58	        |(inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re| := abs_add_le _ _
    59	    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T psi‖ +
    60	        ‖phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi)‖ :=
    61	      add_le_add ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
    62	        ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
    63	    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖psi‖ + ‖phi‖ * ‖psi - phi‖ :=
    64	      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT psi) (norm_nonneg _))
    65	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT (psi - phi)) (norm_nonneg _))
    66	    _ = _ := by rw [hpsi, hphi]; ring
    67	
    68	/-- The complete diagonal overlap of two local measurements is stable under a
    69	change of unit state. The tensor factors can have different dimensions. -/
    70	theorem abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le {α I J : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    72	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J)
    73	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    74	    |(∑ a, stateQForm psi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))) -
    75	      ∑ a, stateQForm phi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))| ≤
    76	        2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    77	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : α × α => ab.1 = ab.2)
    78	  have heq : (∑ ab ∈ s, (tensorMeasurement A B).effect ab) =
    79	      ∑ a, heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a) := by
    80	    simp [s, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type, tensorMeasurement,
    81	      Measurement.ofSumEqOne]
    82	  have h := abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction _
    83	    (norm_apply_measurement_sum_le (tensorMeasurement A B) s) psi phi hpsi hphi
    84	  rw [heq, stateQForm_finset_sum, stateQForm_finset_sum] at h
    85	  exact h

    87	/-- Averaging evaluated overlaps does not increase the state-transfer cost.
    88	This controls the complete overlap in paper `eq:qld-unitary-9`. -/
    89	theorem evaluated_overlap_state_transfer {Y α R I J : Type*}
    90	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    91	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    92	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    93	    (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J) (eval : α → Y → R)
    94	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    95	    avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y => ∑ r, stateQForm psi
    96	      (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r)
    97	        ((B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r))) ≤
    98	      avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y => ∑ r, stateQForm phi
    99	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r)
   100	          ((B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r))) + 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
   101	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution Y) _ _ (fun y =>
   102	    (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le
   103	      (A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)) (B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y))
   104	      psi phi hpsi hphi))
   105	  rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability _
   106	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at h
   107	  linarith

   109	/-- Two distinct Pauli answers have encodings agreeing on at most an `md/q`
   110	fraction of points. Injectivity follows from the exact decoder identity. -/
   111	theorem pauli_encoding_collision_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
   112	    (h k : PauliRegister P) (hne : h ≠ k) :
   113	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   114	      (fun u => if evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u = evalPoly (encodingPoly k) u
   115	        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   116	  apply poly_eval_collision_le
   117	  intro heq
   118	  apply hne
   119	  have hd := congrArg (fun g : Poly P => decodeFq g) heq
   120	  simpa only [decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding] using hd
   121	
   122	/-- The unevaluated Pauli overlap on a unit comparison state is bounded below
   123	by the evaluated overlap on another unit state, minus the collision and state
   124	errors. This combines paper `eq:qld-unitary-8` with the transfer following
   125	`eq:qld-unitary-9`, without any dimension or answer-count factor. -/
   126	theorem pauli_overlap_transfer {P : AdmissibleParams} {I J : Type*}
   127	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   128	    (A : Measurement (PauliRegister P) I) (B : Measurement (PauliRegister P) J)
   129	    (theta ideal : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   130	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) (hideal : ‖ideal‖ = 1) :
   131	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   132	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
   133	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   134	          ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) ≤
   135	      (∑ h, stateQForm ideal (heteroKron (A.effect h) (B.effect h))) +
   136	        (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q + 2 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
   137	  have ht := evaluated_overlap_state_transfer A B
   138	    (fun h u => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u) theta ideal htheta hideal
   139	  have hc := SandwichProduct.avg_diagonal_postprocess_stateQForm_le A B ideal
   140	    (fun h u => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hideal
   141	    (by positivity) pauli_encoding_collision_le
   142	  exact ht.trans (add_le_add hc le_rfl)
   143

    99	/-- At construction error at most one, a universal extraction coefficient of

   102	`deltaExtract`; there is no parameter-dependent enlargement of the constant. -/
   103	theorem extraction_small_error_absorption (C delta : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ)
   104	    (hC : 18 ≤ C) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1) :
   105	    16 * delta ≤ deltaExtract C delta m d q ∧
   106	      2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
   107	        deltaExtract C delta m d q := by
   108	  have hroot := Real.self_le_rpow_of_le_one hdelta hdelta_one
   109	    (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
   110	  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt delta ≤ delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   111	    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
   112	    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hdelta hdelta_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
   113	  have hr : 0 ≤ (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) := by positivity
   114	  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC
   115	    (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hdelta (1 / 4)) hr)
   116	  constructor
   117	  · exact (show 16 * delta ≤ 18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   118	      ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
   119	  · exact (show 2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
   120	      18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp

    39	    (theta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((I × PauliRegister P) × (J × PauliRegister P)))
    40	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) :
    41	    let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    42	    let B := rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := I) (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)
    43	    (∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    44	      (heteroKron (1 : Op (I × PauliRegister P))
    45	        (A.effect h - heteroKron (1 : Op J) (pauliProj W h))) ideal‖ ^ 2) ≤
    46	      2 * (1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    47	        ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
    48	          (heteroKron ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
    49	            ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)))) +
    50	        2 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) + 4 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
    51	  let e := Equiv.prodComm (I × PauliRegister P) (J × PauliRegister P)
    52	  let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    53	  have hideal : reindexState prodShuffle
    54	      (vecTensor (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) aux) (eprState (PauliRegister P))) =
    55	      reindexState e ideal := by
    56	    ext p
    57	    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, prodShuffle, eprState, e, ideal, eq_comm]
    58	  have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_le A W (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) aux)
    59	    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, haux]) (reindexState e theta)
    60	    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, htheta])
    61	  dsimp only at h ⊢
    62	  rw [hideal, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
    63	  dsimp only [e] at h
    64	  simp_rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
    65	    WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, WinImplications.reindexOp_prodComm_heteroKron] at h
    66	  exact h

    73	/-- The evaluated total-Pauli consistency defect against the opposite
    74	pulled-apart measurement, with the tensor factors in Alice--Bob order. -/
    75	def evaluatedPauliDefect (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    76	    (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
    77	  match side with
    78	  | .alice => consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    79	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
    80	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat
    81	  | .bob => consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    82	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    83	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat

    85	/-- The ideal state in local extraction-block order. -/
    86	theorem reindexState_idealExpState_blocks
    87	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    88	    reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    89	      (S.idealExpState aux) = reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux
    90	        (eprState (PauliRegister P))) := by
    91	  rfl

    93	/-- Subtraction of block operators agrees with subtraction after placement. -/
    94	theorem placeSide_sub (side : PlayerSide)
    95	    (A B : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    96	    S.placeSide side (A - B) = S.placeSide side A - S.placeSide side B := by
    97	  cases side
    98	  · ext row col
    99	    exact sub_mul _ _ _
   100	  · ext row col
   101	    exact mul_sub _ _ _

   103	/-- The entire answer-summed distance in block coordinates is the distance
   104	appearing in `ExtractionWitness.pauli_close`, for either player. -/
   105	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_eq_sum (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   106	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   107	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   108	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   109	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   110	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   111	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   112	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   113	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) =
   114	      ∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   115	        (S.placeSide side (((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).effect h) -
   116	          heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) (pauliProj W h)))
   117	        (S.idealExpState aux)‖ ^ 2 := by
   118	  simp_rw [S.placeSide_sub, S.placeSide_swappedPauliMeas, S.placeSide_extracted]
   119	  exact avgOver_uniform_const _

   122	/-- For the concrete swaps, the full Pauli distance on the normalized ideal
   123	state is bounded by the evaluated consistency defect and the two established
   124	comparison losses. This instantiates `eq:qld-unitary-7`--`eq:qld-unitary-9`
   125	with all six-register placements and both player orientations. -/
   126	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_le (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   127	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   128	    (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1) (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   129	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   130	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   131	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   132	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   133	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   134	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) ≤
   135	      2 * S.evaluatedPauliDefect w side W + 2 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) +
   136	        4 * ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
   137	          S.idealExpState aux‖ := by
   138	  let e := sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
   139	  let theta := S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat
   140	  have htheta : ‖reindexState e theta‖ = 1 := by
   141	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq]
   142	    exact S.applyBoth_swap_norm w
   143	  rw [S.extraction_pauli_dist_eq_sum]
   144	  cases side
   145	  · have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_le (S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W) W aux haux
   146	      (reindexState e theta) htheta
   147	    dsimp only at h
   148	    erw [S.swapped_pauli_overlap_alice w W, sub_sub_cancel,
   149	      ← S.reindexState_idealExpState_blocks aux, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
   150	    convert h using 1
   151	    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   152	      intro label _
   153	      congr 1
   154	      exact (WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState e _ _).symm
   155	    · rfl
   156	  · have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_right_le (S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W) W aux haux
   157	      (reindexState e theta) htheta
   158	    dsimp only at h
   159	    erw [S.swapped_pauli_overlap_bob w W, sub_sub_cancel,
   160	      ← S.reindexState_idealExpState_blocks aux, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
   161	    convert h using 1
   162	    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   163	      intro label _
   164	      congr 1
   165	      exact (WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState e _ _).symm
   166	    · rfl

    28	/-- Simultaneous unitary conjugation preserves the quadratic form of a product. -/
    29	theorem stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    30	    (U A B : Op I) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    31	    stateQForm (applyOperatorToState U psi) (conjBy U A * conjBy U B) =
    32	      stateQForm psi (A * B) := by
    33	  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    34	  congr 1
    35	  simp only [conjBy]
    36	  calc
    37	    _ = (Uᴴ * U) * A * (Uᴴ * U) * B * (Uᴴ * U) := by noncomm_ring
    38	    _ = A * B := by rw [hU]; simp

    45	/-- The total Pauli POVM extended to the full local extraction block and
    46	conjugated by the concrete swap. This is the measurement in `eq:qld-unitary-7`. -/
    47	def swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    48	    (W : PauliKind) : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
    49	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    50	    (fun h => conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    51	    (fun h => by
    52	      apply star_right_conjugate_nonneg
    53	      exact kronecker_nonneg
    54	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.pauliMeas side W).pos h) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    55	        Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    56	    (by
    57	      simp only [conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    58	        ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one,
    59	        heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose])

    65	    ((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).postprocess
    66	      (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a =
    67	      conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliEvalMeas side W u).effect a)) := by
    68	  simp only [swappedPauliMeas, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
    69	    pauliEvalMeas, conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    70	    ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left]

    74	theorem placeSide_onPlayer (side : PlayerSide) (A : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
    75	    S.placeSide side (S.onPlayer side A) = S.placePlayer side A := by

    80	/-- The canonical last-register effect has the same block and crossed placements. -/
    81	theorem placeSide_extracted (side : PlayerSide) (T : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
    82	    S.placeSide side (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) T) =
    83	      S.placeExtractedRegister side T := by

    86	    change
    87	      ((if (row.1.1, row.1.2.1) = (col.1.1, col.1.2.1) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
    88	        T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    89	        (if ((row.2.1, row.2.2.1), row.2.2.2) =
    90	          ((col.2.1, col.2.2.1), col.2.2.2) then 1 else 0) =
    91	      (if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) *
    92	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    93	        ((if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    94	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    95	        (if row.2.2.2 = col.2.2.2 then 1 else 0)
    96	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and, ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_one,
    97	      zero_mul, mul_zero]
    98	    split_ifs <;> rfl
    99	  · ext row col

   102	        ((col.1.1, col.1.2.1), col.1.2.2) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *

   107	        (if row.1.2.2 = col.1.2.2 then 1 else 0) *
   108	        (if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   109	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0)

   156	/-- On the jointly swapped state, the overlap of conjugated block measurements
   157	is one minus their original consistency defect. This is simultaneous unitary
   158	invariance with the exact six-register reassociation. -/
   159	theorem swapped_block_overlap_eq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   160	    {X α : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   161	    (mu : Distribution X) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
   162	    (A : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   163	    (B : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   164	    avgOver mu (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm
   165	      (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   166	        (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   167	      (heteroKron (conjBy (swapUnitary w .alice) ((A x).effect a))
   168	        (conjBy (swapUnitary w .bob) ((B x).effect a)))) =
   169	      1 - consistencyDefect mu
   170	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .alice ((A x).effect a))
   171	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .bob ((B x).effect a)) S.psiHat := by
   172	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu
   173	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .alice (A x))
   174	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .bob (B x)) S.psiHat hmu S.psiHat_norm
   175	  simp only [blockMeasurement_effect] at h
   176	  rw [h, sub_sub_cancel]
   177	  apply avgOver_congr
   178	  intro x
   179	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   180	  intro a _
   181	  rw [WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, S.reindexOp_heteroKron_eq_placeSides]
   182	  erw [← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .alice,
   183	    ← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .bob]
   184	  exact stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply _ _ _ (S.placeBoth_swap_left_unitary w) S.psiHat

   187	/-- Alice's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Bob's canonical
   188	measurement is exactly one minus the evaluated-Pauli/tilde consistency defect. -/
   189	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_alice (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   190	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   191	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm
   192	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   193	          (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   194	        (heteroKron (((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).postprocess
   195	          (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   196	          (((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   197	            (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   198	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) =
   199	      1 - consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   200	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   201	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat := by
   202	  simp only [S.swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect]
   203	  simp_rw [S.canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM w .bob]
   204	  have h := S.swapped_block_overlap_eq w _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   205	    (fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u)))
   206	    (fun u => Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u))
   207	      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   208	      (sum_tildeM_eq_one w .bob W (indicatorVec u)))

   210	    S.placeSide_onPlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a)
   211	  convert
   212	    (h.trans (congrArg (fun f => 1 - consistencyDefect _ f _ S.psiHat)
   213	      (funext fun u => funext fun a => hplace u a))) using 1 <;> rfl

   216	/-- Bob's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Alice's canonical
   217	measurement satisfies the same exact transport, without strategy symmetry. -/
   218	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_bob (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   219	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   220	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm
   221	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   222	          (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   223	        (heteroKron (((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
   224	            (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   225	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   226	          (((S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W).postprocess
   227	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) =
   228	      1 - consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   229	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   230	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat := by
   231	  simp only [S.swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect]
   232	  simp_rw [S.canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM w .alice]
   233	  have h := S.swapped_block_overlap_eq w _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   234	    (fun u => Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u))
   235	      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   236	      (sum_tildeM_eq_one w .alice W (indicatorVec u)))
   237	    (fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u)))
   238	  have hplace (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :=
   239	    S.placeSide_onPlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)
   240	  convert
   241	    (h.trans (congrArg (fun f => 1 - consistencyDefect _ _ f S.psiHat)
   242	      (funext fun u => funext fun a => hplace u a))) using 1 <;> rfl

    35	    (S.placeBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob))ᴴ *
    36	      S.placeBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) = 1 := by
    37	  classical
    38	  rw [placeBoth, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
    39	    MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, heteroKron_mul]
    40	  erw [conjTranspose_mul_swapUnitary, conjTranspose_mul_swapUnitary]
    41	  erw [heteroKron_one_one]

    48	  rw [applyBoth, MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_of_isometry

    55	      S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side) = 1 := by
    56	  classical
    57	  cases side <;>
    58	    simp only [placeSide, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
    59	      MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
    60	      heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one] <;>
    61	    erw [conjTranspose_mul_swapUnitary] <;>

    66	    (p : Placement) (A : α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
    67	    (hA : ∑ a, (A a)ᴴ * A a = 1) :
    68	    ∑ a, (S.place p (A a))ᴴ * S.place p (A a) = 1 := by

    73	This is the completeness used to expand the distance at paper lines 1827-1834. -/

    75	    ∑ h, (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h))ᴴ *
    76	      S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h) = 1 := by
    77	  classical

    79	      (S.pauliMeas side W).effect h = 1 := by
    80	    have hproj : Measurement.IsProjective (S.pauliMeas side W) := by
    81	      apply SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
    82	      cases side with
    83	      | alice => exact S.isProjective.1 _
    84	      | bob => exact S.isProjective.2 _

    87	    exact (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one

    94	theorem sum_placeExtractedRegister_pauli_sq (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
    95	    ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))ᴴ *
    96	      S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h) = 1 := by
    97	  classical
    98	  have hlocal : ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (pauliProj W h)ᴴ * pauliProj W h = 1 := by
    99	    simp only [fun h => (posSemidef_pauliProj W h).isHermitian.eq,
   100	      pauliProj_mul_pauliProj, ite_true]
   101	    exact sum_pauliProj_eq_one W
   102	  have htensor {R : Type} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] :
   103	      ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliProj W h))ᴴ *
   104	        heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliProj W h) = 1 := by
   105	    simp only [MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   106	      heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, ← heteroKron_finset_sum_right, hlocal,
   107	      heteroKron_one_one]
   108	  cases side <;> apply sum_place_sq_eq_one <;> exact htensor

   110	/-- The entire conjugated total-Pauli family is square-complete; conjugation
   111	does not introduce a factor equal to the number of answers. -/
   112	theorem sum_conj_pauli_sq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   113	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   114	    ∑ h : PauliRegister P,
   115	      (conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   116	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))ᴴ *
   117	      conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   118	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)) = 1 := by
   119	  classical
   120	  let U := S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side)
   121	  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := S.placeSide_swap_left_unitary w side
   122	  have hU' : U * Uᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
   123	  have hterm (A : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   124	      (conjBy U A)ᴴ * conjBy U A = U * (Aᴴ * A) * Uᴴ := by
   125	    simp only [conjBy, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
   126	    calc
   127	      _ = U * (Aᴴ * (Uᴴ * U) * A) * Uᴴ := by noncomm_ring
   128	      _ = _ := by rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one]
   129	  change (∑ h, (conjBy U _)ᴴ * conjBy U _) = 1
   130	  simp_rw [hterm]
   131	  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum, S.sum_placePlayer_pauli_sq,
   132	    Matrix.mul_one, hU']
   133	
   134	/-- On any normalized ideal state the extraction measurement error is at
   135	most four, uniformly in the local dimensions and number of answers. -/
   136	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_le_four (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   137	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   138	    (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1) (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   139	    opFamilyDistSq (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
   140	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   141	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   142	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   143	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   144	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) ≤ 4 := by
   145	  apply opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four
   146	  · rw [S.idealExpState_norm, haux]
   147	  · intro _
   148	    exact (S.sum_conj_pauli_sq w side W).le
   149	  · intro _
   150	    exact (S.sum_placeExtractedRegister_pauli_sq side W).le

     5	# Finite-character estimates for extracted observables
     6	
     7	Parseval identifies the uniform average over field characters with the sum of
     8	squared outcome norms. A fixed binary basis character instead admits a bound
     9	by four times the consistency defect, using binary postprocessing.

    12

    14	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2, and paper
    15	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1542-1551`.
    16	They do not assert the preceding pulled-apart measurement comparison
    17	`eq:qld-pulling-cons`, which remains an obligation of issue #520.

    30	/-- Parseval for the fixed field trace, with a uniform character average and
    31	an unnormalized outcome sum. This specializes the orthogonality theorem used
    32	for blueprint `lem:qld-4-10`; no measurement assumptions are needed. -/
    33	theorem avg_norm_fixed_character_sum_sq {P : AdmissibleParams} {E : Type*}
    34	    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (v : PauliScalar P → E) :
    35	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P)) (fun r =>
    36	      ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) =
    37	      ∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 := by
    38	  classical
    39	  have horth (a b : PauliScalar P) :
    40	      ∑ r : PauliScalar P,
    41	        (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a))) *
    42	          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * b)) =
    43	        if a = b then ((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
    44	    simpa only [← Complex.star_def, star_phaseSign, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
    45	      sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter a b
    46	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum,
    47	    sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal _ _ horth v, ← mul_assoc,
    48	    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero), one_mul]

    52	identity supporting blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2. -/
    53	theorem avg_norm_basis_character_sum_sq {P : AdmissibleParams} {E : Type*}
    54	    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    55	    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) (v : PauliScalar P → E) :
    56	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P)) (fun r =>
    57	      ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) =
    58	      ∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 := by
    59	  classical
    60	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
    61	  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp
    62	    (Equiv.mulLeft₀ (P.model.basis j) (P.model.basis.ne_zero j))
    63	    (fun r => ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2)
    64	  change (∑ r, ‖∑ a,
    65	    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) = _ at hsum
    66	  rw [hsum]
    67	  exact (avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum _).symm.trans
    68	    (avg_norm_fixed_character_sum_sq v)

    70	/-- Regroup a field-weighted observable by its binary trace label. This is the
    71	postprocessing at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1547-1551`. -/
    72	theorem sum_basis_character_effect_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    73	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Measurement (PauliScalar P) ι)
    74	    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
    75	    (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • A.effect a) =
    76	      ∑ b : ZMod 2, phaseSign b •
    77	        (A.postprocess (fun a => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a))).effect b := by
    78	  classical
    79	  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    80	    (g := fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a))
    81	    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2))) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)]
    82	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    83	  intro b _
    84	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.smul_sum]
    85	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    86	  intro a ha
    87	  rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]

    89	/-- A fixed basis character costs at most four times the field measurement
    90	consistency defect. The question distribution and basis coordinate are retained
    91	exactly. This proves the final conversion in blueprint
    92	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, without assuming a bound on that defect. -/
    93	theorem basis_character_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
    94	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {X ιA ιB : Type*}
    95	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    96	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    97	    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement (PauliScalar P) ιA)
    98	    (B : X → Measurement (PauliScalar P) ιB)
    99	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
   100	    opDistSq μ
   101	      (fun x => heteroKron
   102	        (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • (A x).effect a) 1)
   103	      (fun x => heteroKron 1
   104	        (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • (B x).effect a)) ψ ≤
   105	      4 * consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   106	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) ψ := by
   107	  classical
   108	  let f := fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)
   109	  let A' := fun x => (A x).postprocess f
   110	  let B' := fun x => (B x).postprocess f
   111	  have hdef := consistencyDefect_postprocess_le μ A B ψ f
   112	  have hfam := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect μ
   113	    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A' x))
   114	    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B' x)) ψ).trans
   115	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdef (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   116	  have hobs := povm_to_obs_of_measurements μ
   117	    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A' x))
   118	    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B' x)) phaseSign norm_phaseSign ψ
   119	  simp only [ZMod.card, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hobs
   120	  have hbound := hobs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfam (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   121	  simpa only [sum_basis_character_effect_eq, heteroKron_left_sum_smul,
   122	    heteroKron_right_sum_smul, leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   123	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, ← mul_assoc, show (2 : ℝ) * 2 = 4 by norm_num]
   124	    using hbound

   126	/-- The final measurement-to-observable step of blueprint
   127	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2, on the original six-register state.
   128	The measurement consistency defect is an explicit quantity, not an assumed
   129	bound. Proving its construction-scale bound remains the obligation
   130	`eq:qld-pulling-cons` of issue #520. -/
   131	theorem tildeObs_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
   132	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
   133	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   134	    (W : PauliKind) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
   135	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   136	      (fun u => S.placeSide .alice (tildeObs w .alice W u j))
   137	      (fun u => S.placeSide .bob (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) S.psiHat ≤
   138	      4 * consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   139	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))
   140	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W u a)) S.psiHat := by
   141	  classical
   142	  let M (side : PlayerSide) (u : PauliRegister P) :
   143	      Measurement (PauliScalar P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
   144	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w side W u)
   145	      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w side W u a).nonneg) (sum_tildeM_eq_one w side W u)
   146	  let e := sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
   147	  have h := basis_character_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
   148	    (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P)) (M .alice) (M .bob)
   149	    (reindexState e S.psiHat) j
   150	  have hd : opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   151	      (fun u => heteroKron (tildeObs w .alice W u j) 1)
   152	      (fun u => heteroKron 1 (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
   153	      opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   154	        (fun u => S.placeSide .alice (tildeObs w .alice W u j))
   155	        (fun u => S.placeSide .bob (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) S.psiHat := by
   156	    unfold opDistSq opFamilyDistSq
   157	    simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
   158	    apply avgOver_congr
   159	    intro u
   160	    rw [norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState, reindexOp_sub]
   161	    rfl
   162	  have hc : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   163	      (fun u a => heteroKron (tildeM w .alice W u a) 1)
   164	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (tildeM w .bob W u a)) (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
   165	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   166	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))
   167	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W u a)) S.psiHat := by
   168	    unfold consistencyDefect
   169	    apply avgOver_congr
   170	    intro u
   171	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   172	    intro a _
   173	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   174	    intro b _
   175	    by_cases hab : a = b
   176	    · simp only [hab, if_true]
   177	    · simp only [if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
   178	      rw [stateQForm_reindexState, reindexOp_mul]
   179	      rfl
   180	  change opDistSq _ (fun u => heteroKron (tildeObs w .alice W u j) 1)
   181	    (fun u => heteroKron 1 (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) _ ≤
   182	      4 * consistencyDefect _ (fun u a => heteroKron (tildeM w .alice W u a) 1)
   183	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (tildeM w .bob W u a)) _ at h
   184	  rwa [hd, hc] at h

     4	/-!
     5	# Point overlaps for the difference-polynomial measurement
     6	
     7	Evaluation of the difference polynomial gives `g(u) - g_h(u)`. Unlike
     8	evaluation after decoding, this formula holds for every polynomial outcome.
     9	The resulting point overlaps are the ones supplied by the global witness.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1495-1545`,
    15	  especially `eq:qld-pulling-2b` and `eq:qld-pulling-12`.
    16	- The point-placement and convolution identities identify these overlaps with
    17	  the two consistency relations of the supplied global measurement.
    18	- Issue #520. These identities do not construct the global witness.
    19	-/

    21	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical

    23	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

    30	/-- Evaluation of the difference measurement is a convolution with the ideal
    31	Pauli point projectors. No encoding hypothesis on `g` is needed. -/
    32	theorem pullingMeas_eval_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    33	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    34	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    35	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    36	    ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a =
    37	      ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
    38	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u) (evalPoly g u - a)) := by
    39	  rw [pullingMeas, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
    40	  have heval (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) :
    41	      evalPoly (pullingPoly outcome) u =

     6	/-!
     7	# Polynomial outcomes in the pulling argument
     8	
     9	The joint measurement of a polynomial marginal and an ideal Pauli register
    10	returns the difference between the polynomial and the encoding of the register.
    11	Decoding this difference gives exactly the pulled-apart measurement. Polynomial
    12	collision estimates apply to these representatives without an encoding-support
    13	restriction on the original marginal.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1530-1605`,
    19	  `eq:qld-pulling-11`, `eq:qld-pulling-12`, and the following symmetry argument.
    20	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`; only decoder linearity and its
    21	  left-inverse identity are used here.
    22	- Issue #520; these auxiliary results do not assert `eq:qld-pulling-cons`.
    23	- The collision estimate compares unequal difference polynomials under uniform
    24	  evaluation.
    25	-/

    39	/-- The outcome `g - g_h` in `eq:qld-pulling-12` is a bounded polynomial
    40	representative, even when `g` is not in the encoding image. -/
    41	def pullingPoly {P : AdmissibleParams} (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) : Poly P :=
    42	  outcome.1 - encodingPoly outcome.2

    44	/-- Decoder linearity identifies the label in `eq:qld-pulling-12`. This uses
    45	`Dec(g_h) = h`, never the reverse identity on arbitrary polynomials. -/
    46	theorem decodeFq_pullingPoly {P : AdmissibleParams}
    47	    (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) :
    48	    decodeFq (pullingPoly outcome) = decodeFq outcome.1 - outcome.2 := by
    49	  have hsub (g h : Poly P) : decodeFq (g - h) = decodeFq g - decodeFq h := by
    50	    funext y
    51	    simp [decodeOn, decodeAt, evalPoly, MvPolynomial.eval_sub]
    52	  rw [pullingPoly, hsub, decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding]

    54	/-- Equal difference polynomials give identical scalar labels in the symmetric
    55	expression following `eq:qld-pulling-12`, for every register vector. -/
    56	theorem pulling_label_eq_of_poly_eq {P : AdmissibleParams}
    57	    (first second : Poly P × PauliRegister P)
    58	    (h : pullingPoly first = pullingPoly second) (u : PauliRegister P) :
    59	    dotProduct (decodeFq first.1 - first.2) u =
    60	      dotProduct (decodeFq second.1 - second.2) u := by
    61	  rw [← decodeFq_pullingPoly, ← decodeFq_pullingPoly, h]

   110	/-- The coordinate change to two extraction blocks preserves the consistency
   111	defect, including every off-diagonal outcome and the question distribution. -/
   112	private theorem consistencyDefect_placeSide_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   113	    {X A : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
   114	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (mu : Distribution X)
   115	    (left : X → A → Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace .alice)))
   116	    (right : X → A → Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace .bob))) :
   117	    consistencyDefect mu (fun x a => S.placeSide .alice (left x a))
   118	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .bob (right x a)) S.psiHat =
   119	      consistencyDefect mu (fun x a => heteroKron (left x a) 1)
   120	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (right x a))
   121	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) S.psiHat) := by
   122	  unfold consistencyDefect
   123	  apply avgOver_congr
   124	  intro x
   125	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   126	  intro a _
   127	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   128	  intro b _
   129	  by_cases hab : a = b
   130	  · simp only [hab, if_true]
   131	  · simp only [if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
   132	    rw [stateQForm_reindexState, reindexOp_mul]
   133	    rfl

   135	/-- Polynomial collision and deterministic decoding, before choosing a
   136	register placement. This separates the finite probability calculation from
   137	the six-register coordinate identities. -/
   138	private theorem polynomial_decoding_defect_le_evaluated_add {P : AdmissibleParams}
   139	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   140	    (A : Measurement (Poly P) I) (B : Measurement (Poly P) J)
   141	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) :
   142	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   143	        (fun u a => heteroKron
   144	          ((A.postprocess (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).effect a) 1)
   145	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1
   146	          ((B.postprocess (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).effect a)) psi ≤
   147	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   148	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   149	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi +
   150	          (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   151	  have hcollision := SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add
   152	    A B psi evalPoly ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hpsi
   153	    (by positivity) (fun g h hne => poly_eval_collision_le g h hne)
   154	  have hpost (u : PauliRegister P) := consistencyDefect_postprocess_le
   155	    (uniformDistribution Unit) (fun _ => A) (fun _ => B) psi
   156	    (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)
   157	  simp only [consistencyDefect, avgOver_uniform_const,
   158	    consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at hpost
   159	  simp only [consistencyDefect, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
   160	    placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
   161	  exact (avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpost).trans
   162	    ((avgOver_uniform_const _).le.trans hcollision)

   164	/-- The last polynomial-collision step of the pulling argument, followed by
   165	decoding. The field-measurement defect is bounded by the evaluated
   166	difference-polynomial defect plus exactly `m * d / q`.
   167	
   168	This is an unconditional comparison of two actual defects for the supplied
   169	measurement. Bounding the evaluated defect from the witness's point
   170	consistency remains the preceding steps of `eq:qld-pulling-cons`; no estimate
   171	for that defect is assumed here. The state and placements are the original
   172	six-register ones. -/
   173	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_pulling_eval_add {P : AdmissibleParams}
   174	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   175	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   176	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   177	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))
   178	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W u a)) S.psiHat ≤
   179	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   180	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
   181	          (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
   182	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
   183	          (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
   184	        S.psiHat + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   185	  classical
   186	  rw [consistencyDefect_placeSide_eq, consistencyDefect_placeSide_eq]

    26	/-- Place a complete measurement on its three-register extraction block. -/
    27	private def pullingPlacedMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    28	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (side : PlayerSide) {A : Type*} [Fintype A]
    29	    (M : Measurement A (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    30	    Measurement A (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
    31	  refine Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.placeSide side (M.effect a)) ?_ ?_
    32	  · intro a
    33	    cases side
    34	    · exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _
    35	        (kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    36	    · exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _
    37	        (kronecker_nonneg Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg (M.pos a))
    38	  · cases side
    39	    · rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one]
    40	      change reindexOp _ (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
    41	        (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
    42	      rw [heteroKron_one_one]
    43	      ext row col
    44	      simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply]
    45	    · rw [← S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one]
    46	      change reindexOp _ (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
    47	        (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
    48	      rw [heteroKron_one_one]
    49	      ext row col
    50	      simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply]

    58	/-- Placing a projective measurement on an extraction block preserves projectivity. -/
    59	private theorem pullingPlacedMeasurement_isProjective {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    60	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (side : PlayerSide) {A : Type*} [Fintype A]
    61	    (M : Measurement A (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)))
    62	    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    63	    Measurement.IsProjective (pullingPlacedMeasurement S side M) := by
    64	  classical
    65	  let e := sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
    66	  letI : DecidableEq (ExtractionRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
    67	    instDecidableEqProd
    68	  cases side
    69	  · have h := reindexMeasurement_isProjective e (leftPlacedMeasurement M)
    70	      (fun a => MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker (hM a)
    71	        (IsStarProjection.one _))
    72	    convert h using 1
    73	    rfl
    74	  · have h := reindexMeasurement_isProjective e (rightPlacedMeasurement M)
    75	      (fun a => MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker
    76	        (IsStarProjection.one _) (hM a))

    80	/-- The Alice evaluation defect is bounded by the supplied global consistency
    81	error, with no decoder correction or non-encoding mass term. -/
    82	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice {P : AdmissibleParams}
    83	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    84	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    85	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    86	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
    87	        (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
    88	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
    89	        deltaG := by
    90	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    91	  let pulled := fun u => pullingPlacedMeasurement S .alice
    92	    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    93	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
    94	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
    95	    ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    96	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
    97	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu pulled point S.psiHat
    98	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    99	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
   100	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   101	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a)
   102	      (fun u a => (point u).effect a) S.psiHat =
   103	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   104	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
   105	    rw [hp, hm]
   106	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
   107	    apply avgOver_congr
   108	    intro u
   109	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, pullingPlacedMeasurement_effect,
   110	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
   111	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice
   112	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
   113	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) = _
   114	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas]
   115	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
   116	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
   117	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .AA' W u
   118	        (fun a => S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))).symm

   124	/-- Bob's evaluation defect has the same bound, using the other consistency

   195	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   196	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   197	    rfl
   198	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   199	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   200	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   201	    rw [hsum] at hle
   202	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))
   203	
   204	
   205	
   206	end

     3	/-!
     4	# Point consistency with Alice's pulled-apart measurement
     5	
     6	This module proves the register-interchanged overlap calculation for Item 1 of
     7	blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`. Polynomial evaluation is replaced by
     8	decoded evaluation only on encoding outcomes; the remaining loss is bounded
     9	by the mass of the non-encoding outcomes.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1463-1492`.
    14	* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex` records the necessary restriction
    15	  on the decoder identity.

    18	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    19

    22	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

    26	
    27	namespace ProjectiveSetting
    28	
    29	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    30	
    31	/-- Placing a tensor with an identity on Alice's last register recovers `AA'`. -/
    32	theorem placeSide_alice_tensor_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    33	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
    34	    S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) = S.place .AA' B := by
    35	  ext row col
    36	  simp [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    37	    place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite]
    38	  split_ifs <;> rfl
    39	
    40	/-- The factors on `AA'A''` and `B` can be regrouped on `AA'` and `BA''`
    41	without exchanging registers or assuming symmetry of the strategy. -/
    42	theorem placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    43	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) (T : Op (PauliRegister P))
    44	    (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) :
    45	    S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron B T) * S.placePlayer .bob A =
    46	      S.place .AA' B * S.place .BA'' (heteroKron A T) := by
    47	  classical
    48	  ext row col
    49	  simp [placePlayer, placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron,
    50	    Matrix.kronecker, place, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    51	    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
    52	  split_ifs <;> ac_rfl
    53	
    54	/-- Alice's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
    55	theorem placeSide_alice_finset_sum (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    56	    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) :
    57	    S.placeSide .alice (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .alice (B i) := by
    58	  classical
    59	  change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    60	    (heteroKron (∑ i ∈ s, B i) (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = _
    61	  rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
    62	  ext row col
    63	  simp only [placeSide, reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    64	    Matrix.sum_apply]
    65	
    66	end ProjectiveSetting
    67	
    68	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point overlap is exactly the expanded-point overlap
    69	at the decoded value. This is the register-interchanged version of the first
    70	three lines of the calculation in paper lines 1483--1492. -/
    71	theorem sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap
    72	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    73	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
    74	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    75	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
    76	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) =
    77	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
    78	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
    79	          (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))) := by
    80	  classical
    81	  simp only [tildeM, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    82	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    83	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    84	  intro g _
    85	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    86	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum,
    87	    S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point consistency defect is one minus the decoded
    91	overlap. This uses completeness but no encoding restriction or mass estimate. -/
    92	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap'
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    94	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    95	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    96	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    97	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
    98	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    99	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   100	          (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   101	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   102	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   103	  classical
   104	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   105	    S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   106	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)
   107	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := fun u =>
   108	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   109	      (fun a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   110	      (fun a => by
   111	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   112	        exact kronecker_nonneg (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg
   113	          Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   114	      (by
   115	        rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   116	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   117	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   118	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   119	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   120	        ext row col
   121	        simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply])
   122	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   123	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) pulled point S.psiHat
   124	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   125	  change consistencyDefect _ _ _ S.psiHat = 1 - avgOver _ (fun u =>
   126	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   127	      (S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
   128	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) at h
   129	  refine h.trans ?_
   130	  congr 1
   131	  apply avgOver_congr
   132	  intro u
   133	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap,
   134	    stateQForm_finset_sum]
   135	
   136	open scoped Classical in
   137	/-- On Alice's marginal, replacing polynomial evaluation by decoded evaluation
   138	loses at most the non-encoding mass. This is the support-restricted version of
   139	the fourth line of paper lines 1483--1492, with the players interchanged. -/
   140	theorem marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding'
   141	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   142	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
   143	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   144	    (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   145	      (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   146	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)))) ≤
   147	      (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   148	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   149	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   150	            (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) +
   151	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   152	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   153	  classical
   154	  have hpos (g : Poly P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   155	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   156	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   157	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) :=
   158	    stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg .AA' .BA'' (by trivial)
   159	      ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).pos g) ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).pos a))
   160	  have hsum (g : Poly P) :
   161	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   162	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   163	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))) =
   164	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   165	    have hc : (∑ a : PauliScalar P,
   166	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) = 1 :=
   167	      (S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)).sum_eq_one
   168	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hc, mul_one]
   169	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   170	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   171	  intro g _
   172	  by_cases hg : IsEncoding g
   173	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   174	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   175	    rfl
   176	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   177	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   178	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   179	    rw [hsum] at hle
   180	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))
   181	
   182	
   183	
   184	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Real polynomial collision bounds
     6	
     7	The existing Schwartz–Zippel estimate for bounded polynomial representatives
     8	is expressed as a nonnegative rational cardinality ratio. This module converts
     9	it to the real uniform average used by the sandwich support comparison and
    10	specializes it to the polynomial outcomes of the Pauli basis test.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	* `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex`, `lem:schwartz-zippel`.
    15	* Blueprint `lem:schwartz-zippel-individual` and the collision calculation
    16	  preceding `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` in `sec:separating`.
    17	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`,
    18	  the consistency calculation in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` whose decoder
    19	  substitution requires the blueprint's nonencoding-mass estimate.
    20	* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`, for that substitution's scope.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    26	
    27	/-- Two distinct individual-degree-`d` polynomial representatives agree on at
    28	most an `m * d / |K|` fraction of field points, expressed as a real uniform
    29	average. This is the scalar collision estimate used before blueprint
    30	`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`, not the nonencoding-mass estimate itself.
    31	
    32	The field is finite and hence nonempty. No positive dimension, positive degree,
    33	or degree bound relative to the field size is required; representatives are
    34	not identified merely because their evaluations agree. -/
    35	theorem polyFunc_eval_collision_le {m d : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    36	    [DecidableEq K] (first second : polyFunc m K d) (hne : first ≠ second) :
    37	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
    38	      (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
    39	        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (m * d : ℝ) / Fintype.card K := by
    40	  have havg :
    41	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
    42	        (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
    43	          then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
    44	        (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) := by
    45	    rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter]
    46	    simp [polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    47	  rw [havg]
    48	  have hbound := schwartzZippel_individualDegree first second hne
    49	  have hreal : (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) ≤
    50	      ((((m * d : ℕ) : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card K) : ℝ) := by
    51	    exact_mod_cast hbound
    52	  simpa using hreal
    53	
    54	/-- The collision hypothesis for the sandwich support comparison on QPBT
    55	polynomial outcomes, with the field cardinality written as `P.q`.
    56	
    57	This specializes `polyFunc_eval_collision_le` to the fixed field model and
    58	`evalPoly`; it adds no assumptions to the admissible parameter domain of
    59	blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`. -/
    60	theorem poly_eval_collision_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
    61	    (first second : Poly P) (hne : first ≠ second) :
    62	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    63	      (fun point => if evalPoly first point = evalPoly second point then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
    64	        (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
    65	  have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
    66	    @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
    67	  unfold evalPoly
    68	  conv_rhs => rw [← hcard]
    69	  exact polyFunc_eval_collision_le first second hne
    70	
    71	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     3	/-! # Consistency under independent additive convolution
     4	
     5	Adding the outcomes of an independently perfectly correlated ancillary measurement
     6	pair preserves the consistency defect. The four register types are independent;
     7	`prodShuffle` places the two registers of each player next to one another.
     8	
     9	These are formalization-only auxiliary identities. Perfect ancillary correlation
    10	is a hypothesis of the generic result, to be proved for the Pauli measurements
    11	before applying it to the expanded point construction.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-438`,
    16	  the expanded state and the convolution formula for expanded point effects.
    17	- The same paper, `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`.
    18	- Blueprint `def:expanded-state` and `def:expanded-point-measurement`.
    19	- Issue #266; the ideal-point specialization is the separate issue #267.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    27	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    28	
    29	section Factorization
    30	
    31	variable {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    32	  [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    33	  [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    34	
    35	/-- Joint expectations factor after regrouping an independent pair of bipartite
    36	states by player. The shuffle sends `((i, j), (k, l))` to `((i, k), (j, l))`. -/
    37	theorem inner_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron
    38	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB))
    39	    (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) (R : Op κA) (T : Op κB) :
    40	    inner ℂ (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ))
    41	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (heteroKron A R) (heteroKron B T))
    42	          (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ))) =
    43	      inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron A B) ψ) *
    44	        inner ℂ φ (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron R T) φ) := by
    45	  simp only [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
    46	    EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
    47	  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    48	  rw [← (prodShuffle : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB) ≃ _).sum_comp]
    49	  simp_rw [← (prodShuffle : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB) ≃ _).sum_comp]
    50	  change (∑ p : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB), ∑ q : (ιA × ιB) × (κA × κB),
    51	    ((A p.1.1 q.1.1 * R p.2.1 q.2.1) * (B p.1.2 q.1.2 * T p.2.2 q.2.2) *
    52	      (ψ q.1 * φ q.2)) * star (ψ p.1 * φ p.2)) =
    53	    ∑ i : ιA × ιB, ∑ j : ιA × ιB, ∑ k : κA × κB, ∑ l : κA × κB,
    54	      ((A i.1 j.1 * B i.2 j.2 * ψ j) * star (ψ i)) *
    55	        ((R k.1 l.1 * T k.2 l.2 * φ l) * star (φ k))
    56	  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type (α₁ := ιA × ιB) (α₂ := κA × κB), star_mul]
    57	  conv_lhs =>
    58	    arg 2
    59	    ext i
    60	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    61	  congr! 4 with i j k l
    62	  ring
    63	
    64	/-- For positive ancillary effects, the real joint expectation factors on the
    65	shuffled tensor state. No normalization or positivity of `A` and `B` is needed. -/
    66	theorem stateQForm_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron
    67	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB))
    68	    (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) {R : Op κA} {T : Op κB}
    69	    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    70	    stateQForm (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ φ))
    71	        (heteroKron (heteroKron A R) (heteroKron B T)) =
    72	      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron A B) * stateQForm φ (heteroKron R T) := by
    73	  have hnonneg := (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    74	    (kronecker_nonneg hR hT)).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg φ.ofLp
    75	  have him : (inner ℂ φ (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron R T) φ)).im = 0 := by
    76	    simpa only [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
    77	      EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm, heteroKron] using
    78	      (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hnonneg).2.symm
    79	  simp only [stateQForm, inner_prodShuffle_vecTensor_heteroKron, Complex.mul_re,
    80	    him, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    81	
    82	end Factorization
    83	
    84	/-- An additive convolution of effect families can be indexed by the ancillary
    85	answer alone. This is the finite-fiber form of the expanded point construction. -/
    86	theorem sum_add_fiber_heteroKron {G ι κ : Type*}
    87	    [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] [AddCommGroup G]
    88	    (A : G → Op ι) (R : G → Op κ) (z : G) :
    89	    (∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : G × G => p.1 + p.2 = z),
    90	      heteroKron (A p.1) (R p.2)) =
    91	      ∑ c : G, heteroKron (A (z - c)) (R c) := by
    92	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    93	  simp only [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    94	
    95	/-- Averaging a common additive shift preserves the off-diagonal mass of any
    96	weight function. The ancillary joint weights are supported on the diagonal
    97	and have total diagonal mass one. -/
    98	private theorem sum_convolution_off_diagonal_eq {G : Type*}
    99	    [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] [AddCommGroup G]
   100	    (p q : G → G → ℝ) (hzero : ∀ c d, c ≠ d → q c d = 0)
   101	    (hdiag : ∑ c : G, q c c = 1) :
   102	    (∑ z : G, ∑ w : G, if z = w then 0 else
   103	      ∑ c : G, ∑ d : G, p (z - c) (w - d) * q c d) =
   104	      ∑ a : G, ∑ b : G, if a = b then 0 else p a b := by
   105	  have hinner (z w c : G) :
   106	      (∑ d : G, p (z - c) (w - d) * q c d) =
   107	        p (z - c) (w - c) * q c c := by
   108	    apply Finset.sum_eq_single c
   109	    · intro d _ hdc
   110	      rw [hzero c d hdc.symm, mul_zero]
   111	    · simp
   112	  have hshift (c : G) :
   113	      (∑ z : G, ∑ w : G, if z = w then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)) =
   114	        ∑ a : G, ∑ b : G, if a = b then 0 else p a b := by
   115	    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight c) _ _ fun z => ?_
   116	    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.subRight c) _ _ fun w => ?_
   117	    change (if z = w then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)) =
   118	      if z - c = w - c then 0 else p (z - c) (w - c)
   119	    simp only [sub_left_inj]

item.text: The state-extraction route is internally coherent so far: it transports one fixed nonzero basis character to the uniform Pauli average, obtains a genuine EPR projection bound without normalizing a zero vector, and handles the large-error branch with dimension-free completeness bounds. I’m moving to the algebraic conjugation formulas and the two point-consistency constructions, where an index/sign error would invalidate the later exact overlap identities even though Lean accepts the types.

     5	# Pauli basis test soundness interface
     6	
     7	This module contains the quantitative error function and the closed definitions
     8	used to state Pauli basis test soundness.  The carriers are concrete
     9	finite-dimensional vectors and matrices so that the soundness proof can use the
    10	existing Hilbert-space API without introducing a dependency cycle.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	The interface supports blueprint
    15	`thm:pauli`, with paper origin
    16	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
    17	The distance functionals use blueprint `def:state-distance` and
    18	`def:povm-distance`.
    19	-/

    24
