    30	/-- The Pauli-test error scale.  The argument order is `(a, b, ε, m, d, q)`;
    31	the powers are real `rpow`s and the asymptotic constants are absorbed into `a`,
    32	as specified by blueprint `thm:pauli`,
    33	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`).
    34	-/
    35	noncomputable def deltaQld (a b ε : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
    36	  a * Real.rpow ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) a *
    37	    (Real.rpow ε b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
    38	      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))
    39	
    40	/-- Monotonicity obligation for adjusting the universal constants in
    41	`deltaQld` on the source parameter domain. This Lean-only helper supports the
    42	enlargement of `a` and shrinkage of `b` for `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1` recorded in
    43	`rem:pauli-robustness-form` and stated as `lem:delta-qld-mono-support`,
    44	blueprint `ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex`; the source makes this constant adjustment
    45	at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1402`. It is
    46	not an additional hypothesis of `thm:pauli` or `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    47	theorem deltaQld_mono {P : AdmissibleParams} {a a' b b' ε : ℝ}
    48	    (ha0 : 1 ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b' ≤ b) (hb' : 0 < b')
    49	    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    50	    deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q ≤ deltaQld a' b' ε P.m P.d P.q := by
    51	  have hmd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    52	    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
    53	  have hmd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith
    54	  have hq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (P.q : ℝ) := by
    55	    obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := P.hq
    56	    rw [hk]
    57	    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
    58	  unfold deltaQld
    59	  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow]
    60	  have h1 : ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ a ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ a' :=
    61	    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hmd ha
    62	  have h2 : ε ^ b ≤ ε ^ b' := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hε0 hε1 hb'.le hb
    63	  have h3 : (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) ≤ (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b') :=
    64	    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hq (neg_le_neg hb)
    65	  have h4 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
    66	      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b' * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
    67	    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    68	      (neg_le_neg (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb hmd0))
    69	  have hsum : 0 ≤ ε ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) +
    70	      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
    71	    have := Real.rpow_nonneg hε0 b
    72	    have := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg P.q) (-b)
    73	    have := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
    74	      (-(b * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)))

    76	  exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ha h1 (Real.rpow_nonneg hmd0 a) (by linarith))
    77	    (add_le_add (add_le_add h2 h3) h4) hsum
    78	    (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg hmd0 a'))

    80	/-- The ideal auxiliary state `aux ⊗ EPR_q^{⊗M}` in the shuffled register
    81	ordering.  The EPR factor is the concrete `eprState` from blueprint
    82	`def:EPR`; paper
    83	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:946-955`).
    84	-/
    85	noncomputable def idealState (P : AdmissibleParams)
    86	    {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
    87	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
    88	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × ιB')) :
    89	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ιA' × PauliRegister P) × (ιB' × PauliRegister P)) :=
    90	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((ιA' × PauliRegister P) ×
    91	      (ιB' × PauliRegister P)) ℂ).symm
    92	    (fun p =>
    93	      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA' × ιB') ℂ) aux (p.1.1, p.2.1)) *
    94	        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P) ℂ)
    95	          (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (p.1.2, p.2.2)))
    96	
    97	/-- The A-side ideal Pauli projector, with identities on the auxiliary and
    98	B-side registers.  This is a concrete matrix form of the operator comparison
    99	in blueprint `thm:pauli`; paper
   100	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`).
   101	-/
   102	noncomputable def pauliProjOnA'' (P : AdmissibleParams)
   103	    {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   104	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB'] (W : PauliKind)
   105	    (u : PauliRegister P) :
   106	    Op ((ιA' × PauliRegister P) × (ιB' × PauliRegister P)) :=
   107	  fun p q =>
   108	    if p.1.1 = q.1.1 ∧ p.2 = q.2 then
   109	      pauliProj W u p.1.2 q.1.2
   110	    else 0
   111	
   112	/-- The symmetric B-side ideal Pauli projector from blueprint
   113	`thm:pauli`, paper origin
   114	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
   115	-/
   116	noncomputable def pauliProjOnB'' (P : AdmissibleParams)
   117	    {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   118	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB'] (W : PauliKind)
   119	    (u : PauliRegister P) :
   120	    Op ((ιA' × PauliRegister P) × (ιB' × PauliRegister P)) :=
   121	  fun p q =>
   122	    if p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2.1 = q.2.1 then
   123	      pauliProj W u p.2.2 q.2.2
   124	    else 0
   125	
   126	/-- Lift a conjugated A-side effect to the full ideal register in blueprint
   127	`thm:pauli`, paper origin
   128	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
   129	-/
   130	noncomputable def liftedAEffect {P : AdmissibleParams} {G : Game}
   131	    (S : Strategy G) {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   132	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
   133	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
   134	      EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × PauliRegister P))
   135	    (M : Op S.ιA) :
   136	    Op ((ιA' × PauliRegister P) × (ιB' × PauliRegister P)) :=
   137	  fun p q =>
   138	    if p.2 = q.2 then
   139	      (conjIsometry φA M) p.1 q.1
   140	    else 0
   141	
   142	/-- Lift a conjugated B-side effect to the full ideal register in blueprint
   143	`thm:pauli`, paper origin
   144	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
   145	-/
   146	noncomputable def liftedBEffect {P : AdmissibleParams} {G : Game}
   147	    (S : Strategy G) {ιA' ιB' : Type*} [Fintype ιA'] [DecidableEq ιA']
   148	    [Fintype ιB'] [DecidableEq ιB']
   149	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
   150	      EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × PauliRegister P))
   151	    (M : Op S.ιB) :
   152	    Op ((ιA' × PauliRegister P) × (ιB' × PauliRegister P)) :=
   153	  fun p q =>
   154	    if p.1 = q.1 then
   155	      (conjIsometry φB M) p.2 q.2
   156	    else 0
   157	
   158	/-- A finite witness packaging the auxiliary dimensions, isometries, and state
   159	from `thm:pauli`.  This structure is a Lean-only encoding of the existential
   160	data in the paper theorem; it introduces no extra hypothesis.  Blueprint
   161	`thm:pauli`, paper origin
   162	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
   163	-/
   164	structure PauliSoundnessWitness (P : AdmissibleParams)
   165	    (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P)) where
   166	  ιA' : Type
   167	  ιB' : Type
   168	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA']
   169	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB']
   170	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA']
   171	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB']
   172	  φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
   173	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × PauliRegister P)
   174	  φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
   175	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × PauliRegister P)
   176	  aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × ιB')
   177	  aux_norm : ‖aux‖ = 1
   178	
   179	attribute [instance] PauliSoundnessWitness.ιAFintype PauliSoundnessWitness.ιBFintype
   180	  PauliSoundnessWitness.ιADecidableEq PauliSoundnessWitness.ιBDecidableEq
   181	
   182	/-- The A-side operator-distance quantity appearing in the soundness
   183	conclusion.  It is the finite-sum realization of `def:povm-distance` from
   184	`def:povm-distance`, paper origin
   185	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`.
   186	-/
   187	noncomputable def pauliOperatorDistanceA
   188	    (P : AdmissibleParams) (S : Strategy (pauliBasisTest P))
   189	    (w : PauliSoundnessWitness P S) (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=

   194	
   195	/-- The symmetric B-side operator-distance quantity from blueprint
   196	`def:povm-distance`, paper origin
   197	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`.
   198	-/

   203	      ‖applyOperatorToState (liftedBEffect S w.φB
   204	        (((S.B (pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess pauliAnswerOrZero).effect u) -
   205	      pauliProjOnB'' P W u) (idealState P w.aux)‖ ^ 2
   206	
   207	end

    39	/-- The binary character used for generalized Pauli phases; see

    42	It is public because the Fourier expansion declarations below expose this

    44	noncomputable def phaseSign (t : ZMod 2) : ℂ :=

    47	/-- Formalization-only expansion of a sum over the binary field into its two
    48	terms. -/
    49	theorem sum_zmod_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ZMod 2 → M) :
    50	    ∑ b, f b = f 0 + f 1 := by
    51	  calc
    52	    ∑ b, f b = ∑ i : Fin 2, f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 i) := by
    53	      exact Fintype.sum_equiv (ZMod.finEquiv 2).symm f
    54	        (fun i : Fin 2 => f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 i)) (fun _ => rfl)
    55	    _ = f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 0) + f (ZMod.finEquiv 2 1) := Fin.sum_univ_two _
    56	    _ = f 0 + f 1 := by rfl

    58	/-- Formalization-only case split for the binary field: every element is zero
    59	or one. -/
    60	theorem zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (b : ZMod 2) : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by
    61	  by_cases hb : b = 0
    62	  · exact Or.inl hb
    63	  · right
    64	    have hval_ne : b.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_ne_zero b).mpr hb
    65	    have hval_lt : b.val < 2 := ZMod.val_lt b
    66	    have hval : b.val = 1 := by omega
    67	    exact (ZMod.val_eq_one (by omega) b).mp hval
    68	
    69	/-- In characteristic two, the standard additive character is the sign
    70	character used by the binary Pauli definitions. -/
    71	theorem phaseSign_eq_ffChar (t : ZMod 2) :
    72	    phaseSign t = ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2) t := by
    73	  by_cases ht : t = 0
    74	  · subst t
    75	    rw [phaseSign, if_pos rfl]
    76	    exact (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2)).map_zero_eq_one.symm
    77	  · have hval : t.val = 1 := by
    78	      have hval_ne : t.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_ne_zero t).mpr ht
    79	      have hval_lt : t.val < 2 := ZMod.val_lt t
    80	      omega
    81	    have ht_one : t = 1 := (ZMod.val_eq_one (by omega) t).mp hval
    82	    subst t
    83	    rw [phaseSign, if_neg one_ne_zero]
    84	    change (-1 : ℂ) = ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2) ((1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2)
    85	    rw [ZMod.stdAddChar_coe]
    86	    convert Complex.exp_pi_mul_I.symm using 1
    87	    all_goals ring_nf

    93	theorem phaseSign_add (s t : ZMod 2) :
    94	    phaseSign (s + t) = phaseSign s * phaseSign t := by
    95	  rw [phaseSign_eq_ffChar, phaseSign_eq_ffChar, phaseSign_eq_ffChar]
    96	  exact (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2)).map_add_eq_mul s t

    48	structure ExtractionWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaS : ℝ}
    49	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaS)
    50	    (delta : ℝ) where
    51	  /-- Each swap map is a right unitary. -/
    52	  swap_right_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,
    53	    swapUnitary w side * (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1
    54	  /-- Each swap map is a left unitary. -/
    55	  swap_left_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,
    56	    (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ * swapUnitary w side = 1
    57	  /-- The auxiliary state on registers `AA'BB'`. -/
    58	  aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    59	    (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    60	  /-- The auxiliary state is normalized. -/
    61	  aux_norm : ‖aux‖ = 1
    62	  /-- Applying both concrete swap maps to the expanded state extracts the ideal
    63	  auxiliary-state/EPR tensor product. -/
    64	  state_close :
    65	    ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
    66	        S.idealExpState aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta
    67	  /-- On the ideal extracted state, conjugated total-Pauli effects are close to
    68	  the canonical projectors, for both players and both Pauli bases. -/
    69	  pauli_close : ∀ (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind),
    70	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
    71	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
    72	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
    73	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    74	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
    75	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))
    76	      (S.idealExpState aux) ≤ delta

  1267	\begin{lemma}\label{lem:qld-4-7}
  1268	There exists a function $\delta_S(\eps,m,d,q) = a(md)^a (\eps^b + q^{-b} + 2^{-bmd})$ for some universal constants $a > 1, 0 < b < 1$ such that the following holds. For $\mH \in \{\mH_\alice,\mH_\bob\}$ there exists a projective measurement $\{ \hat{S}_{g_\xpt,g_\zpt} \}$ acting on $\mathcal{H} \otimes (\C^q)^{\otimes \nqubits}$ with outcomes consisting of pairs $(g_\xpt,g_\zpt)$ of polynomials each in $\ideg_{d,m}(\F_q)$ such that for $W \in \{X,Z\}$, on average over uniformly random $u \in \F_q^m$,
  1269	\begin{align}
  1270	  (\hat{S}_{[\eval_{u}(\cdot_{W}) = a]})_{\alice \alice'} &\simeq_{\delta_S} (\hat{M}^{(\Point, W), u}_{a})_{\bob \alice''} \label{eq:qld-s-point-con-alice} \\ 
  1271	    (\hat{S}_{[\eval_{u}(\cdot_{W}) = a]})_{\bob \bob'} &\simeq_{\delta_S} (\hat{M}^{(\Point, W), u}_{a})_{\alice \bob''} \label{eq:qld-s-point-con-bob},
  1272	\end{align}
  1273	where the notation $\eval_{u}(\cdot_W)$ means the evaluation of the first outcome $g_X$ of $\hat{S}$ if $W = X$, or the second outcome $g_Z$ if $W = Z$, at the point $u$.
  1274	\end{lemma}

  1280	        for the classical low-degree test $\game^\ld_\ldparams$ for
  1281	        $\ldparams = (q,2m + 2,d, 1)$, with value $1 -
  1282	        \delta_{\combine}$. This strategy is not necessarily projective because the measurement $\{\hat{Q}^{\line}_f\}$ is not guaranteed to be; however, we may projectivize it by applying Naimark's theorem to this measurement. This preserves the consistency ($\simeq$) relation obtained as the conclusion of \Cref{lem:qld-4-13}. Theorem~\ref{lem:ld-soundness} applied to this projectivized strategy implies the
  1283	        existence of a POVM $\{ \hat{S}_g \}$ with

   546	\begin{lemma}[Pauli comparison after a change of state]
   547	  \label{lem:qld-pauli-overlap-state-transfer}

   554	  $\vartheta$ and $\Phi$ be unit vectors on the associated bipartite space.
   555	  Write
   556	  \[
   557	    E_{A,B}(\vartheta)=\mathbb E_u\sum_a
   558	      \langle\vartheta,A_{[g_h(u)=a]}\ot B_{[g_h(u)=a]}\vartheta\rangle.

   567	  $\mathcal H_A\ot\mathbb C^{q^M}$, take $B$ to be the canonical Pauli
   568	  projectors on $\mathcal H_B\ot\mathbb C^{q^M}$, and set
   569	  $\Delta=\mathrm{aux}\ot\mathrm{EPR}_q^{\ot M}$ in local player order for a

   663			\delta_G=a(md)^a\bigl(\eps^b+q^{-b}+2^{-bmd}\bigr),

   668		$a'\geq1$ and $0<b'<1$, depending only on $C,a,b$, such that, for every
   669		admissible $(q,m,d)$ and every $0\leq\eps\leq1$,

   684			\delta_G^{1/4}\leq HR,\qquad

   701		In the source proof of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-unitary}, the triangle inequality gives $\| H_X \ket{\vartheta} - H_Z \ket{\vartheta} \| \leq \| (\Id - H_X)\ket{\vartheta} \| + \| (\Id - H_Z)\ket{\vartheta} \| \leq 2\sqrt{\delta_P}$, so that $\| H_X \ket{\vartheta} - H_Z \ket{\vartheta} \|^2 \leq 4\delta_P$; the source instead asserts the bound $2\sqrt{\delta_P}$ for the \emph{squared} norm, which holds only when $\sqrt{\delta_P} \leq 1/2$, and consequently carries the term $\sqrt{\delta_P}$ into an overlap bound of $1 - 2\delta_P - \sqrt{\delta_P}$.    206	end

    31	/-- Placing a tensor with an identity on Alice's last register recovers `AA'`. -/
    32	theorem placeSide_alice_tensor_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    33	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
    34	    S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron B (1 : Op (PauliRegister P))) = S.place .AA' B := by
    35	  ext row col
    36	  simp [placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    37	    place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite]
    38	  split_ifs <;> rfl
    39	
    40	/-- The factors on `AA'A''` and `B` can be regrouped on `AA'` and `BA''`
    41	without exchanging registers or assuming symmetry of the strategy. -/
    42	theorem placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    43	    (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) (T : Op (PauliRegister P))
    44	    (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) :
    45	    S.placeSide .alice (heteroKron B T) * S.placePlayer .bob A =
    46	      S.place .AA' B * S.place .BA'' (heteroKron A T) := by
    47	  classical
    48	  ext row col
    49	  simp [placePlayer, placeSide, sixRegExtractionEquiv, reindexOp, heteroKron,
    50	    Matrix.kronecker, place, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    51	    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
    52	  split_ifs <;> ac_rfl
    53	
    54	/-- Alice's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
    55	theorem placeSide_alice_finset_sum (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    56	    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) :
    57	    S.placeSide .alice (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .alice (B i) := by
    58	  classical
    59	  change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    60	    (heteroKron (∑ i ∈ s, B i) (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = _
    61	  rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
    62	  ext row col
    63	  simp only [placeSide, reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    64	    Matrix.sum_apply]
    65	
    66	end ProjectiveSetting
    67	
    68	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point overlap is exactly the expanded-point overlap
    69	at the decoded value. This is the register-interchanged version of the first
    70	three lines of the calculation in paper lines 1483--1492. -/
    71	theorem sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap
    72	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    73	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
    74	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    75	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
    76	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) =
    77	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
    78	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
    79	          (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))) := by
    80	  classical
    81	  simp only [tildeM, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    82	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    83	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    84	  intro g _
    85	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    86	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum,
    87	    S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	/-- The Alice-pulled/Bob-point consistency defect is one minus the decoded
    91	overlap. This uses completeness but no encoding restriction or mass estimate. -/
    92	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap'
    93	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    94	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    95	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    96	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    97	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
    98	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    99	        ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   100	          (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   101	            S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   102	              (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) := by
   103	  classical
   104	  let point := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
   105	    S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   106	  let pulled : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) → Measurement (PauliScalar P)
   107	      (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := fun u =>
   108	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne
   109	      (fun a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   110	      (fun a => by
   111	        apply ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg
   112	        exact kronecker_nonneg (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg
   113	          Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   114	      (by
   115	        rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_eq_one]
   116	        change reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   117	          (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   118	            (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
   119	        rw [heteroKron_one_one]
   120	        ext row col
   121	        simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply])
   122	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   123	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) pulled point S.psiHat
   124	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   125	  change consistencyDefect _ _ _ S.psiHat = 1 - avgOver _ (fun u =>
   126	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   127	      (S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a) *
   128	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) at h
   129	  refine h.trans ?_
   130	  congr 1
   131	  apply avgOver_congr
   132	  intro u
   133	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_tildeM_mul_pointMeas_eq_decoded_overlap,
   134	    stateQForm_finset_sum]
   135	
   136	open scoped Classical in
   137	/-- On Alice's marginal, replacing polynomial evaluation by decoded evaluation
   138	loses at most the non-encoding mass. This is the support-restricted version of
   139	the fourth line of paper lines 1483--1492, with the players interchanged. -/
   140	theorem marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding'
   141	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   142	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind)
   143	    (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   144	    (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   145	      (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   146	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)))) ≤
   147	      (∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   148	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   149	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect
   150	            (dotProduct (decodeFq g) (indicatorVec u))))) +
   151	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
   152	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   153	  classical
   154	  have hpos (g : Poly P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
   155	      0 ≤ stateQForm S.psiHat
   156	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   157	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) :=
   158	    stateQForm_nonneg _ (S.place_mul_place_nonneg .AA' .BA'' (by trivial)
   159	      ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).pos g) ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).pos a))
   160	  have hsum (g : Poly P) :
   161	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
   162	        (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
   163	          S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))) =
   164	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by
   165	    have hc : (∑ a : PauliScalar P,
   166	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) = 1 :=
   167	      (S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)).sum_eq_one
   168	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hc, mul_one]
   169	  rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   170	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   171	  intro g _
   172	  by_cases hg : IsEncoding g
   173	  · simp only [hg, not_true_eq_false, if_false, add_zero]
   174	    rw [decodeFq_dotProduct_indicatorVec hg u]
   175	    rfl
   176	  · simp only [hg, not_false_eq_true, if_true]
   177	    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => hpos g a)
   178	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
   179	    rw [hsum] at hle
   180	    exact hle.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hpos g _))
   181	
   182	
   183	
   184	end

    25	noncomputable section

    27	/-- For a supplied global polynomial-pair witness, the pulled-apart defect is

    30	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`, supporting blueprint

    33	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`. -/
    34	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_deltaG_add_nonencoding
    35	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    36	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    37	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    38	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))

    40	      deltaG + nonencodingMarginalMass w .bob W := by
    41	  classical
    42	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    43	  let evaluated := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
    44	    S.placedMeasurement .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
    45	      (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))
    46	  let expanded := fun u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P =>
    47	    S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
    48	  have hdefect := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu evaluated expanded S.psiHat
    49	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    50	  have hw := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
    51	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (evaluated u).effect a)
    52	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hw
    53	  rw [hdefect] at hw
    54	  have hregroup (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    55	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
    56	        ((evaluated u).effect a * (expanded u).effect a)) =
    57	      ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
    58	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    59	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
    60	            (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))) := by
    61	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
    62	    change stateQForm S.psiHat
    63	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.place .BB'
    64	        (((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
    65	          (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)).effect a) *
    66	            S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) = _
    67	    exact (congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
    68	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
    69	        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)))).trans
    70	      (stateQForm_finset_sum _ _ _)
    71	  simp only [hregroup] at hw
    72	  have hcompare := avgOver_mono mu _ _
    73	    (fun u => marginal_eval_overlap_le_decoded_add_nonencoding w W u)
    74	  rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_const_of_isProbability mu
    75	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at hcompare

    77	      ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
    78	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g)) := by
    79	    unfold nonencodingMarginalMass
    80	    simp only [S.placeSide_bob_tensor_one]
    81	    rfl
    82	  rw [← hmass_eq] at hcompare
    83	  rw [tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap]
    84	  dsimp only [mu] at hw hcompare
    85	  linarith

    93	The source reuses `deltaS` after absorbing the non-encoding and game-error

    96	
    97	The encoding-supported reference and Schwartz--Zippel estimates in

   104	Elimination: discharge the construction required by

   111	          ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
   112	            (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind),

   124	  intro P epsilon deltaG hepsilon _ hdeltaG S w W

   168	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm

   172	  rw [hdefect] at hw

   175	        ((evaluated u).effect a * (expanded u).effect a)) =
   176	      ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat

     9	# Consistency with encoding-supported reference measurements
    10	
    11	The Pauli-basis check remains a consistency estimate after adjoining the
    12	perfectly correlated ideal point measurement. Schwartz-Zippel then controls
    13	mass outside the encoding image by evaluated reference inconsistency.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	- Blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`.

    19	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
    20	- The reference measurements and comparison estimates express the convolution
    21	  with the ideal Pauli point projectors.
    22	- These are auxiliary estimates for a supplied witness, not its construction.

    35	/-- For commuting families, reversing the order of the measurements preserves
    36	the consistency defect. This is finite-sum algebra for opposite placements. -/
    37	theorem consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute {X A I : Type*}
    38	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    39	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (mu : Distribution X)
    40	    (first second : X → A → Op I) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I)
    41	    (hcomm : ∀ x a b, first x a * second x b = second x b * first x a) :
    42	    consistencyDefect mu first second psi = consistencyDefect mu second first psi := by
    43	  unfold consistencyDefect
    44	  apply avgOver_congr
    45	  intro x
    46	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    47	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    48	  intro b _
    49	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    50	  intro a _
    51	  simp only [hcomm x a b, eq_comm]

    53	/-- A polynomial measurement's mass outside the encoding image is at most
    54	its evaluated inconsistency with an encoding-supported reference, plus `md/q`.
    55	This is the Schwartz-Zippel step in blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`.
    56	The reference support is explicit because this auxiliary applies to any POVM;
    57	the concrete reference above proves it without an additional strategy premise. -/
    58	theorem mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}
    59	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    60	    (meas : Measurement (Poly P) I) (reference : Measurement (Poly P) J)
    61	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
    62	    (hsupport : ∀ g, ¬ IsEncoding g → reference.effect g = 0) :
    63	    (∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Poly P => ¬ IsEncoding g),
    64	      stateQForm psi (heteroKron (meas.effect g) 1)) ≤
    65	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    66	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((meas.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
    67	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((reference.postprocess
    68	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
    69	  classical
    70	  have hmass := mass_outside_support_le_point_defect meas reference psi
    71	    (Finset.univ.filter IsEncoding) (by simpa using hsupport)
    72	  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hmass
    73	  have hcollision := SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add
    74	    meas reference psi evalPoly ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hpsi
    75	    (by positivity) poly_eval_collision_le
    76	  refine hmass.trans (hcollision.trans_eq ?_)
    77	  rw [SandwichProduct.consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point]

    87	        (heteroKron (tauPointProj W u a) (tauPointProj W u b))) = 0 := by

    90	  simpa only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,

    92	    sum_tauPointProj_pair_stateQForm_eprState, sub_self] using h

    94	/-- Adjoining the ideal point outcomes preserves the Pauli-basis check on the
    95	two-player expanded state, in the point--Pauli orientation. -/
    96	theorem point_encodingPauli_consistency_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    97	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
    98	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    99	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   100	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
   101	          (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) =
   102	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   103	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   104	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a))
   105	        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
   106	  have h := consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect
   107	    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   108	    (S.pointMeas .alice W) (S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W)
   109	    (tauPointMeas W) (tauPointMeas W) S.toStrategy.ψ
   110	    (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
   111	    (tauPoint_offDiagonal_eq_zero W)
   112	  simpa only [pointMeasExp, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, expPointOp_eq_convolution,
   113	    encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution, tauPointMeas,
   114	    ExtendedLineGame.pairState] using h

   163	theorem right_mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect {P : AdmissibleParams}

   182	/-- Both evaluated global marginals are consistent with the opposite

   186	theorem global_marginal_encoding_consistency :
   187	    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon deltaG : ℝ),
   188	      0 ≤ epsilon → ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
   189	        (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind),
   190	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))

   192	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   193	          (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((S.encodingPauliMeas .bob W).postprocess
   194	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) ≤
   195	        deltaG + C * Real.sqrt epsilon ∧

   197	          (fun u a => heteroKron (((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess
   198	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   199	          (fun u a => heteroKron 1 (((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess
   200	            (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) (ExtendedLineGame.pairState S) ≤
   201	        deltaG + C * Real.sqrt epsilon := by

   203	  obtain ⟨C2, hC2, hreverse⟩ := WinImplications.win_pauli_basis_cons_interchanged_proof

   243	        (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi ≤ deltaG

   245	      consistencyDefect_comm_of_commute _ _ _ _ (by
   246	        intro u a b
   247	        exact S.place_comm .AB'' .BB' trivial _ _)]

   259	      intro u a b

   265	      (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a) 1)

   274	      intro u a b
   275	      exact (WinImplications.heteroKron_left_right_comm _ _).symm)]
   276	    change consistencyDefect mu
   277	      (fun u a => heteroKron (((S.encodingPauliMeas .alice W).postprocess
   278	        (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   279	      (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a)) psi ≤ _

   297	      intro u a b

   137	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
   138	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB'
   139	    ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   140	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
   141	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu point pulled S.psiHat
   142	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   143	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
   144	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   145	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (point u).effect a)
   146	      (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a) S.psiHat =
   147	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   148	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
   149	    rw [hp, hm]
   150	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
   151	    apply avgOver_congr
   152	    intro u
   153	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, pullingPlacedMeasurement_effect,
   154	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
   155	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat
   156	      (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) * S.placeSide .bob
   157	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))) = _
   158	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval]
   159	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
   160	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
   161	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
   162	        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))).symm
   163	  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
   164	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   165	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
   166	  exact heq.le.trans hbound
   167	
   168	/-- Tensoring the strategy state with the two normalized EPR states preserves
   169	the point-measurement consistency defect. This is the six-register form of
   170	the point self-consistency used at `eq:qld-pulling-3`. -/
   171	theorem point_consistencyDefect_psiHat {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   172	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
   173	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   174	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   175	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
   176	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   177	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   178	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.toStrategy.ψ := by
   179	  classical
   180	  have htransfer (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) (B : Op S.toStrategy.ιB)
   181	      (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
   182	      stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placePlayer .alice A * S.placePlayer .bob B) =
   183	        stateQForm S.toStrategy.ψ (heteroKron A 1 * heteroKron 1 B) := by
   184	    letI : DecidableEq (((S.toStrategy.ιA × S.toStrategy.ιB) ×
   185	        (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)) × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)) :=
   186	      instDecidableEqProd
   187	    have hAB := heteroKron_isHermitian A B hA hB
   188	    rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
   189	    change stateQForm S.psiHat
   190	      (S.place .AA' (heteroKron A 1) * S.place .BB' (heteroKron B 1)) = _
   191	    rw [S.psiHat_eq_reindexState, WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState,
   192	      WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, S.reindexOp_sixRegShuffle_place_AA'_heteroKron,
   193	      S.reindexOp_sixRegShuffle_place_BB'_heteroKron]
   194	    simp only [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, heteroKron_one_one]
   195	    rw [stateQForm_vecTensor_heteroKron _ _ _ _
   196	      (heteroKron_isHermitian _ _ hAB Matrix.isHermitian_one) Matrix.isHermitian_one,
   197	      stateQForm_vecTensor_heteroKron _ _ _ _ hAB Matrix.isHermitian_one,
   198	      stateQForm_one_eq_norm_sq, eprState_norm]
   199	    ring
   200	  unfold consistencyDefect
   201	  apply avgOver_congr
   202	  intro u
   203	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   204	  intro a _
   205	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   206	  intro b _
   207	  by_cases hab : a = b
   208	  · simp only [hab, if_true]
   209	  · simp only [if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
   210	    exact htransfer _ _
   211	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).pos a)).isHermitian
   212	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).pos b)).isHermitian
   213	
   214	/-- The evaluated difference-polynomial measurements are self-consistent.
   215	Agreement and two squared-distance triangle inequalities combine the two
   216	opposite-player comparisons with the original point self-consistency.
   217	The error is linear in the supplied witness error, as required before
   218	the collision step `eq:qld-pulling-12`. -/
   219	theorem pullingMeas_eval_consistencyDefect_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
   220	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   221	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   222	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   223	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
   224	          (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
   225	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
   226	          (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
   227	        S.psiHat ≤ 12 * deltaG + 8 * (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon := by
   228	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   229	  let A := fun u => pullingPlacedMeasurement S .alice
   230	    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   231	  let B := fun u => pullingPlacedMeasurement S .bob
   232	    ((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   233	  let PA := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
   234	    (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
   235	  let PB := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB'
   236	    (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
   237	  have hA := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu A PB S.psiHat).trans
   238	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice w W)
   239	      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   240	  have hB := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu PA B S.psiHat).trans
   241	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_bob w W)
   242	      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   243	  have hpoint : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (PA u).effect a)
   244	      (fun u a => (PB u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ (Fintype.card PauliEdge : ℝ) * epsilon := by
   245	    change consistencyDefect mu
   246	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   247	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤ _
   248	    rw [point_consistencyDefect_psiHat]
   249	    exact point_self_consistency_le S W
   250	  have hP := (opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect mu PA PB S.psiHat).trans
   251	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   252	  rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm] at hP
   253	  have hAP := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le mu _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hA hP
   254	  have hAB := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le mu _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hAP hB
   255	  have hproj (side : PlayerSide) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   256	      Measurement.IsProjective (pullingPlacedMeasurement S side
   257	        ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))) :=
   258	    pullingPlacedMeasurement_isProjective S side _
   259	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective _ (pullingMeas_isProjective w side W) _)
   260	  have hdef := consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective mu A B S.psiHat
   261	    (hproj .alice) (hproj .bob)
   262	  exact hdef.trans (hAB.trans (by ring_nf; rfl))
   263	
   264	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Point overlaps for the difference-polynomial measurement
     6	
     7	Evaluation of the difference polynomial gives `g(u) - g_h(u)`. Unlike
     8	evaluation after decoding, this formula holds for every polynomial outcome.
     9	The resulting point overlaps are the ones supplied by the global witness.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1495-1545`,
    15	  especially `eq:qld-pulling-2b` and `eq:qld-pulling-12`.
    16	- The point-placement and convolution identities identify these overlaps with
    17	  the two consistency relations of the supplied global measurement.
    18	- Issue #520. These identities do not construct the global witness.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    26	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	/-- Evaluation of the difference measurement is a convolution with the ideal
    31	Pauli point projectors. No encoding hypothesis on `g` is needed. -/
    32	theorem pullingMeas_eval_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    33	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    34	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    35	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    36	    ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a =
    37	      ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
    38	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u) (evalPoly g u - a)) := by
    39	  rw [pullingMeas, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
    40	  have heval (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) :
    41	      evalPoly (pullingPoly outcome) u =
    42	        evalPoly outcome.1 u - dotProduct outcome.2 (indicatorVec u) := by
    43	    change MvPolynomial.eval u (outcome.1.1 - lowDegreeEncoding outcome.2) = _
    44	    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_sub]
    45	    exact congrArg (evalPoly outcome.1 u - ·) (lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct outcome.2 u)
    46	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter, heval,
    47	    tensorMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, pauliRegisterMeas]
    48	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    49	  unfold tauDotProj bracketOp
    50	  simp_rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, Finset.sum_filter]
    51	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    52	  intro g _
    53	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    54	  intro h _
    55	  have hlabel : evalPoly g u - dotProduct h (indicatorVec u) = a ↔
    56	      dotProduct h (indicatorVec u) = evalPoly g u - a := by
    57	    constructor <;> intro heq <;> linear_combination -heq
    58	  simp only [hlabel]
    59	
    60	/-- Alice's evaluated difference measurement has precisely the overlap with
    61	Bob's point measurement that appears in the witness's Alice consistency field. -/
    62	theorem sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    63	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    64	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    65	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice
    66	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
    67	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) =
    68	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
    69	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (evalPoly g u)) := by
    70	  simp only [pullingMeas_eval_effect, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    71	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    72	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    73	  intro g _
    74	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    75	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum, S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	/-- The reverse-player overlap uses the witness's Bob consistency field, with
    79	the original `BB'` and `AB''` placements retained. -/
    80	theorem sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    81	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    82	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    83	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) *
    84	      S.placeSide .bob
    85	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) =
    86	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    87	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect (evalPoly g u)) := by
    88	  simp only [pullingMeas_eval_effect, S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    89	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    90	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    91	  intro g _
    92	  simp only [S.placePlayer_alice_mul_placeSide_bob_tensor]
    93	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum, S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .alice W u]
    94	  rfl
    95	
    96	end

     4	/-!

     6	
     7	Parseval identifies the uniform average over field characters with the sum of
     8	squared outcome norms. A fixed binary basis character instead admits a bound
     9	by four times the consistency defect, using binary postprocessing.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	These are finite-dimensional auxiliary results for blueprint
    14	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2, and paper
    15	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1542-1551`.
    16	They do not assert the preceding pulled-apart measurement comparison
    17	`eq:qld-pulling-cons`, which remains an obligation of issue #520.
    18	-/

    20	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

    22	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

    24	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement

    30	/-- Parseval for the fixed field trace, with a uniform character average and
    31	an unnormalized outcome sum. This specializes the orthogonality theorem used
    32	for blueprint `lem:qld-4-10`; no measurement assumptions are needed. -/
    33	theorem avg_norm_fixed_character_sum_sq {P : AdmissibleParams} {E : Type*}
    34	    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (v : PauliScalar P → E) :
    35	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P)) (fun r =>
    36	      ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) =
    37	      ∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 := by
    38	  classical
    39	  have horth (a b : PauliScalar P) :
    40	      ∑ r : PauliScalar P,
    41	        (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a))) *
    42	          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * b)) =
    43	        if a = b then ((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
    44	    simpa only [← Complex.star_def, star_phaseSign, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
    45	      sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter a b
    46	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum,
    47	    sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal _ _ horth v, ← mul_assoc,
    48	    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero), one_mul]

    52	identity supporting blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2. -/
    53	theorem avg_norm_basis_character_sum_sq {P : AdmissibleParams} {E : Type*}
    54	    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    55	    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) (v : PauliScalar P → E) :
    56	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P)) (fun r =>
    57	      ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) =
    58	      ∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 := by
    59	  classical
    60	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
    61	  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp
    62	    (Equiv.mulLeft₀ (P.model.basis j) (P.model.basis.ne_zero j))
    63	    (fun r => ‖∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2)
    64	  change (∑ r, ‖∑ a,
    65	    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * r * a)) • v a‖ ^ 2) = _ at hsum
    66	  rw [hsum]
    67	  exact (avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum _).symm.trans
    68	    (avg_norm_fixed_character_sum_sq v)

    72	theorem sum_basis_character_effect_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    73	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Measurement (PauliScalar P) ι)

    77	        (A.postprocess (fun a => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a))).effect b := by
    78	  classical
    79	  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    80	    (g := fun a : PauliScalar P => fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a))
    81	    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2))) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)]
    82	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    83	  intro b _
    84	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.smul_sum]
    85	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    86	  intro a ha
    87	  rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
    88	
    89	/-- A fixed basis character costs at most four times the field measurement
    90	consistency defect. The question distribution and basis coordinate are retained

    92	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, without assuming a bound on that defect. -/
    93	theorem basis_character_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
    94	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {X ιA ιB : Type*}
    95	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    96	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    97	    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement (PauliScalar P) ιA)
    98	    (B : X → Measurement (PauliScalar P) ιB)
    99	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
   100	    opDistSq μ
   101	      (fun x => heteroKron
   102	        (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • (A x).effect a) 1)

   104	        (∑ a, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) • (B x).effect a)) ψ ≤

   106	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) ψ := by

   113	    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A' x))
   114	    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B' x)) ψ).trans
   115	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdef (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   116	  have hobs := povm_to_obs_of_measurements μ
   117	    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A' x))
   118	    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B' x)) phaseSign norm_phaseSign ψ

   122	    heteroKron_right_sum_smul, leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   123	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, ← mul_assoc, show (2 : ℝ) * 2 = 4 by norm_num]
   124	    using hbound
   125	
   126	/-- The final measurement-to-observable step of blueprint
   127	`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2, on the original six-register state.
   128	The measurement consistency defect is an explicit quantity, not an assumed
   129	bound. Proving its construction-scale bound remains the obligation
   130	`eq:qld-pulling-cons` of issue #520. -/
   131	theorem tildeObs_opDistSq_le_four_consistencyDefect
   132	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
   133	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   134	    (W : PauliKind) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
   135	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   136	      (fun u => S.placeSide .alice (tildeObs w .alice W u j))
   137	      (fun u => S.placeSide .bob (tildeObs w .bob W u j)) S.psiHat ≤
   138	      4 * consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   139	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))

    63	        (fun u => (1 : Op (R × ((I → K) × (I → K)))) - C u) =
    64	        averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution (I → K)) (fun _ => 1) -
    65	          averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution (I → K)) C := by
    66	      simp [averageOperatorOverDistribution, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    67	    rw [hsub, averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability _
    68	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)]
    69	    congr 1
    70	    rw [averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_eq_inv_card_smul_sum]
    71	    change _ = (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := ℂ) (α := ℂ) (1 : Op R)) _
    72	    simp only [pauliCorrelation, map_smul, map_sum, C]
    73	    rfl
    74	  have h := avg_closeness (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    75	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) (fun _ => 1) C (fun _ => 1)
    76	    (fun _ => by simp) psi
    77	  rw [havg, hdist] at h
    78	  simpa only [MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
    79	    MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_one] using h

    81	/-- Bounds on both Pauli disagreements imply proximity to the EPR subspace.
    82	The auxiliary register is arbitrary, and the estimate requires no division
    83	by a projection norm or restriction to nonzero projection. -/
    84	theorem norm_sub_eprProjection_le_of_pauli_dist
    85	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((I → K) × (I → K))))
    86	    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    87	    (hdist : ∀ W : PauliKind,
    88	      opDistSq (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    89	        (fun u => heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) 1))
    90	        (fun u => heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron 1 (tauObservable W u))) psi ≤ delta) :
    91	    ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R)
    92	      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (I → K) x)
    93	        (fun y => star (eprState (I → K) y)))) psi‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt delta := by
    94	  let H (W : PauliKind) := heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := I) W)
    95	  have hstep (W : PauliKind) : ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (H W) psi‖ ≤ Real.sqrt delta := by
    96	    have h := (norm_sub_pauliCorrelation_sq_le W psi).trans (hdist W)
    97	    exact (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) hdelta).mpr h
    98	  have hprod : H .X * H .Z = heteroKron (1 : Op R)
    99	      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (I → K) x)
   100	        (fun y => star (eprState (I → K) y))) := by
   101	    dsimp only [H]
   102	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr]
   103	  rw [← hprod, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   104	  calc
   105	    _ ≤ ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (H .X) psi‖ +
   106	        ‖applyOperatorToState (H .X) psi -
   107	          applyOperatorToState (H .X) (applyOperatorToState (H .Z) psi)‖ :=
   108	      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
   109	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt delta + Real.sqrt delta := add_le_add (hstep .X) (by
   110	      rw [← MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub]
   111	      exact (norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le .X _).trans (hstep .Z))
   112	    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt delta := by ring
   113	
   114	end
   115	
   116	end MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction

     6	
     7	The product of the averaged, paired X and Z observables is the rank-one
     8	projection onto the EPR vector. This is an algebraic prerequisite for constructing

    11	## References

    28	/-- The operator `H_W` of the EPR projection argument, averaged over all
    29	generalized Pauli labels. Paper lines 1725-1733 define this average after
    30	reindexing by a nonzero element of the binary basis. -/
    31	def pauliCorrelation (W : PauliKind) : Op ((ι → K) × (ι → K)) :=
    32	  (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
    33	    ∑ u : ι → K, heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u)
    34	
    35	private theorem avg_phaseSign_dotProduct (v : ι → K) :
    36	    (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    37	        ∑ u : ι → K, phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) =
    38	      if v = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    39	  have h := congrArg (fun A : Op (ι → K) => A v v)
    40	    (pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable .Z (0 : ι → K))
    41	  have hv : pauliProj .Z (0 : ι → K) v v = if v = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    42	    change (∏ i, if v i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
    43	      star (∏ i, if v i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = _
    44	    simp only [Fintype.prod_boole, ← funext_iff]
    45	    change (if v = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * star (if v = 0 then 1 else 0) = _

    47	  simp only [dotProduct_zero, map_zero, phaseSign, ite_true, one_smul] at h
    48	  rw [hv] at h
    49	  simpa only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    50	    tauObservable_Z_apply, ite_true, one_mul] using h.symm

    52	/-- The Z correlation projects onto equal computational-basis labels.
    53	This is the Fourier cancellation in paper lines 1736-1740. -/
    54	theorem pauliCorrelation_Z_apply (x y : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) :
    55	    pauliCorrelation .Z x y = if x = y ∧ y.1 = y.2 then 1 else 0 := by
    56	  simp only [pauliCorrelation, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    57	    heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
    58	  simp_rw [tauObservable_Z_apply]
    59	  by_cases hxy : x = y
    60	  · subst x
    61	    simp only [ite_true, true_and]
    62	    have hphase (u : ι → K) :
    63	        phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u y.1)) *
    64	            phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u y.2)) =
    65	          phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u (y.1 + y.2))) := by
    66	      rw [← phaseSign_add, dotProduct_add, map_add]
    67	    simp_rw [hphase]
    68	    rw [avg_phaseSign_dotProduct]
    69	    letI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)

    72	      by_contra h
    73	      push Not at h
    74	      exact hxy (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)

    77	/-- On a diagonal input, the X correlation is uniform over diagonal outputs.

    83	    heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
    84	  simp_rw [tauObservable_X_apply]
    85	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (x.1 - a)]
    86	  · simp [add_sub_cancel, eq_comm]
    87	  · intro u _ hu
    88	    have h : x.1 ≠ a + u := by
    89	      intro h
    90	      apply hu
    91	      rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]
    92	    simp [h]
    93	  · simp

    95	/-- The product `H_X H_Z` is the ordinary rank-one EPR projection, with no
    96	normalized-trace factor. This is the identity at paper lines 1735-1742 used
    97	to construct the auxiliary state in blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
    98	theorem pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr :
    99	    pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := ι) .X * pauliCorrelation .Z =
   100	      Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
   101	        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y)) := by
   102	  ext x y
   103	  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
   104	  simp_rw [pauliCorrelation_Z_apply]
   105	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y]
   106	  · by_cases hy : y.1 = y.2
   107	    · rcases y with ⟨a, b⟩
   108	      dsimp only at hy
   109	      subst b
   110	      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, mul_one, pauliCorrelation_X_apply_diagonal]
   111	      change (if x.1 = x.2 then (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =
   112	        (if x.1 = x.2 then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) *
   113	          star (if a = a then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)

   115	      · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hx, if_pos rfl]

   117	      · simp [hx]

   123	/-- Each Pauli correlation average, with an arbitrary auxiliary register,
   124	is a contraction. The triangle inequality
   125	and the unitarity of its summands justify the norm estimate used in paper
   126	lines 1743-1750, independently of any strategy-consistency hypothesis. -/
   127	theorem norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le {R : Type*}
   128	    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (W : PauliKind)
   129	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((ι → K) × (ι → K)))) :
   130	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ := by
   131	  let U (u : ι → K) :=
   132	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))
   133	  have hnorm (u : ι → K) :
   134	      ‖applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   135	    apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_toEuclideanLin_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one
   136	    simp only [U, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker,
   137	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   138	    change heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (tauObservable W u)ᴴ (tauObservable W u)ᴴ) *
   139	      heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u)) = 1
   140	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, tauObservable_conjTranspose_mul_self,
   141	      heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.one_mul, heteroKron_one_one]
   142	  have haction : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ =
   143	      (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ u : ι → K,
   144	        applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ := by
   145	    change applyOperatorToState
   146	      ((Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := ℂ) (α := ℂ) (1 : Op R))
   147	        ((Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
   148	          ∑ u : ι → K, heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))) ψ = _
   149	    simp only [map_smul, map_sum, applyOperatorToState, LinearMap.sum_apply,
   150	      LinearMap.smul_apply]
   151	    rfl
   152	  rw [haction, norm_smul]
   153	  calc
   154	    _ ≤ ‖(Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹‖ * ∑ u : ι → K,
   155	        ‖applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ‖ :=
   156	      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
   157	    _ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   158	      simp only [hnorm, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
   159	      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀, one_mul]
   160	      positivity
   161	
   162	/-- Near-perfect X and Z correlations force proximity to the EPR subspace.
   163	This is the corrected projection estimate for paper lines 1743-1767, with
   164	arbitrary auxiliary registers. It uses the product identity and contraction
   165	bounds, and avoids the invalid squared-triangle estimate in the source. -/
   166	theorem norm_sub_eprProjection_le {R : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
   167	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((ι → K) × (ι → K)))) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   168	    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
   169	    (hcorr : ∀ W : PauliKind,
   170	      1 - δ / 2 ≤ (inner ℂ ψ
   171	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ)).re) :
   172	    ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState
   173	      (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
   174	        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y)))) ψ‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt δ := by
   175	  let H (W : PauliKind) := heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := ι) W)
   176	  have hdist (W : PauliKind) : ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt δ := by
   177	    have hn := norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le W ψ
   178	    rw [hψ] at hn
   179	    have hs : ‖applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
   180	      dsimp only [H]
   181	      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)]
   182	    have he := norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) ψ (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)
   183	    rw [hψ] at he
   184	    change ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
   185	      1 ^ 2 - 2 * (inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)).re +
   186	        ‖applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ‖ ^ 2 at he
   187	    have hc := hcorr W
   188	    change 1 - δ / 2 ≤ (inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)).re at hc
   189	    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hδ, Real.sqrt_nonneg δ,
   190	      norm_nonneg (ψ - applyOperatorToState (H W) ψ)]
   191	  have hprod : H .X * H .Z =
   192	      heteroKron (1 : Op R) (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
   193	        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y))) := by
   194	    dsimp only [H]
   195	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr]
   196	  rw [← hprod, DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul]
   197	  calc
   198	    _ ≤ ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState (H .X) ψ‖ +
   199	        ‖applyOperatorToState (H .X) ψ -
   200	          applyOperatorToState (H .X) (applyOperatorToState (H .Z) ψ)‖ :=
   201	      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
   202	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt δ + Real.sqrt δ := add_le_add (hdist .X) (by
   203	      rw [← MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub]
   204	      exact (norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le .X _).trans (hdist .Z))
   205	    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt δ := by ring
   206

     4	/-!
     5	# The auxiliary vector from the EPR projection
     6	
     7	Taking the partial inner product with the EPR vector constructs the
     8	unnormalized auxiliary vector. Tensoring it with EPR gives exactly the
     9	orthogonal projection of the original vector onto the EPR subspace.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1769-1783`.
    15	-/

    25	/-- Move each extracted register before its auxiliary registers. This
    26	permutation puts the ideal state in the order used by
    27	`MagicSquareRigidity.exists_unit_residual`. -/
    28	def extractionEprFirstEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    29	    SixReg P ιA ιB ≃
    30	      (PauliRegister P × (ιA × PauliRegister P)) ×
    31	        (PauliRegister P × (ιB × PauliRegister P)) :=
    32	  (sixRegExtractionEquiv P ιA ιB).trans
    33	    (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.prodComm _ _) (Equiv.prodComm _ _))
    34	
    35	namespace Extraction

    37	/-- Partial inner product with the EPR vector, leaving the auxiliary index.
    38	This is the coordinate form of the vector defined at paper line 1769. -/
    39	def eprPartialInner {R V : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    40	    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    41	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × (V × V))) : EuclideanSpace ℂ R :=
    42	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv R ℂ).symm
    43	    (fun r => ∑ p : V × V, star (eprState V p) * ψ (r, p))
    44	
    45	/-- Tensoring the EPR partial inner product with EPR gives the rank-one
    46	projection on the second tensor factor. This is the projection equality in
    47	paper lines 1776-1779; no normalization of the auxiliary vector is assumed. -/
    48	theorem vecTensor_eprPartialInner {R V : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    49	    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    50	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × (V × V))) :
    51	    vecTensor (eprPartialInner ψ) (eprState V) =
    52	      applyOperatorToState
    53	        (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState V x)
    54	          (fun y => star (eprState V y)))) ψ := by
    55	  ext x
    56	  change (∑ p : V × V, star (eprState V p) * ψ (x.1, p)) * eprState V x.2 =
    57	    ∑ j : R × (V × V),
    58	      ((1 : Op R) x.1 j.1 * (eprState V x.2 * star (eprState V j.2))) * ψ j
    59	  conv_rhs => rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    60	  simp only [Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
    61	  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    62	  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    63	  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    64	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    65	  intro p _
    66	  ring
    67	
    68	end Extraction

    76	/-- In EPR-first local coordinates, the ideal extraction state is the target
    77	of the existing auxiliary-state normalization theorem. -/
    78	theorem reindexState_idealExpState
    79	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    80	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    81	    reindexState (extractionEprFirstEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    82	        (S.idealExpState aux) =
    83	      reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor (eprState (PauliRegister P)) aux) := by
    84	  ext index
    85	  change aux ((index.1.2.1, index.1.2.2), (index.2.2.1, index.2.2.2)) *
    86	      eprState (PauliRegister P) (index.1.1, index.2.1) =
    87	    eprState (PauliRegister P) (index.1.1, index.2.1) * aux (index.1.2, index.2.2)
    88	  exact mul_comm _ _

    90	/-- Tensoring an auxiliary vector with EPR preserves its norm. -/
    91	theorem idealExpState_norm
    92	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    93	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    94	    ‖S.idealExpState aux‖ = ‖aux‖ := by
    95	  rw [idealExpState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq, eprState_norm, mul_one]

    98	and one EPR pair. It is used when the EPR projection of the given state vanishes. -/
    99	def extractionAuxReference : EuclideanSpace ℂ
   100	    (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=

   103	/-- The reference auxiliary vector has norm one. -/

   109	Paper lines 1766-1769 use this projection to select the auxiliary vector. -/
   110	def extractionEprProjection : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   111	  reindexOp (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm
   112	    (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   113	      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (PauliRegister P) x)

   116	/-- The auxiliary vector before normalization, obtained by contracting the
   117	extracted registers against EPR. This is `aux_0` at paper line 1769. -/
   118	def extractionAux0
   119	    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   120	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   121	  Extraction.eprPartialInner
   122	    (reindexState (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm θ)
   123	
   124	/-- The unnormalized ideal extraction state is the EPR projection of the
   125	given six-register state. This identifies the actual auxiliary construction
   126	with the projection in paper lines 1776-1779, retaining the heterogeneous
   127	player spaces of blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
   128	theorem idealExpState_extractionAux0
   129	    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   130	    S.idealExpState (S.extractionAux0 θ) =
   131	      applyOperatorToState S.extractionEprProjection θ := by
   132	  unfold idealExpState extractionAux0
   133	  rw [Extraction.vecTensor_eprPartialInner]
   134	  ext x
   135	  let e := (extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm
   136	  let T := heteroKron
   137	    (1 : Op (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   138	    (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (PauliRegister P) x)
   139	      (fun y => star (eprState (PauliRegister P) y)))
   140	  change (T *ᵥ (fun j => θ (e.symm j))) (e x) =
   141	    ((T.submatrix e e) *ᵥ (fun j => θ j)) x
   142	  exact (congrFun (Matrix.submatrix_mulVec_equiv T (fun j => θ j) e e) x).symm
   143	
   144	/-- Normalize the projected auxiliary vector, at twice the projection error.
   145	This is the normalization step at paper lines 1773-1783. The existing
   146	normalization theorem also covers a zero projection, using the reference
   147	vector above; no nonvanishing assumption is added. -/
   148	theorem exists_unit_aux_near_eprProjection
   149	    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) :
   150	    ∃ aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB),
   151	      ‖aux‖ = 1 ∧ ‖θ - S.idealExpState aux‖ ≤
   152	        2 * ‖θ - applyOperatorToState S.extractionEprProjection θ‖ := by
   153	  let e := extractionEprFirstEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
   154	  have hdist (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
   155	      (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   156	      ‖reindexState e θ -
   157	        reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor (eprState (PauliRegister P)) aux)‖ =
   158	          ‖θ - S.idealExpState aux‖ := by
   159	    rw [← S.reindexState_idealExpState]
   160	    exact (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ e).norm_map (θ - S.idealExpState aux)
   161	  obtain ⟨aux, haux, hclose⟩ := MagicSquareRigidity.exists_unit_residual
   162	    (reindexState e θ) (by rwa [reindexState_norm_eq])
   163	    S.extractionAuxReference S.extractionAuxReference_norm
   164	    ‖θ - applyOperatorToState S.extractionEprProjection θ‖ (S.extractionAux0 θ)
   165	    (((hdist (S.extractionAux0 θ)).trans
   166	      (congrArg (fun v => ‖θ - v‖) (S.idealExpState_extractionAux0 θ))).le)
   167	  exact ⟨aux, haux, (hdist aux).symm.trans_le hclose⟩

     5	/-!
     6	# Transfer of the complete Pauli overlap between states
     7	
     8	A selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a positive contraction.
     9	Applied to the product measurement, this bounds the complete overlap operator,
    10	independently of the number of answers. Its expectation changes by at most twice
    11	the distance between unit vectors. Schwartz--Zippel then removes unequal Pauli
    12	encodings after the change of state.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1827-1858`.
