    29	/-- Any selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a contraction.
    30	The estimate applies to the whole sum and has no outcome-cardinality factor. -/
    31	theorem norm_apply_measurement_sum_le {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
    32	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (s : Finset α)
    33	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    34	    ‖applyOperatorToState (∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a) psi‖ ≤ ‖psi‖ := by
    35	  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => M.pos a)
    36	  have hle : ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
    37	    rw [← M.sum_eq_one]
    38	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)
    39	      (fun a _ _ => M.pos a)
    40	  apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
    41	  rw [(Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hpos).isHermitian.eq]
    42	  exact (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self hpos hle).trans hle
    43	
    44	/-- Changing a unit vector changes the expectation of a contraction by at most
    45	twice the vector distance. No positivity or self-adjointness is required. -/
    46	theorem abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction {ι : Type*}
    47	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : Op ι)
    48	    (hT : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖applyOperatorToState T v‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
    49	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    50	    |stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T| ≤ 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    51	  have hsplit : stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T =
    52	      (inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re +
    53	        (inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re := by
    54	    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
    55	  rw [hsplit]
    56	  calc
    57	    _ ≤ |(inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re| +
    58	        |(inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re| := abs_add_le _ _
    59	    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T psi‖ +
    60	        ‖phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi)‖ :=
    61	      add_le_add ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
    62	        ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
    63	    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖psi‖ + ‖phi‖ * ‖psi - phi‖ :=
    64	      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT psi) (norm_nonneg _))
    65	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT (psi - phi)) (norm_nonneg _))
    66	    _ = _ := by rw [hpsi, hphi]; ring
    67	
    68	/-- The complete diagonal overlap of two local measurements is stable under a
    69	change of unit state. The tensor factors can have different dimensions. -/
    70	theorem abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le {α I J : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    72	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J)
    73	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    74	    |(∑ a, stateQForm psi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))) -
    75	      ∑ a, stateQForm phi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))| ≤
    76	        2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    77	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : α × α => ab.1 = ab.2)
    78	  have heq : (∑ ab ∈ s, (tensorMeasurement A B).effect ab) =
    79	      ∑ a, heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a) := by
    80	    simp [s, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type, tensorMeasurement,
    81	      Measurement.ofSumEqOne]
    82	  have h := abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction _
    83	    (norm_apply_measurement_sum_le (tensorMeasurement A B) s) psi phi hpsi hphi
    84	  rw [heq, stateQForm_finset_sum, stateQForm_finset_sum] at h
    85	  exact h
    86	
    87	/-- Averaging evaluated overlaps does not increase the state-transfer cost.
    88	This controls the complete overlap in paper `eq:qld-unitary-9`. -/
    89	theorem evaluated_overlap_state_transfer {Y α R I J : Type*}
    90	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
    91	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    92	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    93	    (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J) (eval : α → Y → R)
    94	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    95	    avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y => ∑ r, stateQForm psi
    96	      (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r)
    97	        ((B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r))) ≤
    98	      avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y => ∑ r, stateQForm phi
    99	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r)
   100	          ((B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)).effect r))) + 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
   101	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution Y) _ _ (fun y =>
   102	    (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le
   103	      (A.postprocess (fun a => eval a y)) (B.postprocess (fun a => eval a y))
   104	      psi phi hpsi hphi))
   105	  rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability _
   106	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at h
   107	  linarith
   108	
   109	/-- Two distinct Pauli answers have encodings agreeing on at most an `md/q`
   110	fraction of points. Injectivity follows from the exact decoder identity. -/
   111	theorem pauli_encoding_collision_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
   112	    (h k : PauliRegister P) (hne : h ≠ k) :
   113	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   114	      (fun u => if evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u = evalPoly (encodingPoly k) u
   115	        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   116	  apply poly_eval_collision_le
   117	  intro heq
   118	  apply hne
   119	  have hd := congrArg (fun g : Poly P => decodeFq g) heq
   120	  simpa only [decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding] using hd
   121	
   122	/-- The unevaluated Pauli overlap on a unit comparison state is bounded below
   123	by the evaluated overlap on another unit state, minus the collision and state
   124	errors. This combines paper `eq:qld-unitary-8` with the transfer following
   125	`eq:qld-unitary-9`, without any dimension or answer-count factor. -/
   126	theorem pauli_overlap_transfer {P : AdmissibleParams} {I J : Type*}
   127	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   128	    (A : Measurement (PauliRegister P) I) (B : Measurement (PauliRegister P) J)
   129	    (theta ideal : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   130	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) (hideal : ‖ideal‖ = 1) :
   131	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   132	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
   133	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   134	          ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) ≤
   135	      (∑ h, stateQForm ideal (heteroKron (A.effect h) (B.effect h))) +
   136	        (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q + 2 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
   137	  have ht := evaluated_overlap_state_transfer A B
   138	    (fun h u => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u) theta ideal htheta hideal
   139	  have hc := SandwichProduct.avg_diagonal_postprocess_stateQForm_le A B ideal
   140	    (fun h u => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hideal
   141	    (by positivity) pauli_encoding_collision_le
   142	  exact ht.trans (add_le_add hc le_rfl)
   143	
   144	end

     6	/-!
     7	# Total Pauli comparison on a normalized ideal state
     8	
     9	The complete answer-summed distance is controlled by the evaluated overlap on
    10	another normalized state, the Schwartz--Zippel collision probability, and the
    11	distance between the states. This is the operator comparison used after the
    12	swap and auxiliary-state construction.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1827-1858`.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    21	
    22	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    23	
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    25	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    26

    28	
    29	/-- A symmetric operator acts identically on the two halves of the extracted
    30	EPR pair, including arbitrary auxiliary registers in local player order. -/
    31	theorem extracted_epr_actions_eq {I J V : Type*}
    32	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    33	    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    34	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (T : Op V) (hT : Tᵀ = T) :
    35	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (heteroKron (1 : Op I) T) (1 : Op (J × V)))
    36	        (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState V))) =
    37	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op (I × V)) (heteroKron (1 : Op J) T))
    38	        (reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState V))) := by
    39	  ext p
    40	  simp only [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
    41	    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    42	  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, reindexState, vecTensor,
    43	    eprState, prodShuffle, mul_ite, ite_mul, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and]
    44	  rw [show T p.2.2 p.1.2 = T p.1.2 p.2.2 from congrFun (congrFun hT p.1.2) p.2.2]
    45	  simp
    46	
    47	/-- The full answer-summed Pauli distance on `aux tensor EPR` is at most twice
    48	the evaluated-overlap deficit on `theta`, plus `2md/q` and four times the state
    49	distance. The bound holds for every local POVM and every normalized auxiliary
    50	state, with no restriction on the field, Pauli basis, or local dimensions.
    51	This is the quantitative combination of paper `eq:qld-unitary-7` through
    52	`eq:qld-unitary-9` and its following state-transfer estimate. -/
    53	theorem pauli_distance_on_ideal_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {I J : Type*}
    54	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    55	    (A : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (I × PauliRegister P)) (W : PauliKind)
    56	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1)
    57	    (theta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((I × PauliRegister P) × (J × PauliRegister P)))
    58	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) :
    59	    let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    60	    let B := rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := J) (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)
    61	    (∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    62	      (heteroKron (A.effect h - heteroKron (1 : Op I) (pauliProj W h))
    63	        (1 : Op (J × PauliRegister P))) ideal‖ ^ 2) ≤
    64	      2 * (1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    65	        ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
    66	          (heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
    67	            ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)))) +
    68	        2 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) + 4 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
    69	  dsimp only
    70	  let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    71	  let B := rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := J) (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)
    72	  have hideal : ‖ideal‖ = 1 := by
    73	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq, haux, eprState_norm, one_mul]
    74	  have hdist := point_distance_le_two_defect
    75	    (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := J × PauliRegister P) A)
    76	    (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := I × PauliRegister P) B) ideal
    77	  rw [point_defect_eq, hideal, one_pow] at hdist
    78	  have haction (h : PauliRegister P) :
    79	      applyOperatorToState
    80	          (heteroKron (A.effect h - heteroKron (1 : Op I) (pauliProj W h))
    81	            (1 : Op (J × PauliRegister P))) ideal =
    82	        applyOperatorToState
    83	          ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := J × PauliRegister P) A).effect h -
    84	            (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := I × PauliRegister P) B).effect h) ideal := by
    85	    change applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (A.effect h - _) _) ideal =
    86	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (A.effect h) _ -
    87	        heteroKron _ (heteroKron _ (pauliProj W h))) ideal
    88	    rw [heteroKron_sub_left, MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
    89	      MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
    90	      extracted_epr_actions_eq aux _ (pauliProj_transpose W h)]
    91	  have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := (Finset.univ : Finset (PauliRegister P)))
    92	    rfl (fun h _ => congrArg (fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2) (haction h))
    93	  rw [hsum]
    94	  have hoverlap := pauli_overlap_transfer A B theta ideal htheta hideal
    95	  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
    96	    placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at hdist
    97	  exact hdist.trans (by dsimp [B] at hoverlap ⊢; linarith)
    98	
    99	/-- At construction error at most one, a universal extraction coefficient of
   100	at least eighteen absorbs both the proved state error and the Pauli comparison
   101	error. The collision term and fourth-root scale are exactly those of
   102	`deltaExtract`; there is no parameter-dependent enlargement of the constant. -/
   103	theorem extraction_small_error_absorption (C delta : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ)
   104	    (hC : 18 ≤ C) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1) :
   105	    16 * delta ≤ deltaExtract C delta m d q ∧
   106	      2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
   107	        deltaExtract C delta m d q := by
   108	  have hroot := Real.self_le_rpow_of_le_one hdelta hdelta_one
   109	    (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
   110	  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt delta ≤ delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   111	    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
   112	    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hdelta hdelta_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
   113	  have hr : 0 ≤ (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) := by positivity
   114	  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC
   115	    (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hdelta (1 / 4)) hr)
   116	  constructor
   117	  · exact (show 16 * delta ≤ 18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   118	      ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
   119	  · exact (show 2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
   120	      18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
   121	
   122	end
   123	
   124	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    12	## References

    28	/-- Simultaneous unitary conjugation preserves the quadratic form of a product. -/
    29	theorem stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    30	    (U A B : Op I) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    31	    stateQForm (applyOperatorToState U psi) (conjBy U A * conjBy U B) =
    32	      stateQForm psi (A * B) := by
    33	  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    34	  congr 1
    35	  simp only [conjBy]
    36	  calc
    37	    _ = (Uᴴ * U) * A * (Uᴴ * U) * B * (Uᴴ * U) := by noncomm_ring
    38	    _ = A * B := by rw [hU]; simp

    42	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}

    45	/-- The total Pauli POVM extended to the full local extraction block and
    46	conjugated by the concrete swap. This is the measurement in `eq:qld-unitary-7`. -/
    47	def swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    48	    (W : PauliKind) : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
    49	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    50	    (fun h => conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    51	    (fun h => by
    52	      apply star_right_conjugate_nonneg
    53	      exact kronecker_nonneg
    54	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.pauliMeas side W).pos h) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    55	        Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    56	    (by
    57	      simp only [conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    58	        ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one,
    59	        heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose])
    60	
    61	/-- Coarse-graining commutes with extending and conjugating the Pauli POVM. -/
    62	theorem swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    63	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    64	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    65	    ((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).postprocess
    66	      (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a =
    67	      conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliEvalMeas side W u).effect a)) := by
    68	  simp only [swappedPauliMeas, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,

    70	    ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left]

    74	theorem placeSide_onPlayer (side : PlayerSide) (A : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :

    76	  cases side

    78	  · exact S.placeSide_bob_tensor_one _

    80	/-- The canonical last-register effect has the same block and crossed placements. -/
    81	theorem placeSide_extracted (side : PlayerSide) (T : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
    82	    S.placeSide side (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) T) =
    83	      S.placeExtractedRegister side T := by
    84	  cases side
    85	  · ext row col
    86	    change
    87	      ((if (row.1.1, row.1.2.1) = (col.1.1, col.1.2.1) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
    88	        T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    89	        (if ((row.2.1, row.2.2.1), row.2.2.2) =
    90	          ((col.2.1, col.2.2.1), col.2.2.2) then 1 else 0) =
    91	      (if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) *
    92	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    93	        ((if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    94	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    95	        (if row.2.2.2 = col.2.2.2 then 1 else 0)
    96	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and, ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_one,
    97	      zero_mul, mul_zero]
    98	    split_ifs <;> rfl
    99	  · ext row col
   100	    change
   101	      (if ((row.1.1, row.1.2.1), row.1.2.2) =
   102	        ((col.1.1, col.1.2.1), col.1.2.2) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
   103	        ((if (row.2.1, row.2.2.1) = (col.2.1, col.2.2.1) then 1 else 0) *
   104	          T row.2.2.2 col.2.2.2) =
   105	      ((if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.2.2.2 col.2.2.2) *
   106	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   107	        (if row.1.2.2 = col.1.2.2 then 1 else 0) *
   108	        (if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   109	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0)
   110	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and, ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_one,
   111	      zero_mul, mul_zero]
   112	    split_ifs <;> rfl

   116	    (U A : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
   117	    S.placeSide side (conjBy U A) = conjBy (S.placeSide side U) (S.placeSide side A) := by
   118	  cases side <;>
   119	    simp only [placeSide, conjBy, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   120	      ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose,

   122	
   123	/-- Conjugated total-Pauli effects in block coordinates give exactly the
   124	six-register operators required by the extraction witness. -/
   125	theorem placeSide_swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   126	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
   127	    S.placeSide side ((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).effect h) =

   129	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)) := by

   132	
   133	/-- The evaluated canonical block measurement is the swap-conjugated
   134	pulled-apart measurement, by `eq:qld-unitary-6`. -/
   135	theorem canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   136	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   137	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
   138	    ((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   139	      (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   140	      (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a =
   141	      conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (tildeM w side W (indicatorVec u) a) := by
   142	  rw [swapUnitary_conj_tildeM]
   143	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   144	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne, pauliRegisterMeas, bracketOp, ← heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
   145	  rfl

   147	/-- Multiplying the two block placements is their tensor product in block coordinates. -/
   148	theorem reindexOp_heteroKron_eq_placeSides
   149	    (A : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   150	    (B : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   151	    reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   152	      (heteroKron A B) = S.placeSide .alice A * S.placeSide .bob B := by
   153	  simp only [placeSide, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   154	    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]

   156	/-- On the jointly swapped state, the overlap of conjugated block measurements
   157	is one minus their original consistency defect. This is simultaneous unitary
   158	invariance with the exact six-register reassociation. -/
   159	theorem swapped_block_overlap_eq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   160	    {X α : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   161	    (mu : Distribution X) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
   162	    (A : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   163	    (B : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   164	    avgOver mu (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm
   165	      (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   166	        (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   167	      (heteroKron (conjBy (swapUnitary w .alice) ((A x).effect a))
   168	        (conjBy (swapUnitary w .bob) ((B x).effect a)))) =
   169	      1 - consistencyDefect mu
   170	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .alice ((A x).effect a))
   171	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .bob ((B x).effect a)) S.psiHat := by
   172	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu
   173	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .alice (A x))
   174	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .bob (B x)) S.psiHat hmu S.psiHat_norm
   175	  simp only [blockMeasurement_effect] at h
   176	  rw [h, sub_sub_cancel]
   177	  apply avgOver_congr
   178	  intro x
   179	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   180	  intro a _
   181	  rw [WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, S.reindexOp_heteroKron_eq_placeSides]
   182	  erw [← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .alice,
   183	    ← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .bob]
   184	  exact stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply _ _ _ (S.placeBoth_swap_left_unitary w) S.psiHat

   186	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   187	/-- Alice's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Bob's canonical
   188	measurement is exactly one minus the evaluated-Pauli/tilde consistency defect. -/
   189	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_alice (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   190	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   191	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm
   192	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   193	          (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   194	        (heteroKron (((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).postprocess
   195	          (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   196	          (((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   197	            (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   198	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) =
   199	      1 - consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   200	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   201	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat := by
   202	  simp only [S.swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect]
   203	  simp_rw [S.canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM w .bob]
   204	  have h := S.swapped_block_overlap_eq w _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   205	    (fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u)))
   206	    (fun u => Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u))
   207	      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   208	      (sum_tildeM_eq_one w .bob W (indicatorVec u)))
   209	  have hplace (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :=
   210	    S.placeSide_onPlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a)
   211	  convert
   212	    (h.trans (congrArg (fun f => 1 - consistencyDefect _ f _ S.psiHat)
   213	      (funext fun u => funext fun a => hplace u a))) using 1 <;> rfl
   214

   216	/-- Bob's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Alice's canonical
   217	measurement satisfies the same exact transport, without strategy symmetry. -/
   218	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_bob (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   219	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   220	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm
   221	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   222	          (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   223	        (heteroKron (((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
   224	            (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   225	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   226	          (((S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W).postprocess
   227	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) =
   228	      1 - consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   229	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
   230	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat := by
   231	  simp only [S.swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect]
   232	  simp_rw [S.canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM w .alice]
   233	  have h := S.swapped_block_overlap_eq w _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   234	    (fun u => Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u))
   235	      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   236	      (sum_tildeM_eq_one w .alice W (indicatorVec u)))
   237	    (fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u)))
   238	  have hplace (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :=
   239	    S.placeSide_onPlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)
   240	  convert
   241	    (h.trans (congrArg (fun f => 1 - consistencyDefect _ _ f S.psiHat)
   242	      (funext fun u => funext fun a => hplace u a))) using 1 <;> rfl

    24	/-- Coordinate transport preserves the distance between two state vectors. -/
    25	theorem norm_reindexState_sub_eq {I J : Type*}
    26	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    27	    (e : I ≃ J) (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    28	    ‖reindexState e psi - reindexState e phi‖ = ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    29	  change ‖reindexState e (psi - phi)‖ = _
    30	  exact reindexState_norm_eq e _
    31	
    32	/-- The full Pauli comparison with the total measurement on the right block.
    33	This follows from the left-block estimate by exchanging both auxiliary and
    34	extracted registers; the EPR factor is invariant under this exchange. -/
    35	theorem pauli_distance_on_ideal_right_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {I J : Type*}
    36	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    37	    (A : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (J × PauliRegister P)) (W : PauliKind)
    38	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1)
    39	    (theta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((I × PauliRegister P) × (J × PauliRegister P)))
    40	    (htheta : ‖theta‖ = 1) :
    41	    let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    42	    let B := rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := I) (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)
    43	    (∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    44	      (heteroKron (1 : Op (I × PauliRegister P))
    45	        (A.effect h - heteroKron (1 : Op J) (pauliProj W h))) ideal‖ ^ 2) ≤
    46	      2 * (1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
    47	        ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm theta
    48	          (heteroKron ((B.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
    49	            ((A.postprocess (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)))) +
    50	        2 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) + 4 * ‖theta - ideal‖ := by
    51	  let e := Equiv.prodComm (I × PauliRegister P) (J × PauliRegister P)
    52	  let ideal := reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux (eprState (PauliRegister P)))
    53	  have hideal : reindexState prodShuffle
    54	      (vecTensor (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) aux) (eprState (PauliRegister P))) =
    55	      reindexState e ideal := by
    56	    ext p
    57	    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, prodShuffle, eprState, e, ideal, eq_comm]
    58	  have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_le A W (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm I J) aux)
    59	    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, haux]) (reindexState e theta)
    60	    (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, htheta])
    61	  dsimp only at h ⊢
    62	  rw [hideal, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
    63	  dsimp only [e] at h
    64	  simp_rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
    65	    WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, WinImplications.reindexOp_prodComm_heteroKron] at h
    66	  exact h

    73	/-- The evaluated total-Pauli consistency defect against the opposite
    74	pulled-apart measurement, with the tensor factors in Alice--Bob order. -/
    75	def evaluatedPauliDefect (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    76	    (W : PauliKind) : ℝ :=
    77	  match side with
    78	  | .alice => consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    79	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
    80	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat
    81	  | .bob => consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    82	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W (indicatorVec u) a))
    83	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat

    85	/-- The ideal state in local extraction-block order. -/
    86	theorem reindexState_idealExpState_blocks
    87	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    88	    reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    89	      (S.idealExpState aux) = reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor aux
    90	        (eprState (PauliRegister P))) := by
    91	  rfl

    93	/-- Subtraction of block operators agrees with subtraction after placement. -/
    94	theorem placeSide_sub (side : PlayerSide)
    95	    (A B : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    96	    S.placeSide side (A - B) = S.placeSide side A - S.placeSide side B := by
    97	  cases side
    98	  · ext row col
    99	    exact sub_mul _ _ _
   100	  · ext row col
   101	    exact mul_sub _ _ _
   102	
   103	/-- The entire answer-summed distance in block coordinates is the distance
   104	appearing in `ExtractionWitness.pauli_close`, for either player. -/
   105	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_eq_sum (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   106	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   107	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   108	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   109	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   110	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   111	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   112	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   113	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) =
   114	      ∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   115	        (S.placeSide side (((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).effect h) -
   116	          heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) (pauliProj W h)))
   117	        (S.idealExpState aux)‖ ^ 2 := by
   118	  simp_rw [S.placeSide_sub, S.placeSide_swappedPauliMeas, S.placeSide_extracted]
   119	  exact avgOver_uniform_const _

   121	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   122	/-- For the concrete swaps, the full Pauli distance on the normalized ideal
   123	state is bounded by the evaluated consistency defect and the two established
   124	comparison losses. This instantiates `eq:qld-unitary-7`--`eq:qld-unitary-9`
   125	with all six-register placements and both player orientations. -/
   126	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_le (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   127	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   128	    (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1) (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   129	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   130	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   131	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   132	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   133	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   134	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) ≤
   135	      2 * S.evaluatedPauliDefect w side W + 2 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) +
   136	        4 * ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
   137	          S.idealExpState aux‖ := by
   138	  let e := sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB
   139	  let theta := S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat
   140	  have htheta : ‖reindexState e theta‖ = 1 := by
   141	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq]
   142	    exact S.applyBoth_swap_norm w
   143	  rw [S.extraction_pauli_dist_eq_sum]
   144	  cases side
   145	  · have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_le (S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W) W aux haux
   146	      (reindexState e theta) htheta
   147	    dsimp only at h
   148	    erw [S.swapped_pauli_overlap_alice w W, sub_sub_cancel,
   149	      ← S.reindexState_idealExpState_blocks aux, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
   150	    convert h using 1
   151	    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   152	      intro label _
   153	      congr 1
   154	      exact (WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState e _ _).symm
   155	    · rfl
   156	  · have h := pauli_distance_on_ideal_right_le (S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W) W aux haux
   157	      (reindexState e theta) htheta
   158	    dsimp only at h
   159	    erw [S.swapped_pauli_overlap_bob w W, sub_sub_cancel,
   160	      ← S.reindexState_idealExpState_blocks aux, norm_reindexState_sub_eq] at h
   161	    convert h using 1
   162	    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   163	      intro label _
   164	      congr 1
   165	      exact (WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState e _ _).symm
   166	    · rfl

    32	/-- The simultaneous swap is an isometry on the six-register space. This is
    33	the two-player consequence of the unitarity calculation at paper lines 1693-1700. -/
    34	theorem placeBoth_swap_left_unitary (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) :
    35	    (S.placeBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob))ᴴ *
    36	      S.placeBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) = 1 := by
    37	  classical

    39	    MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, heteroKron_mul]

    65	private theorem sum_place_sq_eq_one {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    66	    (p : Placement) (A : α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
    67	    (hA : ∑ a, (A a)ᴴ * A a = 1) :
    68	    ∑ a, (S.place p (A a))ᴴ * S.place p (A a) = 1 := by
    69	  simp only [← S.place_conjTranspose, ← S.place_mul]
    70	  rw [← S.place_finsetSum, hA, S.place_one]

    72	/-- The original total-Pauli effects remain square-complete after placement.
    73	This is the completeness used to expand the distance at paper lines 1827-1834. -/
    74	theorem sum_placePlayer_pauli_sq (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
    75	    ∑ h, (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h))ᴴ *
    76	      S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h) = 1 := by
    77	  classical
    78	  have hlocal : ∑ h, ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)ᴴ *
    79	      (S.pauliMeas side W).effect h = 1 := by
    80	    have hproj : Measurement.IsProjective (S.pauliMeas side W) := by
    81	      apply SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective

    93	/-- The ideal total-Pauli effects are square-complete on either extracted register. -/
    94	theorem sum_placeExtractedRegister_pauli_sq (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
    95	    ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))ᴴ *
    96	      S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h) = 1 := by

    98	  have hlocal : ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (pauliProj W h)ᴴ * pauliProj W h = 1 := by

    38	\section{Key theorem forms}
    39	
    40	Let $H_X$ and $H_Z$ be the positive contractions of the extraction proof, and
    41	let $\vartheta$ be a unit vector such that
    42	\[
    43	  \langle\vartheta,H_W\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta/2
    44	  \qquad (W\in\{X,Z\}).
    45	\]
    46	Since $(I-H_W)^2\geq0$,
    47	\[
    48	  H_W^2\geq2H_W-I,
    49	  \qquad
    50	  \langle\vartheta,H_W^2\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta.
    51	\]
    52	Also $\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert^2\leq\delta$, whence
    53	\[
    54	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert^2\leq4\delta.
    55	\]
    56	Together with $H_XH_Z$ equal to the EPR projection, these estimates give the
    57	required overlap bound, with constants absorbed into the stated
    58	$O(\sqrt\delta)$ error.
    59	
    60	For the final transfer, let $\phi\colon\mathcal H\to\mathcal K$ be an isometry
    61	and set $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$.  If $N_h$ is the unitary-conjugated extension of
    62	a measurement operator $M_h$, then the exact identity is
    63	\[
    64	  \phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ=QN_h,
    65	\]
    66	not merely $N_h$.  Thus comparison of $N_h$ with an ideal projector must be
    67	combined with control of $(I-Q)\Delta$ on the ideal comparison state
    68	$\Delta$.

    70	\section{Numerical defects in the source proof}
    71	
    72	Lines~1715--1742 of
    73	\path{references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex}
    74	construct $H_X,H_Z$ and identify $H_XH_Z$ with the EPR projection.  The norm
    75	estimate at lines~1743--1750 gives
    76	$\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert\leq\sqrt\delta$.  At lines~1753--1757 the
    77	source substitutes $\delta$ inside the reverse triangle inequality
    78	\cite[lines~1715--1783]{Ji2020MIPStar}.  That replacement is not valid for
    79	small $\delta$.  The desired lower bound on
    80	$\langle H_W^2\rangle$ follows directly from $H_W^2\geq2H_W-I$, as above.
    81	
    82	The triangle inequality yields
    83	\[
    84	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert\leq2\sqrt\delta,
    85	\]
    86	so its square is at most $4\delta$.  Line~1761 instead bounds that square by
    87	$2\sqrt\delta$ without a stated restriction.  This inequality follows when
    88	$\delta\leq1/4$; for larger error the theorem is made trivial by enlarging the
    89	universal constant.  The same small-error split ensures that the projected
    90	vector defined at lines~1769--1773 is nonzero before it is normalized.  These
    91	are local numerical repairs and do not weaken the extraction conclusion.

    93	\section{The range-projection obligation}
    94	
    95	Lines~1827--1858 prove state-dependent closeness for the concrete operators
    96	obtained by conjugating the original measurement with the swap unitaries.
    97	Lines~1864--1875 then define isometries by adjoining EPR pairs and applying
    98	those unitaries, and immediately state the corresponding closeness for
    99	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger$.  The omitted range projection makes this implication
   100	non-definitional \cite[lines~1827--1875]{Ji2020MIPStar}.
   101	
   102	Let $\Psi$ be the original state and suppose $\phi\Psi$ is close to the ideal
   103	state $\Delta$.  Since $Q\phi\Psi=\phi\Psi$ and $Q$ is a contraction, the
   104	triangle inequality bounds $(I-Q)\Delta$ by the state-extraction error.  Using
   105	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ$, split
   106	\[
   107	  (N_hQ-T_h)\Delta
   108	  =(N_h-T_h)\Delta-N_h(I-Q)\Delta,
   109	\]
   110	where $T_h$ is the ideal Pauli projector.  Summing squared norms over $h$
   111	uses projectivity and orthogonality to keep the second term under control.
   112	The same argument is required for each player and each Pauli basis.

     5	/-! # Encoding-supported Pauli reference measurements
     6	
     7	The reference measurement measures the strategy's Pauli answer and an independent
     8	ideal Pauli answer, then returns the bounded encoding of their sum. Its effects
     9	vanish outside the encoding image. Evaluation of its polynomial outcome is the
    10	convolution of the evaluated strategy measurement and the ideal point projectors.
    11	
    12	These are internal auxiliary constructions for blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`
    13	and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`, not the quantitative support estimate. No
    14	winning premise or global polynomial-pair witness is used or constructed here.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	The encoding is paper `eq:low-degree-encoding-definition` in
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:882-897`. The convolution is the Pauli
    20	answer replacement of the expanded point measurement at
    21	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:383-418`.
    22	The corrected use in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` is recorded in blueprint
    23	`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
    24	-/

    51	/-- Measure the strategy Pauli answer and the ancillary ideal Pauli answer and
    52	return the encoding of their sum. This complete POVM is the internal reference
    53	measurement underlying blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`; it is not the global
    54	polynomial measurement whose existence is required in `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    55	noncomputable def encodingPauliMeas (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    56	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) :
    57	    Measurement (Poly params) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
    58	  (tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis) (pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess
    59	    fun answers => encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2)

    98	/-- Evaluating the reference polynomial is equivalent to evaluating the two Pauli
    99	answers separately and adding their values. This uses linearity of the encoding,
   100	not the decoder/evaluation identity for arbitrary polynomial representatives. -/
   101	theorem encodingPauliMeas_postprocess_eval (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
   102	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (point : Fin params.m → PauliScalar params) :
   103	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).postprocess (fun poly => evalPoly poly point) =
   104	      (tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point)
   105	        ((pauliRegisterMeas basis).postprocess
   106	          (fun answer => lowDegreeEnc answer point))).postprocess
   107	        (fun values => values.1 + values.2) := by
   108	  unfold encodingPauliMeas pauliEvalMeas
   109	  rw [Measurement.postprocess_comp, tensorMeasurement_postprocess,
   110	    Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   111	  apply congrArg ((tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis)
   112	    (pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess)
   113	  funext answers
   114	  change lowDegreeEnc (answers.1 + answers.2) point =
   115	    lowDegreeEnc answers.1 point + lowDegreeEnc answers.2 point
   116	  simp only [lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct, add_dotProduct]

   131	theorem sum_tildeM_eq_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
   132	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
   133	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) :
   134	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, tildeM w side W u a = 1 := by
   135	  classical
   136	  simp only [tildeM]
   137	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   138	  calc
   139	    _ = ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
   140	        (∑ a : PauliScalar P, tauDotProj W u (dotProduct (decodeFq g) u - a)) := by
   141	      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ =>
   142	        (DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right _ _ _).symm
   143	    _ = ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g) 1 := by
   144	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
   145	      congr 1

   147	        _ = ∑ a : PauliScalar P, tauDotProj W u a :=
   148	          (Equiv.subLeft (dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).sum_comp (tauDotProj W u)

    29	/-- Any selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a contraction.
    30	The estimate applies to the whole sum and has no outcome-cardinality factor. -/
    31	theorem norm_apply_measurement_sum_le {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
    32	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (s : Finset α)
    33	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    34	    ‖applyOperatorToState (∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a) psi‖ ≤ ‖psi‖ := by
    35	  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => M.pos a)

    37	    rw [← M.sum_eq_one]
    38	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)
    39	      (fun a _ _ => M.pos a)
    40	  apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
    41	  rw [(Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hpos).isHermitian.eq]
    42	  exact (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self hpos hle).trans hle

    44	/-- Changing a unit vector changes the expectation of a contraction by at most
    45	twice the vector distance. No positivity or self-adjointness is required. -/

    47	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : Op ι)
    48	    (hT : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖applyOperatorToState T v‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
    49	    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
    50	    |stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T| ≤ 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
    51	  have hsplit : stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T =
    52	      (inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re +
    53	        (inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re := by
    54	    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
    55	  rw [hsplit]

   115	    (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hdelta (1 / 4)) hr)
   116	  constructor
   117	  · exact (show 16 * delta ≤ 18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
   118	      ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
   119	  · exact (show 2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
   120	      18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
   121	
   122	end

   124	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     4	/-!
     5	# Real polynomial collision bounds
     6	
     7	The existing Schwartz–Zippel estimate for bounded polynomial representatives
     8	is expressed as a nonnegative rational cardinality ratio. This module converts
     9	it to the real uniform average used by the sandwich support comparison and
    10	specializes it to the polynomial outcomes of the Pauli basis test.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	* `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex`, `lem:schwartz-zippel`.
    15	* Blueprint `lem:schwartz-zippel-individual` and the collision calculation
    16	  preceding `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` in `sec:separating`.
    17	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`,
    18	  the consistency calculation in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` whose decoder
    19	  substitution requires the blueprint's nonencoding-mass estimate.
    20	* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`, for that substitution's scope.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    24	
    25	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    26	
    27	/-- Two distinct individual-degree-`d` polynomial representatives agree on at
    28	most an `m * d / |K|` fraction of field points, expressed as a real uniform
    29	average. This is the scalar collision estimate used before blueprint
    30	`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`, not the nonencoding-mass estimate itself.
    31	
    32	The field is finite and hence nonempty. No positive dimension, positive degree,
    33	or degree bound relative to the field size is required; representatives are
    34	not identified merely because their evaluations agree. -/
    35	theorem polyFunc_eval_collision_le {m d : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    36	    [DecidableEq K] (first second : polyFunc m K d) (hne : first ≠ second) :
    37	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
    38	      (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
    39	        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (m * d : ℝ) / Fintype.card K := by
    40	  have havg :
    41	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
    42	        (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
    43	          then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
    44	        (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) := by
    45	    rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter]
    46	    simp [polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    47	  rw [havg]
    48	  have hbound := schwartzZippel_individualDegree first second hne
    49	  have hreal : (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) ≤
    50	      ((((m * d : ℕ) : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card K) : ℝ) := by
    51	    exact_mod_cast hbound
    52	  simpa using hreal
    53	
    54	/-- The collision hypothesis for the sandwich support comparison on QPBT
    55	polynomial outcomes, with the field cardinality written as `P.q`.
    56	
    57	This specializes `polyFunc_eval_collision_le` to the fixed field model and
    58	`evalPoly`; it adds no assumptions to the admissible parameter domain of
    59	blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`. -/
    60	theorem poly_eval_collision_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
    61	    (first second : Poly P) (hne : first ≠ second) :
    62	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    63	      (fun point => if evalPoly first point = evalPoly second point then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
    64	        (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
    65	  have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
    66	    @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
    67	  unfold evalPoly
    68	  conv_rhs => rw [← hcard]
    69	  exact polyFunc_eval_collision_le first second hne
    70	
    71	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     3	/-!
     4	# EPR projection from Pauli disagreement
     5	
     6	Averaging the paired Pauli operators contracts the disagreement norm. The X
     7	and Z averages multiply to the EPR projection, giving the corrected projection
     8	estimate directly in the squared-distance formulation.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    13	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1715-1783`;
    14	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction
    20	
    21	open MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.LDT DistanceCalculus
    22	
    23	noncomputable section
    24	
    25	variable {K I R : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    26	  [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    27	
    28	/-- The averaged paired Pauli operator has squared displacement at most the
    29	mean squared disagreement between the two players. This is Jensen's inequality
    30	in the projection argument at paper lines 1715-1750. -/
    31	theorem norm_sub_pauliCorrelation_sq_le
    32	    (W : PauliKind) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((I → K) × (I → K)))) :
    33	    ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) psi‖ ^ 2 ≤
    34	      opDistSq (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    35	        (fun u => heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) 1))
    36	        (fun u => heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron 1 (tauObservable W u))) psi := by
    37	  classical
    38	  let L (u : I → K) :=
    39	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (1 : Op (I → K)))
    40	  let B (u : I → K) :=
    41	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (1 : Op (I → K)) (tauObservable W u))
    42	  let C (u : I → K) :=
    43	    heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))
    44	  have hL (u : I → K) : (L u)ᴴ * L u = 1 := by
    45	    simp only [L, MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
    46	      heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, tauObservable_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    47	      heteroKron_one_one]
    48	  have halg (u : I → K) : L u * (L u - B u) = 1 - C u := by
    49	    simp only [L, B, C, Matrix.mul_sub, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
    50	      Matrix.mul_one, tauObservable_sq, heteroKron_one_one]
    51	  have hdist : opDistSq (uniformDistribution (I → K)) (fun _ => 1) C psi =
    52	      opDistSq (uniformDistribution (I → K)) L B psi := by
    53	    unfold opDistSq opFamilyDistSq
    54	    simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
    55	    apply avgOver_congr
    56	    intro u
    57	    rw [← halg, MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_isometry_mul (hL u)]
    58	  have havg : averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    59	      (fun u => (1 : ℂ) • ((1 : Op (R × ((I → K) × (I → K)))) - C u)) =
    60	      1 - heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W) := by
    61	    simp only [one_smul]
    62	    have hsub : averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    63	        (fun u => (1 : Op (R × ((I → K) × (I → K)))) - C u) =
    64	        averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution (I → K)) (fun _ => 1) -
    65	          averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution (I → K)) C := by
    66	      simp [averageOperatorOverDistribution, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    67	    rw [hsub, averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability _
    68	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)]
    69	    congr 1
    70	    rw [averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_eq_inv_card_smul_sum]
    71	    change _ = (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := ℂ) (α := ℂ) (1 : Op R)) _
    72	    simp only [pauliCorrelation, map_smul, map_sum, C]
    73	    rfl
    74	  have h := avg_closeness (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    75	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) (fun _ => 1) C (fun _ => 1)
    76	    (fun _ => by simp) psi
    77	  rw [havg, hdist] at h
    78	  simpa only [MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
    79	    MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_one] using h
    80	
    81	/-- Bounds on both Pauli disagreements imply proximity to the EPR subspace.
    82	The auxiliary register is arbitrary, and the estimate requires no division
    83	by a projection norm or restriction to nonzero projection. -/
    84	theorem norm_sub_eprProjection_le_of_pauli_dist
    85	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((I → K) × (I → K))))
    86	    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    87	    (hdist : ∀ W : PauliKind,
    88	      opDistSq (uniformDistribution (I → K))
    89	        (fun u => heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) 1))
    90	        (fun u => heteroKron (1 : Op R) (heteroKron 1 (tauObservable W u))) psi ≤ delta) :
    91	    ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R)
    92	      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (I → K) x)
    93	        (fun y => star (eprState (I → K) y)))) psi‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt delta := by
    94	  let H (W : PauliKind) := heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := I) W)
    95	  have hstep (W : PauliKind) : ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (H W) psi‖ ≤ Real.sqrt delta := by
    96	    have h := (norm_sub_pauliCorrelation_sq_le W psi).trans (hdist W)
    97	    exact (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) hdelta).mpr h
    98	  have hprod : H .X * H .Z = heteroKron (1 : Op R)
    99	      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (I → K) x)
   100	        (fun y => star (eprState (I → K) y))) := by
   101	    dsimp only [H]
   102	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr]
   103	  rw [← hprod, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   104	  calc
   105	    _ ≤ ‖psi - applyOperatorToState (H .X) psi‖ +
   106	        ‖applyOperatorToState (H .X) psi -
   107	          applyOperatorToState (H .X) (applyOperatorToState (H .Z) psi)‖ :=
   108	      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
   109	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt delta + Real.sqrt delta := add_le_add (hstep .X) (by
   110	      rw [← MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sub]
   111	      exact (norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le .X _).trans (hstep .Z))
   112	    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt delta := by ring
   113	
   114	end
   115	
   116	end MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction

     6	/-!
     7	# Polynomial outcomes in the pulling argument
     8	
     9	The joint measurement of a polynomial marginal and an ideal Pauli register
    10	returns the difference between the polynomial and the encoding of the register.
    11	Decoding this difference gives exactly the pulled-apart measurement. Polynomial
    12	collision estimates apply to these representatives without an encoding-support
    13	restriction on the original marginal.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1530-1605`,
    19	  `eq:qld-pulling-11`, `eq:qld-pulling-12`, and the following symmetry argument.
    20	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`; only decoder linearity and its
    21	  left-inverse identity are used here.
    22	- Issue #520; these auxiliary results do not assert `eq:qld-pulling-cons`.
    23	- The collision estimate compares unequal difference polynomials under uniform
    24	  evaluation.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    28	
    29	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    30	
    31	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    32	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    33	open WinImplications
    34	
    35	noncomputable section
    36	
    37	open scoped Classical
    38	
    39	/-- The outcome `g - g_h` in `eq:qld-pulling-12` is a bounded polynomial
    40	representative, even when `g` is not in the encoding image. -/
    41	def pullingPoly {P : AdmissibleParams} (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) : Poly P :=
    42	  outcome.1 - encodingPoly outcome.2
    43	
    44	/-- Decoder linearity identifies the label in `eq:qld-pulling-12`. This uses
    45	`Dec(g_h) = h`, never the reverse identity on arbitrary polynomials. -/
    46	theorem decodeFq_pullingPoly {P : AdmissibleParams}
    47	    (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) :
    48	    decodeFq (pullingPoly outcome) = decodeFq outcome.1 - outcome.2 := by
    49	  have hsub (g h : Poly P) : decodeFq (g - h) = decodeFq g - decodeFq h := by
    50	    funext y
    51	    simp [decodeOn, decodeAt, evalPoly, MvPolynomial.eval_sub]
    52	  rw [pullingPoly, hsub, decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding]
    53	
    54	/-- Equal difference polynomials give identical scalar labels in the symmetric
    55	expression following `eq:qld-pulling-12`, for every register vector. -/
    56	theorem pulling_label_eq_of_poly_eq {P : AdmissibleParams}
    57	    (first second : Poly P × PauliRegister P)
    58	    (h : pullingPoly first = pullingPoly second) (u : PauliRegister P) :
    59	    dotProduct (decodeFq first.1 - first.2) u =
    60	      dotProduct (decodeFq second.1 - second.2) u := by
    61	  rw [← decodeFq_pullingPoly, ← decodeFq_pullingPoly, h]
    62	
    63	/-- The projective measurement with polynomial outcomes `g - g_h` used to
    64	organize the last step of the pulling argument. Its input witness remains
    65	supplied; no global witness is constructed by this definition. -/
    66	def pullingMeas {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    67	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    68	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
    69	    Measurement (Poly P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
    70	  (tensorMeasurement (w.marginalPoly side W) (pauliRegisterMeas W)).postprocess pullingPoly
    71	
    72	/-- The joint effects are tensor products of orthogonal projections, and
    73	postprocessing retains projectivity. -/
    74	theorem pullingMeas_isProjective {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    75	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    76	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
    77	    Measurement.IsProjective (pullingMeas w side W) := by
    78	  apply SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
    79	  intro outcome
    80	  exact MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker
    81	    (w.marginalPoly_isProjective side W outcome.1)
    82	    ⟨by simp [IsIdempotentElem, pauliRegisterMeas, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
    83	        pauliProj_mul_pauliProj],
    84	      (posSemidef_pauliProj W outcome.2).isHermitian⟩
    85	
    86	/-- Decoding the difference-polynomial measurement recovers `eq:tilde_M`
    87	exactly. The equality holds on the full bounded polynomial carrier. -/
    88	theorem pullingMeas_postprocess_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    89	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    90	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
    91	    ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).effect a =
    92	      tildeM w side W u a := by
    93	  classical
    94	  rw [pullingMeas, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
    95	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter,
    96	    decodeFq_pullingPoly, tensorMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, pauliRegisterMeas]
    97	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    98	  unfold tildeM tauDotProj bracketOp
    99	  simp_rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, Finset.sum_filter]
   100	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   101	  intro g _
   102	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   103	  intro h _
   104	  have hlabel : dotProduct (decodeFq g - h) u = a ↔
   105	      dotProduct h u = dotProduct (decodeFq g) u - a := by
   106	    rw [sub_dotProduct]
   107	    constructor <;> intro heq <;> linear_combination -heq
   108	  simp only [hlabel]
   109	
   110	/-- The coordinate change to two extraction blocks preserves the consistency
   111	defect, including every off-diagonal outcome and the question distribution. -/
   112	private theorem consistencyDefect_placeSide_eq {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   113	    {X A : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
   114	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (mu : Distribution X)
   115	    (left : X → A → Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace .alice)))
   116	    (right : X → A → Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace .bob))) :
   117	    consistencyDefect mu (fun x a => S.placeSide .alice (left x a))
   118	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .bob (right x a)) S.psiHat =
   119	      consistencyDefect mu (fun x a => heteroKron (left x a) 1)
   120	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (right x a))
   121	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) S.psiHat) := by
   122	  unfold consistencyDefect
   123	  apply avgOver_congr
   124	  intro x
   125	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   126	  intro a _
   127	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   128	  intro b _
   129	  by_cases hab : a = b
   130	  · simp only [hab, if_true]
   131	  · simp only [if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
   132	    rw [stateQForm_reindexState, reindexOp_mul]
   133	    rfl
   134	
   135	/-- Polynomial collision and deterministic decoding, before choosing a
   136	register placement. This separates the finite probability calculation from
   137	the six-register coordinate identities. -/
   138	private theorem polynomial_decoding_defect_le_evaluated_add {P : AdmissibleParams}
   139	    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
   140	    (A : Measurement (Poly P) I) (B : Measurement (Poly P) J)
   141	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) :
   142	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   143	        (fun u a => heteroKron
   144	          ((A.postprocess (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).effect a) 1)
   145	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1
   146	          ((B.postprocess (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).effect a)) psi ≤
   147	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   148	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((A.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) 1)
   149	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) psi +
   150	          (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   151	  have hcollision := SandwichProduct.point_codeword_defect_le_avg_evaluated_add
   152	    A B psi evalPoly ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q) hpsi
   153	    (by positivity) (fun g h hne => poly_eval_collision_le g h hne)
   154	  have hpost (u : PauliRegister P) := consistencyDefect_postprocess_le
   155	    (uniformDistribution Unit) (fun _ => A) (fun _ => B) psi
   156	    (fun g => dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)
   157	  simp only [consistencyDefect, avgOver_uniform_const,
   158	    consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at hpost
   159	  simp only [consistencyDefect, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
   160	    placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
   161	  exact (avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpost).trans
   162	    ((avgOver_uniform_const _).le.trans hcollision)
   163	
   164	/-- The last polynomial-collision step of the pulling argument, followed by
   165	decoding. The field-measurement defect is bounded by the evaluated
   166	difference-polynomial defect plus exactly `m * d / q`.
   167	
   168	This is an unconditional comparison of two actual defects for the supplied
   169	measurement. Bounding the evaluated defect from the witness's point
   170	consistency remains the preceding steps of `eq:qld-pulling-cons`; no estimate
   171	for that defect is assumed here. The state and placements are the original
   172	six-register ones. -/
   173	theorem tildeM_consistencyDefect_le_pulling_eval_add {P : AdmissibleParams}
   174	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   175	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   176	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))
   177	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (tildeM w .alice W u a))
   178	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W u a)) S.psiHat ≤
   179	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   180	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
   181	          (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
   182	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
   183	          (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
   184	        S.psiHat + (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
   185	  classical
   186	  rw [consistencyDefect_placeSide_eq, consistencyDefect_placeSide_eq]
   187	  have h := polynomial_decoding_defect_le_evaluated_add
   188	      (pullingMeas w .alice W) (pullingMeas w .bob W)
   189	      (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) S.psiHat)
   190	      (by rw [reindexState_norm_eq, S.psiHat_norm])
   191	  simp only [pullingMeas_postprocess_effect] at h
   192	  convert h using 1
   193	  all_goals congr 1
   194	
   195	/-- Observable consistency reduces to the evaluated difference-polynomial
   196	defect. The coefficient four, uniform register average, and fixed basis
   197	coordinate are exactly those of the established character conversion.
   198	This estimate assumes no bound on the remaining evaluated defect. -/
   199	theorem tildeObs_opDistSq_le_pulling_eval_add {P : AdmissibleParams}
   200	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   201	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
   202	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution (PauliRegister P))

    30	/-- Evaluation of the difference measurement is a convolution with the ideal
    31	Pauli point projectors. No encoding hypothesis on `g` is needed. -/
    32	theorem pullingMeas_eval_effect {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    33	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    34	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    35	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    36	    ((pullingMeas w side W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a =
    37	      ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
    38	        (tauDotProj W (indicatorVec u) (evalPoly g u - a)) := by
    39	  rw [pullingMeas, Measurement.postprocess_comp]
    40	  have heval (outcome : Poly P × PauliRegister P) :
    41	      evalPoly (pullingPoly outcome) u =
    42	        evalPoly outcome.1 u - dotProduct outcome.2 (indicatorVec u) := by
    43	    change MvPolynomial.eval u (outcome.1.1 - lowDegreeEncoding outcome.2) = _
    44	    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_sub]
    45	    exact congrArg (evalPoly outcome.1 u - ·) (lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct outcome.2 u)
    46	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter, heval,
    47	    tensorMeasurement, Measurement.ofSumEqOne, pauliRegisterMeas]
    48	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    49	  unfold tauDotProj bracketOp
    50	  simp_rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, Finset.sum_filter]
    51	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    52	  intro g _
    53	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    54	  intro h _
    55	  have hlabel : evalPoly g u - dotProduct h (indicatorVec u) = a ↔
    56	      dotProduct h (indicatorVec u) = evalPoly g u - a := by
    57	    constructor <;> intro heq <;> linear_combination -heq
    58	  simp only [hlabel]
    59	
    60	/-- Alice's evaluated difference measurement has precisely the overlap with
    61	Bob's point measurement that appears in the witness's Alice consistency field. -/
    62	theorem sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    63	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    64	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    65	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placeSide .alice
    66	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
    67	        S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) =
    68	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g) *
    69	        S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect (evalPoly g u)) := by
    70	  simp only [pullingMeas_eval_effect, S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    71	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    72	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    73	  intro g _
    74	  simp only [S.placeSide_alice_tensor_mul_placePlayer_bob]
    75	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum, S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .bob W u]
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	/-- The reverse-player overlap uses the witness's Bob consistency field, with
    79	the original `BB'` and `AB''` placements retained. -/
    80	theorem sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    81	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    82	    (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    83	    (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) *
    84	      S.placeSide .bob
    85	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) =
    86	      ∑ g : Poly P, S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    87	        S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect (evalPoly g u)) := by
    88	  simp only [pullingMeas_eval_effect, S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    89	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    90	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    91	  intro g _
    92	  simp only [S.placePlayer_alice_mul_placeSide_bob_tensor]
    93	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← S.place_finset_sum, S.pointMeasExp_effect_eq_sum_sub .alice W u]
    94	  rfl
    95	
    96	end

   164	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place .AA' ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).effect g)) := by

   178	      (Finset.mem_univ (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))

    27	/-- For a supplied global polynomial-pair witness, the pulled-apart defect is

    35	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    36	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :

    39	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat ≤
    40	      deltaG + nonencodingMarginalMass w .bob W := by
    41	  classical
    42	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)

    47	    S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
    48	  have hdefect := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu evaluated expanded S.psiHat
    49	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    50	  have hw := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
    51	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (evaluated u).effect a)
    52	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hw
    53	  rw [hdefect] at hw
    54	  have hregroup (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
    55	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm S.psiHat
    56	        ((evaluated u).effect a * (expanded u).effect a)) =
    57	      ∑ g : Poly P, stateQForm S.psiHat
    58	        (S.place .BB' ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).effect g) *
    59	          S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect
    60	            (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1))) := by
    61	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]

    63	      (∑ a : PauliScalar P, S.place .BB'

    66	            S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)) = _

    68	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
    69	        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a)))).trans

    75	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)] at hcompare

    79	    unfold nonencodingMarginalMass
    80	    simp only [S.placeSide_bob_tensor_one]
    81	    rfl
    82	  rw [← hmass_eq] at hcompare
    83	  rw [tildeM_consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_decoded_overlap]
    84	  dsimp only [mu] at hw hcompare
    85	  linarith

     5	/-!
     6	# Total Pauli measurements under the extraction swaps
     7	
     8	The evaluated overlap on the swapped state is the original evaluated-Pauli
     9	consistency overlap. Both player orientations retain their six-register
    10	placements. These identities instantiate the ideal-state Pauli comparison.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    15	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1785-1858`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-unitary-6` and `eq:qld-unitary-9`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    24	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement

    28	/-- Simultaneous unitary conjugation preserves the quadratic form of a product. -/
    29	theorem stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    30	    (U A B : Op I) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    31	    stateQForm (applyOperatorToState U psi) (conjBy U A * conjBy U B) =
    32	      stateQForm psi (A * B) := by
    33	  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    34	  congr 1
    35	  simp only [conjBy]
    36	  calc
    37	    _ = (Uᴴ * U) * A * (Uᴴ * U) * B * (Uᴴ * U) := by noncomm_ring
    38	    _ = A * B := by rw [hU]; simp
    39	
    40	namespace ProjectiveSetting
    41	
    42	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    43	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    44	
    45	/-- The total Pauli POVM extended to the full local extraction block and
    46	conjugated by the concrete swap. This is the measurement in `eq:qld-unitary-7`. -/
    47	def swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    48	    (W : PauliKind) : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
    49	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    50	    (fun h => conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    51	    (fun h => by
    52	      apply star_right_conjugate_nonneg
    53	      exact kronecker_nonneg
    54	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.pauliMeas side W).pos h) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    55	        Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    56	    (by
    57	      simp only [conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    58	        ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one,
    59	        heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose])
    60	
    61	/-- Coarse-graining commutes with extending and conjugating the Pauli POVM. -/
    62	theorem swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    63	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    64	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    65	    ((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).postprocess
    66	      (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a =
    67	      conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliEvalMeas side W u).effect a)) := by
    68	  simp only [swappedPauliMeas, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
    69	    pauliEvalMeas, conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    70	    ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
    71	  rfl
    72	
    73	/-- Original-player placement agrees with extension to the whole local block. -/
    74	theorem placeSide_onPlayer (side : PlayerSide) (A : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
    75	    S.placeSide side (S.onPlayer side A) = S.placePlayer side A := by
    76	  cases side
    77	  · exact S.placeSide_alice_tensor_one _
    78	  · exact S.placeSide_bob_tensor_one _
    79	
    80	/-- The canonical last-register effect has the same block and crossed placements. -/
    81	theorem placeSide_extracted (side : PlayerSide) (T : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
    82	    S.placeSide side (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) T) =
    83	      S.placeExtractedRegister side T := by
    84	  cases side
    85	  · ext row col
    86	    change
    87	      ((if (row.1.1, row.1.2.1) = (col.1.1, col.1.2.1) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
    88	        T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    89	        (if ((row.2.1, row.2.2.1), row.2.2.2) =
    90	          ((col.2.1, col.2.2.1), col.2.2.2) then 1 else 0) =
    91	      (if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) *
    92	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    93	        ((if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    94	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    95	        (if row.2.2.2 = col.2.2.2 then 1 else 0)
    96	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and, ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_one,
    97	      zero_mul, mul_zero]
    98	    split_ifs <;> rfl
    99	  · ext row col
   100	    change
   101	      (if ((row.1.1, row.1.2.1), row.1.2.2) =
   102	        ((col.1.1, col.1.2.1), col.1.2.2) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
   103	        ((if (row.2.1, row.2.2.1) = (col.2.1, col.2.2.1) then 1 else 0) *
   104	          T row.2.2.2 col.2.2.2) =
   105	      ((if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.2.2.2 col.2.2.2) *
   106	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   107	        (if row.1.2.2 = col.1.2.2 then 1 else 0) *
   108	        (if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   109	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0)
