   156	/-- On the jointly swapped state, the overlap of conjugated block measurements
   157	is one minus their original consistency defect. This is simultaneous unitary
   158	invariance with the exact six-register reassociation. -/
   159	theorem swapped_block_overlap_eq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   160	    {X α : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   161	    (mu : Distribution X) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
   162	    (A : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   163	    (B : X → Measurement α (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   164	    avgOver mu (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm
   165	      (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   166	        (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   167	      (heteroKron (conjBy (swapUnitary w .alice) ((A x).effect a))
   168	        (conjBy (swapUnitary w .bob) ((B x).effect a)))) =
   169	      1 - consistencyDefect mu
   170	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .alice ((A x).effect a))
   171	        (fun x a => S.placeSide .bob ((B x).effect a)) S.psiHat := by
   172	  have h := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu
   173	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .alice (A x))
   174	    (fun x => S.blockMeasurement .bob (B x)) S.psiHat hmu S.psiHat_norm
   175	  simp only [blockMeasurement_effect] at h
   176	  rw [h, sub_sub_cancel]
   177	  apply avgOver_congr
   178	  intro x
   179	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   180	  intro a _
   181	  rw [WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, S.reindexOp_heteroKron_eq_placeSides]
   182	  erw [← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .alice,
   183	    ← S.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide w .bob]
   184	  exact stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply _ _ _ (S.placeBoth_swap_left_unitary w) S.psiHat

   187	/-- Alice's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Bob's canonical
   188	measurement is exactly one minus the evaluated-Pauli/tilde consistency defect. -/
   189	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_alice (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   190	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   191	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm
   192	        (reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   193	          (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat))
   194	        (heteroKron (((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).postprocess
   195	          (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a)
   196	          (((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
   197	            (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   198	            (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a))) =
   199	      1 - consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   200	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   201	        (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat := by
   202	  simp only [S.swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect]
   203	  simp_rw [S.canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM w .bob]
   204	  have h := S.swapped_block_overlap_eq w _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   205	    (fun u => leftPlacedMeasurement (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u)))
   206	    (fun u => Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tildeM w .bob W (indicatorVec u))
   207	      (fun a => (tildeM_isProj w .bob W (indicatorVec u) a).nonneg)
   208	      (sum_tildeM_eq_one w .bob W (indicatorVec u)))
   209	  have hplace (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :=
   210	    S.placeSide_onPlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a)
   211	  convert
   212	    (h.trans (congrArg (fun f => 1 - consistencyDefect _ f _ S.psiHat)
   213	      (funext fun u => funext fun a => hplace u a))) using 1 <;> rfl

   216	/-- Bob's evaluated swapped total-Pauli overlap with Alice's canonical
   217	measurement satisfies the same exact transport, without strategy symmetry. -/
   218	theorem swapped_pauli_overlap_bob (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :

   220	      ∑ a : PauliScalar P, stateQForm

    26	/-- Place a complete measurement on its three-register extraction block. -/
    27	private def pullingPlacedMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    28	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (side : PlayerSide) {A : Type*} [Fintype A]
    29	    (M : Measurement A (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    30	    Measurement A (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
    31	  refine Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.placeSide side (M.effect a)) ?_ ?_
    32	  · intro a
    33	    cases side
    34	    · exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _
    35	        (kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    36	    · exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _
    37	        (kronecker_nonneg Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg (M.pos a))
    38	  · cases side
    39	    · rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one]
    40	      change reindexOp _ (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
    41	        (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
    42	      rw [heteroKron_one_one]
    43	      ext row col
    44	      simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply]
    45	    · rw [← S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one]
    46	      change reindexOp _ (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
    47	        (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
    48	      rw [heteroKron_one_one]
    49	      ext row col
    50	      simp [reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply]

    58	/-- Placing a projective measurement on an extraction block preserves projectivity. -/
    59	private theorem pullingPlacedMeasurement_isProjective {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    60	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (side : PlayerSide) {A : Type*} [Fintype A]
    61	    (M : Measurement A (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)))
    62	    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    63	    Measurement.IsProjective (pullingPlacedMeasurement S side M) := by
    64	  classical

    76	        (IsStarProjection.one _) (hM a))

    80	/-- The Alice evaluation defect is bounded by the supplied global consistency
    81	error, with no decoder correction or non-encoding mass term. -/
    82	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_alice {P : AdmissibleParams}
    83	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    84	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
    85	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    86	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice
    87	        (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))
    88	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
    89	        deltaG := by
    90	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    91	  let pulled := fun u => pullingPlacedMeasurement S .alice
    92	    ((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    93	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .bob W u))
    94	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA'
    95	    ((w.marginalPoly .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
    96	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BA'' (S.pointMeasExp .bob W u)
    97	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu pulled point S.psiHat
    98	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
    99	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
   100	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   101	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a)
   102	      (fun u a => (point u).effect a) S.psiHat =
   103	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   104	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
   105	    rw [hp, hm]
   106	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
   107	    apply avgOver_congr
   108	    intro u
   109	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, pullingPlacedMeasurement_effect,
   110	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
   111	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placeSide .alice
   112	      (((pullingMeas w .alice W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a) *
   113	      S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a))) = _
   114	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pullingMeas_eval_mul_pointMeas]
   115	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
   116	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
   117	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .AA' W u
   118	        (fun a => S.place .BA'' ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))).symm
   119	  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_alice w W
   120	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   121	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
   122	  exact heq.le.trans hbound

   124	/-- Bob's evaluation defect has the same bound, using the other consistency
   125	field of the supplied witness and its `BB'`--`AB''` placements. -/
   126	theorem pullingMeas_eval_point_consistent_bob {P : AdmissibleParams}
   127	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
   128	    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (W : PauliKind) :
   129	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   130	      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   131	      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob
   132	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤
   133	        deltaG := by
   134	  let mu := uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   135	  let pulled := fun u => pullingPlacedMeasurement S .bob
   136	    ((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   137	  let point := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AA' (leftPlacedMeasurement (S.pointMeas .alice W u))
   138	  let marginal := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .BB'
   139	    ((w.marginalPoly .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u))
   140	  let expanded := fun u => S.placedMeasurement .AB'' (S.pointMeasExp .alice W u)
   141	  have hp := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu point pulled S.psiHat
   142	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   143	  have hm := consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap mu marginal expanded S.psiHat
   144	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) S.psiHat_norm
   145	  have heq : consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (point u).effect a)
   146	      (fun u a => (pulled u).effect a) S.psiHat =
   147	      consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   148	        (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat := by
   149	    rw [hp, hm]
   150	    apply congrArg (1 - ·)
   151	    apply avgOver_congr
   152	    intro u
   153	    simp only [pulled, point, marginal, expanded, pullingPlacedMeasurement_effect,
   154	      ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
   155	    change (∑ a, stateQForm S.psiHat
   156	      (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) * S.placeSide .bob
   157	        (((pullingMeas w .bob W).postprocess (fun g => evalPoly g u)).effect a))) = _
   158	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, sum_pointMeas_mul_pullingMeas_eval]
   159	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum]
   160	    exact congrArg (stateQForm S.psiHat)
   161	      (sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul w .BB' W u
   162	        (fun a => S.place .AB'' ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))).symm
   163	  have hbound := marginalPoly_pointMeas_consistent_bob w W
   164	  change consistencyDefect mu (fun u a => (marginal u).effect a)
   165	    (fun u a => (expanded u).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ deltaG at hbound
   166	  exact heq.le.trans hbound

   168	/-- Tensoring the strategy state with the two normalized EPR states preserves
   169	the point-measurement consistency defect. This is the six-register form of
   170	the point self-consistency used at `eq:qld-pulling-3`. -/
   171	theorem point_consistencyDefect_psiHat {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
   172	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (W : PauliKind) :
   173	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   174	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a))
   175	        (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat =
   176	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
   177	        (fun u a => heteroKron ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).effect a) 1)
   178	        (fun u a => heteroKron 1 ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.toStrategy.ψ := by
   179	  classical
   180	  have htransfer (A : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) (B : Op S.toStrategy.ιB)
   181	      (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
   182	      stateQForm S.psiHat (S.placePlayer .alice A * S.placePlayer .bob B) =
   183	        stateQForm S.toStrategy.ψ (heteroKron A 1 * heteroKron 1 B) := by
   184	    letI : DecidableEq (((S.toStrategy.ιA × S.toStrategy.ιB) ×
   185	        (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)) × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)) :=
   186	      instDecidableEqProd
   187	    have hAB := heteroKron_isHermitian A B hA hB
   188	    rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
   189	    change stateQForm S.psiHat
   190	      (S.place .AA' (heteroKron A 1) * S.place .BB' (heteroKron B 1)) = _
   191	    rw [S.psiHat_eq_reindexState, WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState,
   192	      WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, S.reindexOp_sixRegShuffle_place_AA'_heteroKron,
   193	      S.reindexOp_sixRegShuffle_place_BB'_heteroKron]
   194	    simp only [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, heteroKron_one_one]
   195	    rw [stateQForm_vecTensor_heteroKron _ _ _ _
   196	      (heteroKron_isHermitian _ _ hAB Matrix.isHermitian_one) Matrix.isHermitian_one,
   197	      stateQForm_vecTensor_heteroKron _ _ _ _ hAB Matrix.isHermitian_one,
   198	      stateQForm_one_eq_norm_sq, eprState_norm]
   199	    ring
   200	  unfold consistencyDefect
   201	  apply avgOver_congr
   202	  intro u
   203	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   204	  intro a _
   205	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   206	  intro b _
   207	  by_cases hab : a = b
   208	  · simp only [hab, if_true]
   209	  · simp only [if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
   210	    exact htransfer _ _
   211	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((S.pointMeas .alice W u).pos a)).isHermitian
   212	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((S.pointMeas .bob W u).pos b)).isHermitian

   214	/-- The evaluated difference-polynomial measurements are self-consistent.
   215	Agreement and two squared-distance triangle inequalities combine the two
   216	opposite-player comparisons with the original point self-consistency.
   217	The error is linear in the supplied witness error, as required before
   218	the collision step `eq:qld-pulling-12`. -/
   219	theorem pullingMeas_eval_consistencyDefect_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
   220	    {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}

    51	  /-- Each swap map is a right unitary. -/
    52	  swap_right_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,
    53	    swapUnitary w side * (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1

    55	  swap_left_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,

     4	/-!
     5	# The joint state estimate of Magic Square rigidity
     6	
     7	This file proves the state estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` on the dilated
     8	strategy: the tensor of the two players' two-qubit controlled-swap embeddings
     9	carries the shared state to within `O(sqrt ε + sqrt δ)` of two EPR pairs
    10	tensored with a residual bipartite vector, and that residual can be normalized
    11	to the unit auxiliary state of the conclusion.
    12	
    13	The argument is the coordinatewise one.  The image of the state under the two
    14	embeddings has, at the pair of register labels `(e, f)`, the component
    15	
    16	    `(A_e ⊗ B_f) ψ`,
    17	
    18	where `A_e` and `B_f` are the residual factors of the two controlled swaps.
    19	Since the two logical pairs are applied in succession, each component factors as
    20	a second-pair component applied to a first-pair component, so the estimates of
    21	`Rigidity/SwapPair.lean` apply twice: once on the state, once on the residual of
    22	the first pair, whose second-pair hypotheses are supplied by
    23	`Rigidity/SwapTransport.lean`.  Every component with `e ≠ f` is small and every
    24	component with `e = f` is close to the one at the zero label; sixteen labels
    25	then give the estimate.

    29	blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity`,

   700	\begin{remark}[Two steps in the source proof of the extraction lemma]\label{rem:qld-unitary-triangle-slip}
   701		In the source proof of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-unitary}, the triangle inequality gives $\| H_X \ket{\vartheta} - H_Z \ket{\vartheta} \| \leq \| (\Id - H_X)\ket{\vartheta} \| + \| (\Id - H_Z)\ket{\vartheta} \| \leq 2\sqrt{\delta_P}$, so that $\| H_X \ket{\vartheta} - H_Z \ket{\vartheta} \|^2 \leq 4\delta_P$; the source instead asserts the bound $2\sqrt{\delta_P}$ for the \emph{squared} norm, which holds only when $\sqrt{\delta_P} \leq 1/2$, and consequently carries the term $\sqrt{\delta_P}$ into an overlap bound of $1 - 2\delta_P - \sqrt{\delta_P}$. The proof above uses the corrected bound $4\delta_P$, which gives the overlap bound $1 - 4\delta_P$ and leaves the final bound $\delta_{\mathrm{qld}} = O(\delta_P^{1/4} + md/q)$ unchanged. The source proof also normalizes the vector $(\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M})_{\mathrm{A}''\mathrm{B}''} \ket{\vartheta}$ without ensuring that it is nonzero; the case distinction on $\delta_P$ in the proof above supplies this, the conclusions of the lemma being trivial when $\delta_P$ exceeds a universal constant.

  1862	We now prove \Cref{thm:pauli-appendix}. 
  1863	\begin{proof}[Proof of \Cref{thm:pauli-appendix}]
  1864		Let $\strategy = (\psi,M)$ be a projective strategy for $\game^\pauli_\qldparams$ that succeeds with probability at least $1 - \eps$, where $\ket{\psi}$ is a bipartite state on registers $\alice \bob$. As mentioned at the beginning of \Cref{sec:commutation}, we assume that the state $\ket{\psi}$ is padded with sufficiently many ancilla $\ket{0}$ qubits. Let $\phi_\alice$ be the following isometry mapping the register $\alice$ to the registers $\alice \alice' \alice''$ where $\alice'$ and $\alice''$ are isomorphic to $(\C^q)^{\otimes \nqubits}$:
  1865		\[
  1866			\phi_\alice: \ket{\theta}_\alice \mapsto V_\alice (\ket{\theta}_\alice \otimes (\ket{\EPR_q}^{\otimes \nqubits})_{\alice' \alice''})
  1867		\]
  1868		where $V_\alice$ is the unitary acting on $\alice \alice' \alice''$ from \Cref{lem:qld-unitary}. Define the isometry $\phi_\bob$ analogously. \Cref{lem:qld-unitary} then implies that there exists a state $\ket{\aux}$ on registers $\alice \alice' \bob \bob'$ such that
  1869		\[
  1870			\left \| \phi_\alice \otimes \phi_\bob \ket{\psi} - \ket{\aux} \otimes \ket{\EPR_q}^{\otimes \nqubits} \right \|^2 \leq \delta_\qld
  1871		\]

  1873		\[
  1874			\phi_\alice \, (M^{(\Pauli,W)}_h)_\alice \, \phi_\alice^\dagger \approx_{\delta_\qld} (\tau^W_h)_{\alice''} \qquad \text{and} \qquad \phi_\bob \, (M^{(\Pauli,W)}_h)_\bob \, \phi_\bob^\dagger \approx_{\delta_\qld} (\tau^W_h)_{\bob''}
  1875		\]
  1876		where the $\approx$ statement holds with respect to the state $\ket{\aux} \otimes \ket{\EPR_q}^{\otimes \nqubits}$. This shows that $\game^\pauli_\qldparams$ is a self-test for the strategy $\strategy^\pauli$ with robustness $\delta_\qld(\eps,m,d,q)$.   1877	\end{proof}

    53	  have hmd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith

  1419	Recall the decoding map of the low-degree code defined in \Cref{sec:ld-encoding}. This map takes in a polynomial $g \in \ideg_{d,m}(\F_q)$ and returns a string $\coded(g) \in \F_q^{\nqubits}$ consisting of the evaluations of $g$ on the points in the hypercube $\{0,1\}^m$.
  1420	We now use this decoding map to construct a new set of measurement operators out of $\hat{S}$.
  1421	First, we introduce some notation. For all $W \in \{X,Z\}$ and all degree $d$ polynomials $g: \F_q^m \to \F_q$ define projectors
  1422	\[ \hat{S}^X_g = \sum_{g_\zpt} \hat{S}_{g,g_\zpt} \quad  \text{and}  \quad \hat{S}^Z_g = \sum_{g_\xpt} \hat{S}_{g_\xpt,g}\;,\]
  1423	where the measurement $\{\hat{S}_{g_\xpt,g_\zpt} \}$  is given by \Cref{lem:qld-4-7}.
  1424	
  1425	For all $W \in \{X, Z\}$, $\tilde{u} \in \F_q^{\nqubits}$, and $a \in \F_q$, define the projector
  1426	\begin{equation}\label{eq:def-tauwu}
  1427	 \tau^{W}_{a}(\tilde{u}) = \sum_{h \in \F_q^{\nqubits} \,:\, h \cdot \tilde{u} = a} \tau^W_{h}
  1428	\end{equation}
  1429	where recall that $\tau^W_h$ is the projector corresponding to measuring $(\C^q)^{\otimes \nqubits}$ in the $W$ basis and obtaining $h \in \F_q^\nqubits$ as the outcome. For all $\tilde{u} \in \F_q^\nqubits$ define the projective measurement $\{ \tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a \}_{a \in \F_q}$ by 
  1430		\begin{equation}
  1431		\label{eq:tilde_M}
  1432		\tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a =  \sum_{g} \hat{S}^W_g \otimes \tau_{(\coded(g) \cdot \tilde{u}) - a}^W(\tilde{u})\;.
  1433		\end{equation}
  1434		If $\hat{S}^W_g$ is viewed as an operator acting on registers $\alice \alice'$ (resp. $\bob \bob'$) then we view $\tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a$ as an operator acting on registers $\alice \alice' \alice''$ (resp. $\bob \bob' \bob''$). (When necessary we will indicate via subscripts which registers the operators are acting on.)
  1435	The $\tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a$ are projective because the $\hat{S}^W_g$ and $\tau^W$ operators are projective.

  1439		\begin{equation}\label{eq:def-tildewj}

  1483	\begin{proof}
  1484	We show the first item of the lemma for the case when $M^{(\Point,W),u}_a$ acts on register $\alice$ and $\tilde{M}^{W,\ind_m(u)}_a$ acts on registers $\bob \bob' \bob''$ (the argument for when the $\alice$ and $\bob$ registers are interchanged proceeds analogously):
  1485		\begin{align*}
  1486			&\E_{u \in \F_q^m} \sum_a \bra{\hat{\psi}} M^{(\Point,W),u}_a \otimes \tilde{M}^{W,\ind_m(u)}_a \ket{\hat{\psi}} \\
  1487			&= \E_{u \in \F_q^m} \sum_{g,a} \bra{\hat{\psi}} (M^{(\Point,W),u}_a)_{\alice} \otimes (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau^W_{\coded(g) \cdot \ind_m(u) -a}(\ind_m(u)))_{\bob''} \ket{\hat{\psi}} \\
  1488			&= \E_{u \in \F_q^m} \sum_{g} \bra{\hat{\psi}} (\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{\coded(g) \cdot \ind_m(u)})_{\alice \bob''} \otimes (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\bob \bob'} \ket{\hat{\psi}} \\
  1489			&= \E_{u \in \F_q^m} \sum_{g} \bra{\hat{\psi}} (\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{g(u)})_{\alice \bob''} \otimes (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\bob \bob'} \ket{\hat{\psi}} \\
  1490			&\geq 1 - \delta_S\;.
  1491		\end{align*}
  1492		The second line follows from expanding the definition of $\tilde{M}^{W,\ind_m(u)}_a$ using~\eqref{eq:tilde_M}, the third line follows from the definition of $\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_a$ given in Section~\ref{sec:expanding}, the fourth line follows from the fact that $\coded(g) \cdot \ind_m(u) = g(u)$, and the fifth line follows from \Cref{lem:qld-4-7}. This implies the first item of the Lemma.
  1493	
  1494	
  1495	To show the second item we first argue that, on average over $\tilde{u}$, 
  1496		\begin{equation}
  1497			\label{eq:qld-pulling-cons}
  1498			\Big ( \tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a \Big)_{\alice \alice' \alice''} \approx_{\delta_S} \Big ( \tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a \Big)_{\bob \bob' \bob''}.
  1499		\end{equation}
  1500		This follows because on average over $u \in \F_q^m$ and $\tilde{u} \in \F_q^\nqubits$ we have
  1501		\begin{align}
  1502			&\Big ( \tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a \Big)_{\alice \alice' \alice''} \label{eq:qld-pulling-0} \\
  1503			\approx_{\delta_S}& \Big ( \tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a \Big)_{\alice \alice'\alice''} \cdot \Big ( \sum_g (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes  (\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{g(u)})_{\bob \alice''} \Big) \label{eq:qld-pulling-1} \\
  1504			=_{\phantom{\delta_S}}& \sum_g \Big ( (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau^W_{(\coded(g) \cdot \tilde{u}) - a}(\tilde{u}))_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big(\sum_{r,s: r + s = g(u)} (M^{(\Point,W),u}_r)_{\bob} \otimes (\tau_s^W(\ind_m(u)))_{\alice''} \Big) \label{eq:qld-pulling-2} \\
  1505			=_{\phantom{\delta_S}}& \sum_{\substack{g,h: \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}}  (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau^W_h)_{\alice''} \otimes (M^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h)(u)})_{\bob}~. \label{eq:qld-pulling-2b}
  1506		\end{align}
  1507		The first inequality follows from right-multiplying~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-0} by the approximation~\eqref{eq:qld-sg-cons} in \Cref{lem:qld-constructing-the-paulis-helper} (to be proved below) and using Fact~\ref{fact:add-a-proj}. Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-2} follows from expanding the definition of $\tilde{M}^{W,\tilde{u}}_a$.  To obtain Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-2b}, we expanded the definitions of $\tau^W_{(\coded(g) \cdot \tilde{u}) - a}(\tilde{u})$ and $\tau^W_s(\ind_m(u))$ using~\cref{eq:def-tauwu}, and the fact that $h \cdot \ind_m(u) = g_h(u)$ (due to \cref{eq:low-degree-encoding-definition}). Thus for all $g \in \ideg_{d,m}(\F_q)$ and $s \in \F_q$ we have
  1508		\[
  1509			\tau^W_{(\coded(g) \cdot \tilde{u}) - a}(\tilde{u}) \cdot \tau^W_s(\ind_m(u)) = \sum_{\substack{h: \\ (\coded(g) - h) \cdot \tilde{u} = a \\ g_h(u) = s}} \tau^W_h~.

  1516			&\approx_{0}\sum_{\substack{g,h: \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \cdot \Big((M^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h)(u)})_{\alice} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big ( M^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h)(u)} \Big)_{\bob} \label{eq:qld-pulling-3a} \\
  1517			&= \sum_{\substack{g,h: \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} (\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \cdot \Big((\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{g(u)})_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big ( M^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h)(u)} \Big)_{\bob} \;. \label{eq:qld-pulling-3b}
  1518		\end{align}
  1519		The ``$\approx_0$'' in Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-3a} indicates that the left hand side is equal to the right hand side when applied to the state $\ket{\hat{\psi}}$.   1520		\begin{align}

  1523	\end{align}
  1524		Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-5} follows from~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-4} by expanding the definition of $\{ \hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_a\}$. Next, we argue that, on average over $u \in \F_q^m$,
  1525	\begin{align}
  1526			\text{\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-5}} &\approx_{\delta_S} \sum_{\substack{g,h,h': \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} \Big((\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \otimes \Big( (\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h+g_{h'})(u)})_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau_{h'}^W)_{\bob''} \Big)~. \label{eq:qld-pulling-7}
  1527			\end{align}
  1528			We show this by bounding the magnitude of the difference. Using the fact that $\hat{S}^W_g$ and $\tau^W_h$ are projective, we have:
  1529			\begin{align}
  1530			&\E_u \sum_a \Big \|\sum_{\substack{g,h,h': \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} (\hat{S}^W_g \cdot (\Id - \hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{g(u)}))_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \otimes (\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h+g_{h'})(u)})_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau_{h'}^W)_{\bob''} \, \ket{\hat{\psi}} \Big \|^2 \notag \\

  1533			\leq& \E_u \sum_{g} \bra{\hat{\psi}} ((\Id - \hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{g(u)}) \cdot \hat{S}^W_g \cdot (\Id - \hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{g(u)}))_{\alice \alice'} \ket{\hat{\psi}}\label{eq:qld-pulling-8} \\

The inequality in Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-9} follows from the second item of \Cref{lem:qld-constructing-the-paulis-helper} (to be proved below). 
  1537			Next, we show that on average over $u \in \F_q^m$,
  1538			\begin{align}
  1539			\text{\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-7}} &=\sum_{\substack{g,h,g',h': \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} \Big((\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big( (\hat{S}^W_{g'} \cdot \hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h+g_{h'})(u)})_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau_{h'}^W)_{\bob''} \Big) \label{eq:qld-pulling-9a} \\

  1541			&\approx_{\delta_S} \sum_{\substack{g,h,g',h': \\ (g' - g_{h'})(u) = (g -g_h)(u) \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} \Big((\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big( (\hat{S}^W_{g'})_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau_{h'}^W)_{\bob''} \Big) \label{eq:qld-pulling-11} \\

  1543			\end{align}
  1544			Before we justify the sequence of steps to go from Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-7} to Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-12}, we first argue how this establishes Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-cons}, and hence the second item of the Lemma statement.

  1546			Absorbing the error terms $O(md/q)$ and $O(\sqrt{\eps})$ into $\delta_S$, we have shown that 
  1547			\[

  1558			\paragraph{The approximation in Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-10}.} The approximation in Line~\eqref{eq:qld-pulling-10} follows by bounding the magnitude of the difference:	
  1559	\begin{align}
  1560			&\E_u \sum_a \Big \| \sum_{\substack{g,h,g',h': \\ (g' - g_{h'})(u) \neq (g -g_h)(u) \\ (\coded(g)-h)\cdot \tilde{u} = a}} \Big((\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big( (\hat{S}^W_{g'} \cdot \hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h+g_{h'})(u)})_{\bob \bob'} \otimes (\tau_{h'}^W)_{\bob''} \Big) \ket{\hat{\psi}} \Big \|^2 \notag \\
  1561	&= \E_u \sum_{\substack{g,h,g',h': \\ (g' - g_{h'})(u) \neq (g -g_h)(u)}} \bra{\hat{\psi}} \Big(\hat{S}^W_g)_{\alice \alice'} \otimes (\tau_h^W)_{\alice''} \Big) \cdot \Big( (\hat{M}^{(\Point,W),u}_{(g-g_h+g_{h'})(u)} \cdot \hat{S}^W_{g'} \cdot \notag\\

   214	The next lemma shows that the pulled-apart measurements are consistent with the original points measurements of the strategy, and self-consistent. Write $\delta_G$ for the error of the global polynomial-pair witness supplied by Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-4-7}. Assume $0\leq\eps\leq1$ and $\delta_G\geq0$, and put
   215	\[
   216		B = \delta_G + \sqrt{\eps} + \frac{md}{q}.
   217	\]
   218	Each displayed construction estimate below has its own universal constant $C_E \geq 1$, quantified independently, and its own scale $\delta_P^E=C_EB$. The two presentations agree: after the finitely many estimates have been established, take $C_* = \max_E C_E$ and $\delta_P=C_*B$. Since $B\geq0$, every bound remains valid at this common scale.    576	  Finally, for $0\leq\delta\leq1$ and $C\geq18$, both $16\delta$ and
   577	  $2\delta+2md/q+16\sqrt\delta$ are at most $C(\delta^{1/4}+md/q)$.

    19	\section{At a glance}
    20	
    21	\begin{itemize}
    22	  \item \textbf{Difficulty.} Medium.  The extraction proof contains two
    23	  incorrect numerical steps and later suppresses the range projection when
    24	  passing from unitary conjugation to isometry conjugation.
    25	  \item \textbf{Estimated weight.} A corrected positive-contraction estimate,
    26	  a small-error case split for normalization, and one range-projection transfer
    27	  lemma for a projective measurement family.
    28	  \item \textbf{Mathlib/project split.} Positivity, contraction inequalities,
    29	  isometry range projections, and norm estimates belong to finite-dimensional
    30	  Hilbert-space algebra.  The state-dependent family distance and register
    31	  placements are project-local.
    32	  \item \textbf{Key mathematical inputs.} The inequality
    33	  $H^2\geq2H-I$ for a positive contraction, the triangle inequality, and
    34	  $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$ for an isometry.  The repair is tracked in
    35	  \ghissue{19}.
    36	\end{itemize}

    38	\section{Key theorem forms}
    39	
    40	Let $H_X$ and $H_Z$ be the positive contractions of the extraction proof, and
    41	let $\vartheta$ be a unit vector such that
    42	\[
    43	  \langle\vartheta,H_W\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta/2
    44	  \qquad (W\in\{X,Z\}).
    45	\]
    46	Since $(I-H_W)^2\geq0$,
    47	\[
    48	  H_W^2\geq2H_W-I,
    49	  \qquad
    50	  \langle\vartheta,H_W^2\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta.
    51	\]
    52	Also $\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert^2\leq\delta$, whence
    53	\[
    54	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert^2\leq4\delta.
    55	\]
    56	Together with $H_XH_Z$ equal to the EPR projection, these estimates give the
    57	required overlap bound, with constants absorbed into the stated
    58	$O(\sqrt\delta)$ error.
    59	
    60	For the final transfer, let $\phi\colon\mathcal H\to\mathcal K$ be an isometry
    61	and set $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$.  If $N_h$ is the unitary-conjugated extension of
    62	a measurement operator $M_h$, then the exact identity is
    63	\[
    64	  \phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ=QN_h,
    65	\]
    66	not merely $N_h$.  Thus comparison of $N_h$ with an ideal projector must be
    67	combined with control of $(I-Q)\Delta$ on the ideal comparison state
    68	$\Delta$.
    69	
    70	\section{Numerical defects in the source proof}
    71	
    72	Lines~1715--1742 of
    73	\path{references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex}
    74	construct $H_X,H_Z$ and identify $H_XH_Z$ with the EPR projection.  The norm
    75	estimate at lines~1743--1750 gives
    76	$\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert\leq\sqrt\delta$.  At lines~1753--1757 the
    77	source substitutes $\delta$ inside the reverse triangle inequality
    78	\cite[lines~1715--1783]{Ji2020MIPStar}.  That replacement is not valid for
    79	small $\delta$.  The desired lower bound on
    80	$\langle H_W^2\rangle$ follows directly from $H_W^2\geq2H_W-I$, as above.
    81	
    82	The triangle inequality yields
    83	\[
    84	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert\leq2\sqrt\delta,
    85	\]
    86	so its square is at most $4\delta$.  Line~1761 instead bounds that square by
    87	$2\sqrt\delta$ without a stated restriction.  This inequality follows when
    88	$\delta\leq1/4$; for larger error the theorem is made trivial by enlarging the
    89	universal constant.  The same small-error split ensures that the projected
    90	vector defined at lines~1769--1773 is nonzero before it is normalized.  These
    91	are local numerical repairs and do not weaken the extraction conclusion.
    92	
    93	\section{The range-projection obligation}
    94	
    95	Lines~1827--1858 prove state-dependent closeness for the concrete operators
    96	obtained by conjugating the original measurement with the swap unitaries.
    97	Lines~1864--1875 then define isometries by adjoining EPR pairs and applying
    98	those unitaries, and immediately state the corresponding closeness for
    99	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger$.  The omitted range projection makes this implication
   100	non-definitional \cite[lines~1827--1875]{Ji2020MIPStar}.
   101	
   102	Let $\Psi$ be the original state and suppose $\phi\Psi$ is close to the ideal
   103	state $\Delta$.  Since $Q\phi\Psi=\phi\Psi$ and $Q$ is a contraction, the
   104	triangle inequality bounds $(I-Q)\Delta$ by the state-extraction error.  Using
   105	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ$, split
   106	\[
   107	  (N_hQ-T_h)\Delta
   108	  =(N_h-T_h)\Delta-N_h(I-Q)\Delta,
   109	\]
   110	where $T_h$ is the ideal Pauli projector.  Summing squared norms over $h$
   111	uses projectivity and orthogonality to keep the second term under control.
   112	The same argument is required for each player and each Pauli basis.
   113	
   114	This transfer is an open proof obligation for the next extraction stage.  It
   115	must be a theorem derived from the concrete swap unitaries, transformed-state
   116	estimate, and operator comparisons.  It must not be stored as a bridge field,
   117	residual assumption, or hypothesis of the source-labelled soundness theorem.
   118

   174	\section{Conclusion}
   175	
   176	The printed triangle calculation has repairable numerical errors, and the
   177	last passage from unitaries to isometries omits a genuine range-projection
   178	argument.  Neither defect is a counterexample to Pauli soundness.  The former
   179	is corrected by positive-contraction inequalities and a small-error split;
   180	the latter remains a named downstream proof obligation whose hypotheses are
   181	already supplied by the extraction lemma.  Independently of both defects, the
   182	present extraction declaration is conditional on the global polynomial-pair
   183	measurement, and that conditionality must be removed before it may be
   184	advertised as the source lemma.

 \begin{definition}[The swap unitaries]\label{def:v-swap-unitary}

 \begin{lemma}[Unitarity and conjugation action of the swap unitaries]\label{lem:v-swap-conjugation}
 	\lean{MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose}

 	The maps $V_{\mathrm{A}}$ and $V_{\mathrm{B}}$ of Definition~\ref{def:v-swap-unitary} are unitaries acting on registers $\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{A}''$ and $\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'\mathrm{B}''$ respectively, and their conjugation action is exact, as follows. For all $W \in \{X,Z\}$, $j \in \{0,\ldots,t-1\}$, and $\tilde{u} \in \F_q^M$,
 	\begin{equation}\label{eq:v-swap-obs-conjugation}
 		V_{\mathrm{A}} \, \tilde{W}^j(\tilde{u}) \, V_{\mathrm{A}}^\dagger = \Id_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'} \ot \bigl( \tau^W(e_j \tilde{u}) \bigr)_{\mathrm{A}''}
 		\qquad \text{and} \qquad
 		V_{\mathrm{B}} \, \tilde{W}^j(\tilde{u}) \, V_{\mathrm{B}}^\dagger = \Id_{\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot \bigl( \tau^W(e_j \tilde{u}) \bigr)_{\mathrm{B}''}\;,

 	\begin{equation}\label{eq:qld-unitary-6}
 		V_{\mathrm{B}} \, \tilde{M}^{W,\mathrm{ind}_m(u)}_a \, V_{\mathrm{B}}^\dagger = \Id_{\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot (\tau^W_{[g_h(u)=a]})_{\mathrm{B}''}\;,
 		\qquad
 		\tau^W_{[g_h(u)=a]} = \sum_{h \,:\, g_h(u) = a} \tau^W_h\;,
 	\end{equation}
 	together with the analogous identity for $V_{\mathrm{A}}$ on registers $\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{A}''$.
 \end{lemma}
 \begin{proof}

 \begin{lemma}[Extraction of the EPR state and the Pauli observables]\label{lem:qld-unitary}

 	There is a universal constant $C_{\mathrm{ext}}\geq1$. Set
 	\[
 		\delta_P^{\mathrm{ext}}=C_{\mathrm{ext}}B,
 		\qquad
 		\delta_{\mathrm{qld}}=C_{\mathrm{ext}}
 		\left((\delta_P^{\mathrm{ext}})^{1/4}+\frac{md}{q}\right).

 	There exist unitaries $V_{\mathrm{A}}$ acting on registers $\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{A}''$ and $V_{\mathrm{B}}$ acting on registers $\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'\mathrm{B}''$, such that the following hold.
 	\begin{enumerate}
 		\item There exists a state $\ket{\mathrm{aux}}$ on registers $\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'$ such that
 		\[
 			\bigl\| V_{\mathrm{A}} \ot V_{\mathrm{B}} \ket{\hat{\psi}}_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{A}''\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'\mathrm{B}''} - \ket{\mathrm{aux}}_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M}_{\mathrm{A}''\mathrm{B}''} \bigr\|^2 \leq \delta_{\mathrm{qld}}\;.
 		\]
 		\item For $W \in \{X,Z\}$,
 		\begin{align*}
 			V_{\mathrm{A}} \, \bigl(M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_h \bigr)_{\mathrm{A}} \, V_{\mathrm{A}}^\dagger &\approx_{\delta_{\mathrm{qld}}} \Id_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'} \ot (\tau^W_h)_{\mathrm{A}''}\;, \\
 			V_{\mathrm{B}} \, \bigl(M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_h \bigr)_{\mathrm{B}} \, V_{\mathrm{B}}^\dagger &\approx_{\delta_{\mathrm{qld}}} \Id_{\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot (\tau^W_h)_{\mathrm{B}''}\;,
 		\end{align*}
 		where the $\approx$ statements hold with respect to the state $\ket{\mathrm{aux}}_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M}_{\mathrm{A}''\mathrm{B}''}$, with the answer summation over $h \in \F_q^{M}$ and no average over questions.
 	\end{enumerate}
 	The unitaries may be taken to be $V_{\mathrm{A}}$ and $V_{\mathrm{B}}$ of Definition~\ref{def:v-swap-unitary}.
 	The conditional result below assumes the global polynomial-pair measurement
 	of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-4-7}, whereas the present proof obtains that measurement
 	from the lemma. It therefore establishes the extraction conclusions only
 	after the measurement and its consistency estimates are supplied, not the
 	existence claim above. The missing composition and the range-projection
 	transfer are recorded in \cite{gap:qpbt_extraction-transfer}.

 \begin{proof}
 	\uses{def:v-swap-unitary, lem:v-swap-conjugation, lem:tildew-product-form, lem:qld-construct-the-paulis, lem:qld-win-implications, fact:triangle-for-simeq, def:bracket, lem:cancellation, lem:schwartz-zippel-total-degree, lem:qld-4-7}
 	For the first item, the self-consistency of the observables $\tilde{W}^j$ (Item~2 of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-construct-the-paulis}) is equivalent, since these observables are Hermitian involutions (Lemma~\ref{lem:tildew-product-form}), to $\E_{j \in \{0,\ldots,t-1\}} \E_{\tilde{u} \in \F_q^M} \bra{\hat\psi} \tilde{W}^j(\tilde{u}) \ot \tilde{W}^j(\tilde{u}) \ket{\hat\psi} \geq 1 - \delta_P/2$; setting $\ket{\vartheta} = V_{\mathrm{A}} \ot V_{\mathrm{B}} \ket{\hat\psi}$ and using the exact conjugation identities of Lemma~\ref{lem:v-swap-conjugation}, this becomes $\bra{\vartheta} H_W \ket{\vartheta} \geq 1 - \delta_P/2$ for $W \in \{X,Z\}$, where $H_W = \E_j \E_{\tilde{u}} \, \tau^W(e_j \tilde{u}) \ot \tau^W(e_j \tilde{u}) = \bigl( \E_{s \in \F_q} \tau^W(s) \ot \tau^W(s) \bigr)^{\ot M}$ by the tensor factorization of $\tau^W(\tilde{u})$ and the invariance of the uniform average over $s$ under $s \mapsto e_j s$. By Lemma~\ref{lem:cancellation}, $\E_{s,s'} \tau^X(s)\tau^Z(s') \ot \tau^X(s)\tau^Z(s') = \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}$ on each pair of qudits, whence $H_X H_Z = \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M}$. The bounds $\| (\Id - H_W)\ket{\vartheta} \|^2 \leq \delta_P$ and $\bra{\vartheta} H_W^2 \ket{\vartheta} \geq 1 - 2\delta_P$, combined through the triangle inequality $\| H_X \ket{\vartheta} - H_Z \ket{\vartheta} \| \leq 2\sqrt{\delta_P}$ (see Remark~\ref{rem:qld-unitary-triangle-slip}), give $\bra{\vartheta} \Id_{\mathrm{A}\mathrm{A}'\mathrm{B}\mathrm{B}'} \ot (\ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}\bra{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M})_{\mathrm{A}''\mathrm{B}''} \ket{\vartheta} \geq 1 - 4\delta_P$.
 	% Case distinction added: the source normalizes the projected vector
 	% without ensuring that it is nonzero; see Remark rem:qld-unitary-triangle-slip.

For the second item, Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-win-implications} gives, on average over $u \in \F_q^m$, $M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_{[g_h(u)=a]} \ot \Id \simeq_\eps \Id \ot M^{(\mathrm{Point},W),u}_a$ and $\Id \ot M^{(\mathrm{Point},W),u}_a \simeq_\eps M^{(\mathrm{Point},W),u}_a \ot \Id$, where $M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_{[g_h(u)=a]} = \sum_{h : g_h(u) = a} M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_h$; combining these with Item~1 of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-construct-the-paulis} by Lemma~\ref{fact:triangle-for-simeq}, using $\eps \leq \sqrt{\eps} \leq \delta_P$, yields $M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_{[g_h(u)=a]} \ot \Id \simeq_{\sqrt{\delta_P}} \Id \ot \tilde{M}^{W,\mathrm{ind}_m(u)}_a$. Writing $\ket{\Delta} = \ket{\mathrm{aux}} \ot \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M}$, the quantity to be bounded for the $\mathrm{A}$-side relation equals $2 - 2\sum_h \bra{\Delta} V_{\mathrm{A}} M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_h V_{\mathrm{A}}^\dagger \ot (\tau^W_h)_{\mathrm{B}''} \ket{\Delta}$, since $(\tau^W_h)_{\mathrm{A}''} \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M} = (\tau^W_h)_{\mathrm{B}''} \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q}^{\ot M}$. Replacing $(\tau^W_h)_{\mathrm{B}''}$ by the averaged coarse-graining $\E_u \sum_{h' : g_{h'}(u) = g_h(u)} (\tau^W_{h'})_{\mathrm{B}''}$ costs at most $md/q$ by Lemma~\ref{lem:schwartz-zippel-total-degree} (distinct $h \neq h'$ have distinct encodings $g_h \neq g_{h'}$, of total degree at most $md$), and by \eqref{eq:qld-unitary-6} the resulting sum equals $\E_u \sum_{a} \bra{\Delta} V_{\mathrm{A}} M^{(\mathrm{Pauli},W)}_{[g_h(u)=a]} V_{\mathrm{A}}^\dagger \ot V_{\mathrm{B}} \tilde{M}^{W,\mathrm{ind}_m(u)}_a V_{\mathrm{B}}^\dagger \ket{\Delta}$. Altogether the distance is $O(\delta_P^{1/4} + md/q)$; the $\mathrm{B}$-side relation is proved identically.
 \end{proof}

 \section{Conclusion}
 
 The printed triangle calculation has repairable numerical errors, and the
 last passage from unitaries to isometries omits a genuine range-projection
 argument.  Neither defect is a counterexample to Pauli soundness.  The former
 is corrected by positive-contraction inequalities and a small-error split;
 the latter remains a named downstream proof obligation whose hypotheses are
 already supplied by the extraction lemma.  Independently of both defects, the
 present extraction declaration is conditional on the global polynomial-pair
 measurement, and that conditionality must be removed before it may be
 advertised as the source lemma.

private def pullingPlacedMeasurement {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}
    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (side : PlayerSide) {A : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (M : Measurement A (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    Measurement A (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  refine Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.placeSide side (M.effect a)) ?_ ?_
  · intro a
    cases side
    · exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _
        (kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    · exact ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _
        (kronecker_nonneg Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg (M.pos a))
  · cases side

      change reindexOp _ (heteroKron (1 : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
